text: Dayunon sang Department of Agriculture (DA) ang pagpatuman sang maximum suggested retail price (SRP) sa karne sang baboy.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) will continue the implementation of the maximum suggested retail price (SRP) for pork.

text: Ini matapos naglab-ot na sa P480 per kilo ang presyo sini sandig sa pinakaulihi nga monitoring sang ahensya.
english: This is after the price of rice has reached P480 per kilo based on the latest monitoring of the agency.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Assistant Secretary kag spokesman Arnel de Mesa, wala pa sang nahitso nga petsa kun san-o ini umpisahan, apang pat-od nga iimplementar ini sang agriculture department bangud sobra-sobra ang presyo nga makit-an sa mga mercado.
english: According to Agriculture Assistant Secretary and spokesman Arnel de Mesa, there is no fixed date when it will start, but the agriculture department will definitely implement it because the prices found in the markets are too high.

text: Base sa monitoring sang DA, ang retail price sang pork shoulder ang yara sa P345 tubtub sa P420 per kilo samtang yara sa P380 tubtub sa P480 per kilo naman sa pork belly.
english: Based on DA monitoring, the retail price of pork shoulder is P345 to P420 per kilo while pork belly is P380 to P480 per kilo.

text: Tuman ini ka taas ipaanggid sa farmgate price nga P220-P240 kada kilo.
english: This is very high compared to the farmgate price of P220-P240 per kilo.

text: “If you include the additional cost of P100 to P150, the retail price should only be P350, P360, P380, but we are seeing P450, P460, P480, P450.
english: “If you include the additional cost of P100 to P150, the retail price should only be P350, P360, P380, but we are seeing P450, P460, P480, P450.

text: There is something wrong with the pricing in the markets,” suno kay De Mesa.
english: There is something wrong with the pricing in the markets,” De Mesa said.

text: Una na nga gin-report sang DA nga sang third quarter sang 2024, naka-recover na ang hog raisers sa epekto sang pag-igo sang African Swine Fever (ASF).
english: The DA earlier reported that by the third quarter of 2024, hog raisers will have recovered from the impact of the African Swine Fever (ASF) outbreak.

text: Ginklaro ni Manila 3rd District Rep.
english: Manila 3rd District Rep.

text: Joel Chua nga wala sang istoryahanay sa Kamara nga iimpeach si Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Joel Chua that there is no discussion in the House to impeach Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Ini nga klaripikasyon ang kasunod sang naglapta nga report kahapon nga ginaalegar nagpadala sang text message si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: This clarification follows reports yesterday that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. allegedly sent a text message.

text: sa House leaders nga nagatulod sa ila nga mag-file sang impeachment complaints batok kay Sara.
english: to House leaders prompting them to file impeachment complaints against Sara.

text: Suno kay Chua, wala siya sang nabaton nga komunikasyon nga amo sini halin sa liderato sang Kamara.
english: Chua said he had not received any such communication from the House leadership.

text: “Hindi ko pa po alam yan,” suno kay Chua sa isa ka press conference.
english: “I don't know that yet,” Chua said at a press conference.

text:
“Wala naman po akong nare-receive na communication from House Leadership.”

Gin-ugyunan ni Zambales Rep.
english:
“I have not received any communication from House Leadership.”

Zambales Rep.

text: Jay Khonghun ang statement ni Chua nga wala pa sang diskusyon kaangot sa impeachment sa bise-presidente, apang suno kay Khonghun, posible nga indi mapunggan ang iban nga mga kongresista nga suportahan ang kaangay nga mga tikang.
english: Jay Khonghun rejected Chua's statement that there has been no discussion regarding the impeachment of the vice president, but Khonghun said it is possible that other congressmen will not be prevented from supporting such measures.

text: “Well, wala tayong kasiguraduhan kung saan nga po nanggaling yung text messages na iyan pero kung ang pinag uusapan ay impeachment, lahat naman ng tao may karapatan na mag file ng impeachment at siguro nasa kanya-kanyang konsensiya na yan ng mga bawat miyembro ng Kamara kung susuporta sila sa impeachment na may magpa-file…” suno sa mamalidha.
english: "Well, we are not sure where those text messages came from but if the issue is impeachment, everyone has the right to file impeachment and maybe it is in the conscience of each member of the House if they support impeachment with someone to file..." haha.

text: Mismo si Sara ang nagpalutaw nga target gid sang Marcos administration nga kakason siya sa pwesto.
english: Sara herself revealed that the Marcos administration is targeting to remove her from office.

text: Una naman nga nagpaguwa sang statement ang presidente kag nagsiling nga indi man importante si Sara gani indi kinahanglan ang impeachment complaints bangud iga-distract lamang sila sini sa pagtrabaho sa gobyerno.
english: Earlier, the president issued a statement saying that Sara is not important and therefore there is no need for impeachment complaints because it will only distract them from working in government.

text: Subong nga adlaw kuntani ang hearing sang House committee kaangot sa confidential funds ni Sara apang indi ini anay pagdayunon.
english: The House committee hearing on Sara's confidential funds was scheduled to be held today but will not be held.

text: Ginpaathag ni Chua nga hatagan nila sang ligwa ang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) nga nag-require sang presensya ni Sara subong nga adlaw agud magsabat kaangot sa iya “kill order” batok sa president, first lady, kag house speaker.
english: Chua explained that they will give relief to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) which required Sara's presence today to answer regarding her “kill order” against the president, first lady, and house speaker.

text: Bag-o lang nakabalik sa hampang kag naka-recover sa injury ang former NBA-Most Valuable Player nga si Joel Embiid apang kinahanglan naman sini liwat nga magpahuway matapos nagsuprer sang sinus fracture.
english: Former NBA-Most Valuable Player Joel Embiid recently returned to the game and recovered from injury but had to rest again after suffering a sinus fracture.

text: Natabo ini sa 30-anyos nga superstar center sa hampang sang Philadelphia 76ers batok sa Indiana Pacers kun sa diin nalutos sanday Embiid, 121-107.
english: It happened to the 30-year-old superstar center in the Philadelphia 76ers' game against the Indiana Pacers where Embiid lost, 121-107.

text: Tuyo kuntani sang big man nga mag-rebound apang naigo ang iya nawong sang siko ni Bennedict Mathurin sang Indiana.
english: The big man intended to rebound but was hit in the face by an elbow from Indiana’s Bennedict Mathurin.

text: 12 puntos pa lamang, four rebounds, kag five assists ang nahimo sang Cameroon native sang amo nga tion apang kinahanglan na sini magguwa antes ang half-time.
english: The Cameroon native had managed just 12 points, four rebounds, and five assists at the time but had to come out before half-time.

text: Sunod nga ginkumpirma sang Sixers nga na-diagnose ini nga may sinus fracture kag kinahanglan ang evaluation subong nga weekend.
english: The Sixers subsequently confirmed that he had been diagnosed with a sinus fracture and would need an evaluation this weekend.

text: Ang sinus fracture amo ang pagkabali ukon crack sa tul-an nga nagapalibot sa sinuses nga posible tuga sang facial trauma ukon mabug-at nga impact.
english: A sinus fracture is a break or crack in the bone surrounding the sinuses likely caused by facial trauma or heavy impact.

text: Ini nga injury ang mahimo magresulta sa seryoso nga mga kumplikasyon kaangay sang sinus infections, kabudlay sa pagginhawa, kag facial deformity kun indi ma-treat sang maayo.
english: This injury can result in serious complications such as sinus infections, difficulty breathing, and facial deformity if not treated properly.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini pa lamang kuntani ang ikaduha nga hampang ni Embiid matapos wala nakaupod sa pito ka sambuwa subong nga season.
english: It was known that this was only Embiid's second game after missing seven games this season.

text: Sang 2017-2018 season, nagsuprer man si Embiid sang orbital bone fracture.
english: During the 2017-2018 season, Embiid also suffered an orbital bone fracture.

text: Ginsundan ini sang injury sa Game 6 sang first-round playoff game sang Philadelphia batok sa Toronto sang 2022.
english: That was followed by an injury in Game 6 of Philadelphia’s first-round playoff game against Toronto in 2022.

text: Bangud graduation season sa gihapon subong, sunod-sunod ang mga istorya nga makapukaw sang aton nga balatyagon kag maka-agaw gid sang aton nga atensyon.
english: Since it's still graduation season, there are stories that can stir our feelings and capture our attention.

text: Isa diri ang istorya sang conjoined twins sa Statesville, North Carolina, USA nga ginhatagan lang anay sang duha ka porsyento nga tyansa nga mabuhi, apang subong pareho na nga healthy kag naka-graduate sa Kindergarten!
english: One of these is the story of conjoined twins in Statesville, North Carolina, USA who were once given only a two percent chance of survival, but now both are healthy and graduated from Kindergarten!

text: Ini ang istorya sang kapid nga sanday Abby kag Erin nga ginbun-ag nga tapikanay ang ulo ukon ginatawag nga craniopagus twins, isa ka kondisyon nga nagatapik ang ila nga bagul kag isa lang ang iban sa ila nga brain tissues.
english: This is the story of twins Abby and Erin who were born with craniopagus twins, a condition that causes their skulls to attach and only one of their brain tissues.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, isa sa 2.5 million lamang ang tyansa nga makaangkon sang craniopagus twins rason nga espesyal ang kaso nanday Abby kag Erin.
english: In fact, there is only a one in 2.5 million chance of having craniopagus twins, which is why Abby and Erin's case is special.

text: Suno sa ila 33-anyos nga mommy nga si Heather Delaney, nagabusong pa lamang siya sang ginpahibalo sang doktor nga gamay lang ang tyansa nga mabuhi ang iya mga bata.
english: Their 33-year-old mommy, Heather Delaney, said she was just pregnant when the doctor informed her that her children had little chance of survival.

text: Hulyo 2016 sang ginbun-ag ang kapid, apang bangud sa kondisyon, wala anay sila ginpa-guwa sa neonatal intensive care unit sa Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia sa Pennsylvania.
english: The twins were born in July 2016, but due to their condition, they were not discharged from the neonatal intensive care unit at the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia in Pennsylvania.

text: Sang 2017, ginpaidalom sila sa 11 ka oras nga operasyon agud nga maseparar ang ila nga mga ulo.
english: In 2017, they underwent an 11-hour operation to separate their heads.

text: Sang amo nga tion, malaka pa gid lamang ang naga-risgo sa kaangay nga operasyon rason nga tuman ang kahadlok sang pamilya, apang, tuman ang kalipay sang mommy kag daddy nga pareho nga nakaluwas ang duha ka bata.
english: At that time, very few people risked such an operation so the family was very scared, but, very happy mommy and daddy that both children survived.

text: Fast forward subong nga tuig, malapit na lang ang ila nga 7th birthday kag proud parents gid sanday Heather kag iya mister nga si Riley samtang ginalantaw ang paggraduate sang duha ka bata sa Kindergarten.
english: Fast forward to this year, their 7th birthday is approaching and Heather and her husband Riley are proud parents as they watch their two children graduate from Kindergarten.

text: Mangin ang mga doktor ang haluson man makapati kun makita ang kapid, kag ginakabig ini isa ka milestone nga ila nalab-ot.#
english: Even doctors can hardly believe it when they see the twins, and consider it a milestone they have achieved.

text: ILOILO CITY- Dungog kag kakulba ang nabatyagan sang pamilya sang isa ka Ilonggo nurse sa United Arab Emirates matapos nga nagvolunteer ini agud mangin subject sa clinical trial para sa COVID-19 vaccine.
english: ILOILO CITY- The family of an Ilonggo nurse in the United Arab Emirates felt honored and nervous after she volunteered to be subjected to a clinical trial for the COVID-19 vaccine.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Blessie Luzarita, utod sang nurse nga si Ramon Francisco Sonico sang Sta.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Blessie Luzarita, sister of nurse Ramon Francisco Sonico of Sta.

text: Barbara, Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga nakibot na lang sila sang ginpahibalo sa ila ni Sonico nga nakapa-inject na ini sang first shot sang nasambit nga bakuna.
english: Barbara, Iloilo, he said they were surprised when Sonico informed them that he had already injected the first shot of the vaccine.

text: Suno kay Luzarita, apisar nabalaka, wala na nila ginkakibot ang ginhimo sang iya manghud bangud humalin sadto, duna na sa iya manghud ang mangin volunteer sa mapuslanon nga mga kawsa.
english: According to Luzarita, although worried, they were not surprised by her brother's actions because since then, her brother has been able to volunteer for useful causes.

text: Gintuad ni Luzarita nga sa subong, nagahulat pa ang iya manghud sang 21 ka adlaw kag iga-inject sa iya kag sa iban nga mga human subjects sang trial ang ikaduha nga shot sang bakuna.
english: Luzarita admitted that her younger brother is still waiting for 21 days before he and the other human subjects of the trial will be injected with the second shot of the vaccine.

text: Si Sonico ang Nursing graduate sang Central Philippine University kag tatlo ka tuig na nga nurse sa isa ka ospital sa UAE.
english: Sonico is a Nursing graduate of Central Philippine University and has been a nurse for three years in a hospital in the UAE.

text: Mas madamo nga mga Pinoy ang nagasulod sa negosyo matapos narecord sang Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) ang record-high registrations sang bag-o nga mga kompaniya sang 2024.
english: More Filipinos are entering the business after the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) recorded record-high registrations of new companies in 2024.

text: Suno sa commission, ang mga registrations para sa bag-o nga mga kompaniya ang naghampak sa all-time high sang nagligad nga tuig sa likod sang innovative kag advanced digital platforms nga padayon nga nagapahapos sa pagnegosyo sa Pilipinas.
english: According to the commission, registrations for new companies hit an all-time high last year on the back of innovative and advanced digital platforms that continue to make it easier to do business in the Philippines.

text: Ang commission nagregister sang 52,304 nga bag-o nga companies sang 2024, mas mataas sang six percent sa 49,506 sang 2023.
english: The commission registered 52,304 new companies in 2024, up six percent from 49,506 in 2023.

text: Ini nagpataas sang total number sang active SEC-registered companies sa 527,710 sa pagtakop sang 2024.
english: This raises the total number of active SEC-registered companies to 527,710 by the end of 2024.

text: Ang stock corporations ang nagabug-os sang 75 percent, ukon 39,146, sang bag-o nga registered companies; ang non-stock corporations naman ang 21 percent, ukon 10,782; kag ang nabilin nga four percent, ukon 2,376, ang lunsay partnerships.
english: Stock corporations accounted for 75 percent, or 39,146, of the newly registered companies; non-stock corporations accounted for 21 percent, or 10,782; and the remaining four percent, or 2,376, are all partnerships.

text: Samtang, ang bag-o nga registered one-person corporations ang nagtubo sang 27 percent sa 8,640 sang 2024 halin sa 6,794 sang 2023.
english: Meanwhile, newly registered one-person corporations grew 27 percent to 8,640 in 2024 from 6,794 in 2023.

text: Nakakuha sang impormasyon si former Anakalusugan Partylist Rep.
english: Former Anakalusugan Partylist Rep.

text: Mike Defensor nga natultulan ang kontrobersyal nga whistleblower nga si Orly Guteza.
english: Mike Defensor who tracked down controversial whistleblower Orly Guteza.

text: Si Guteza nga anay staff ni resigned Ako Bicol Party-list Rep.
english: Guteza, a former staff of resigned Ako Bicol Party-list Rep.

text: Zaldy Co amo ang surprise witness sa Senate Blue Ribbon Committee nga nag-implicate kay former House Speaker Martin Romualdez sa flood control corruption scandal sadtong Septyembre 2025.
english: Zaldy Co is the surprise witness in the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee that implicated former House Speaker Martin Romualdez in the flood control corruption scandal in September 2025.

text: Ang nagdala sa iya sa Senado bilang testigo amo si Senator Rodante Marcoleta, apang nauna na nga ginpahayag sang senador nga ang nagpakilala sa ila sa isa kag isa amo si Defensor.
english: He was brought to the Senate as a witness by Senator Rodante Marcoleta, but the senator earlier said that Defensor introduced them to each other.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga wala sila sang direkta nga komunikasyon, apang sa iya nga ulihi nga impormasyon, na-locate na si Guteza apang indi siya sigurado kun sa diin ini subong.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Defensor said they have no direct communication, but according to his latest information, Guteza has been located but he is not sure where he is now.

text: “Parang na-locate na siya, pero hindi ako sigurado kung he is still under the custody of the Marines or malaya na siya,” suno sa anay kongresista.
english: “It seems that he has been located, but I am not sure if he is still under the custody of the Marines or he is free,” the former congressman said.

text: “Ang maganda naman ay syempre buhay siya.
english: “The good thing is that of course he is alive.

text: Ako naman ay natutuwa para sa kaniyang pamilya,” pahayag pa ni Defensor.
english: I am happy for his family,” Defensor said.

text: Ginkumpirma man sini nga may common friend sila ni Guteza rason nga nangin kilala man niya ini kag gin-refer kay Marcoleta nga sang una amo ang chairman sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee.
english: He also confirmed that he and Guteza had a common friend so he got to know him and referred him to Marcoleta who was formerly chairman of the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee.

text: Matandaan nga matapos ang iya testimoniya sa Senado, nangindulaan na si Guteza.
english: It can be recalled that after his testimony in the Senate, Guteza disappeared.

text: May nagguwa nga reports nga yara ini sa kustodiya sang Philippine Marine Corps (PMC) bilang isa ka retired serviceman, apang ginpanginwala ini sang Philippine Navy.
english: There were reports that he was in the custody of the Philippine Marine Corps (PMC) as a retired serviceman, but the Philippine Navy denied this.

text: Sa pag-resume sang hearing sang Senate Blue Ribbon panel sang Lunes, nagpaguwa si Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson sang show cause order batok sa iya.
english: Resuming the hearing of the Senate Blue Ribbon panel on Monday, Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson issued a show cause order against him.

text: Nagpaandam ini nga maga-isyu sila sang arrest warrant kun wala sang maayo nga paathag kun ngaa wala gihapon ini nagsipot sa hearing.
english: He warned that they will issue an arrest warrant if there is no good explanation why he still did not attend the hearing.

text:

ukon indi pagsantu sang supply (sang dalan) kag demand sa pagbiyahe sing
salakyan sa dalanon (roads).
english:
BASICALLY, our traffic problem is a mismatch problem,
or mismatch between supply (of roads) and demand for travel
vehicle on the roads.

text:
Tungod sa kagamay sang dalan (small supply) para sa sobra nga kadamuon

(traffic congestion).
english:
Because of the small supply for the excess quantity
(big demand) of cars, our problem is car congestion

mahinay man ang dalagan sang mga salakyan.

Of course, there is little risk for those crossing the road because
traffic was also slow.

text:
Ugaling, problema man ini sang mga
may ginasakuan nga nagasakay sa salakyan.

However, it is also a problem for

In such a small path problem, our usual solution

As well as building
of alternative lanes for walk-wishing commuters,
other vehicle-safe access, such as bicycles
lanes, and the construction of service roads for vehicles that

If the road is too wide for a small number of

Ang
malawig nga talabukon nga dalan makahatag man gani sing kahangawa kag

The

mga ugali sang aton mga drayber kag sang mga commuters mismo nga mahuyog

First, because of the opposite

english:

Let’s trust that cars on a small road can breathe through

english:
Let us trust to rest on the narrow road from which others

text:
Tungod sini, importante ang vigilance sa pagpatuman sang aton

english:
For this reason, vigilance is important in the implementation of our

commuters.

text: Wala sing dapat libre nga mga traffic officers.
english: There should be no free traffic officers.

text:

buslan dayon agud indi magbakante ang bantayanay sang trapiko.
english:
When someone takes a break,
replace immediately so that the traffic guard does not become empty.

Of course, madamo man ang dapat himuon naton agud mapaayo gid ang

Of course, there is also a lot we need to do to really improve the

ini sa iban nga dalan.

This includes road designs, the construction of new roads that
shorten a trip, closing a road in time to cause traffic

english: If dry mouth is not addressed immediately, it can lead to tooth decay and bad breath.

text: Pahayag sang eksperto, kun indi gilayon mag ayo ang kondisyon, may yara sang dako nga posibilidad nga may yara ikaw sang impeksyon tuga sang fungi ukon virus sa imo nga bibig.
english: According to the expert, if the condition does not improve immediately, there is a high possibility that you have a fungal or viral infection in your mouth.

text: KON ANO man ang matuod nga natabo, ang importante sa karon amo nga ang mataas nga pamunuan sang Tsina, paagi sa Chinese Embassy, nagpaabot sang ila regret sa pagkabunggo sang Chinese trawler sa Filipino fishing boat nga F/B Gem Vir 1.
english: WHATEVER really happened, what matters for now is that the Chinese top leadership, through the Chinese Embassy, ​​expressed their regret over the collision of the Chinese trawler with the Filipino fishing boat F/B Gem Vir 1.

text: Naghatag man sing rason ang Chinese Embassy kon ngaa ginpabay-an sang Chinese trawler Yuemaobinyu 42212 ang 22 ka tinao sang Filippino fishing boat.
english: The Chinese Embassy also gave a reason why the Chinese trawler Yuemaobinyu 42212 abandoned the 22 crew of the Filipino fishing boat.

text: Ina tungod kuno kay gin-kuyog (besieged) sila, sunu mismo sa Chinese Embassy, sang mga Filipino nga mangingisda kag nalagyo na gid lang sila sa kahadlok sa kon ano man ang matabo sa ila.
english: This is because they were besieged, according to the Chinese Embassy, ​​by Filipino fishermen and they fled for fear of what would happen to them.

text: Daw indi man mga pirata ang mga mangingisda ta nga kuyogon gid ang mga Intsik, samtang ang dapat una pensaron kag himuon sang tanan amo nga mabuligan  rescue ang mga napahamak nga mga mangingisda.
english: It seems that our fishermen are not pirates to follow the Chinese, while the first thing that everyone should think and do is to help rescue the distressed fishermen.

text: Isa pa, indi bala “Flight is evidence of guilt”, ukon ang pagpalagyo pakilala sang kasal-anan, sa masami gani nga ginapatihan naton?
english: Furthermore, isn't “Flight is evidence of guilt”, or isn't flight a sign of guilt, as we often believe?

text:
***

Ginsiling sang Chinese Embassy nga ang natabo isa ka “ordinary collision” sa tunga sang Chinese trawler (light purse seine), nga mas daku kaayo, kag sang gamay nga Filipino fishing boat sadtong tungang gab-i sang Hunyo 9.
english:
***

The Chinese Embassy said the incident was an “ordinary collision” between a Chinese trawler (light purse seine), which was much larger, and a small Filipino fishing boat at midnight on June 9.

text: Nahibal-an lang ining hitabo sa aton publiko sa pagsugid ni Defense Secretary Lorenzana sadtong Independence Day, Hunyo 12.
english: This incident was only made known to the public by Defense Secretary Lorenzana on Independence Day, June 12.

text: Sunu sa isa ka press release, gin-igu sang Chinese trawler sang iya lighting grid ang Filipino fishing boat nayon sa pilot house kag ginyud-tud pa gani ini tubtub nga nalugdang.
english: According to a press release, the Chinese trawler hit the Filipino fishing boat near the pilot house with its lighting grid and even dragged it until it sank.

text:
***

Bisan pa ugaling wala sing kahilabtanan, kon wala gid man, ang matag-as nga pamunuan sang Tsina sa natabo, indi ta gihapon masiling nga wala sing kahilabtanan ang katapuan sang Chinese trawler.
english:
***

Although the Chinese top leadership was not involved, if at all, in the incident, we cannot say that the crew of the Chinese trawler was not involved.

text: Sunu sa Filipino boat captain Junel Insigne, naka-anchor, ukon naka-angkla, sila sang matabo ini kag masnahon, ukon makita, sila sing maathag halin sa Chinese trawler.
english: According to Filipino boat captain Junel Insigne, they were anchored when the incident occurred and they were clearly visible from the Chinese trawler.

text: Pareho nga may suga ang duha ka fishing boat.
english: Both fishing boats are equipped with lights.

text: Gani gapati gid si Boat Captain Junel Insigne nga ginhungod gid ang pagkabunggo sa ila sang sobra ka daku nga Chinese trawler Yuemaobinyu 42212.
english: Boat Captain Junel Insigne believes that the oversized Chinese trawler Yuemaobinyu 42212 collided with them.

text: Sa pahayag gani sang AFP Western Command sa Palawan, “far from accidental” ang natabo.
english: According to the AFP Western Command in Palawan, the incident was “far from accidental”.

text: In other words, kon wala man sing kahilabtanan ang matag-as nga pamunuan sang Tsina, posible nga may kahilabtanan ang pamunuan sang Chinese trawler.
english: In other words, if the Chinese top management is not involved, the Chinese trawler management is likely to be involved.

text: Kag diri na matutok ang imbestigasyon sa natabo, nga pwede pasakupan sang mga maritime authorities sang Tsina kag Filipinas.
english: And this is where the investigation into the incident will focus, which may involve the maritime authorities of China and the Philippines.

text: Kon ginhungod man ang pagkabunggo sang Chinese trawler sa pagpati ni Insigne, posible tungod sang personal nga kaugot sang mga Intsik sa padayon nga pagpangisda sang mga Filipino sa Recto Bank, nga samtang gina-claim sang Tsina, gina-claim man ini sang Filipinas sa idalom sang aton sovereign rights sa aton 200-mile Exclusive Economic Zone (EZZ).
english: If the collision of the Chinese trawler was intentional, Insigne believes, it is possible because of the Chinese's personal anger at the continued fishing of Filipinos in the Recto Bank, which while claimed by China, is also claimed by the Philippines under our sovereign rights in our 200-mile Exclusive Economic Zone (EZ).

text: Daw pareho bala sang pagbunggo sang isa ka dyep sa isa pa ka dyep tungod sa kaakig sang drayber nga gin-overtake sang nagasunod nga dyep nga ka-kumpetensya niya sa pasahero.
english: It's like a jeep colliding with another jeep because of the anger of the driver who was overtaken by the following jeep that was his competitor for the passenger.

text: Kon indi gid man hungod, segurado tungod ini sa kakulangan sang pag-amlig sang Chinese trawler.
english: If it was not intentional, it must have been due to the Chinese trawler's lack of protection.

text: Makumparar ta ini sa “reckless imprudence” nga sayop sa tunga sang salakyan sa duta katulad sang awto kag dyep.
english: We can compare this to the “reckless imprudence” error between land vehicles such as cars and jeeps.

text: Tungod sini dapat lang ang Chinese trawler magbayad sang kapahamakan sang F/B Gem Vir 1 sa balor nga P2.2 ka milyon, sunu sa tag-iya.
english: Because of this, the Chinese trawler should only pay for the disaster of F/B Gem Vir 1 worth P2.2 million, according to the owner.

text: Madugang pa dira ang iban nga danyos.
english: Other damage will be added.

text: Dapat sabton man nila ang pag-abandonar sa 22 ka tinao sang Filipino fishing boat samtang naga-utaw-utaw sing pila ka oras sa lawod sang malugdang ang ila salakyan, nga ginapakamalaut sang international law.
english: They must also answer for the abandonment of 22 crew members of a Filipino fishing boat while they were floating for hours at sea when their vehicle sank, which is condemned by international law.

text: Diri sa Filipinas may ara kita sing Good Samaritan Law nga naga-obligar sa pagtabang sang sin-o man nga malabayan nga may kasablagan.
english: Here in the Philippines we have a Good Samaritan Law that obliges us to help anyone we pass by with a disability.

text: Maayo lang kay wala sing napatay sa aton mga mangingisda kag nalubong sa malamig nga lulubngan sang kadagatan.
english: Fortunately, none of our fishermen died and were buried in the cold grave of the ocean.

text: Ang isa pa ka Vietnamese nga fishing boat ang nag-rescue sa mga Filipino, nga ginapasalamatan gid naton nga mga Filipino sing daku.
english: Another Vietnamese fishing boat rescued the Filipinos, for which we Filipinos are very grateful.

english: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)

text: Ginalauman ni Iloilo Provincial Governor Arthur Defensor Jr., nga mabalik sa orihinal nga judging areas ang Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan kag Dinagyang Tribes Competition.
english: Iloilo Provincial Governor Arthur Defensor Jr., hopes that the Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahan and Dinagyang Tribes Competition will return to their original judging areas.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa Gobernador, iya ginpahayag nga may bintaha kag disbintaha sang ginpatigayon ang Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan kag Dinagyang Tribes Competition sa mga bag-o nga judging area apang suno man sa iya nga indi ini sala nga desisyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, the Governor said there were advantages and disadvantages when the Kasadyahan sa Babanwahana and Dinagyang Tribes Competition were held in the new judging areas but he said it was not a wrong decision.

text: Ini matapos nga ginpamangkut si Defensor nahanungod sa iya reaksyon angut sa pahayag sang Iloilo Festivals Foundation Inc.
english: This was after Defensor was asked about his reaction to the statement of the Iloilo Festivals Foundation Inc.

text: (IFFI) nga ibalik sa City Proper ang venue ukon judging area sang Dinagyang Tribes Competition sa 2027.
english: (IFFI) to return the venue or judging area of ​​the Dinagyang Tribes Competition to City Proper in 2027.

text: Apang paathag man niya, nakadepende ini sagihapon sa desisyon sang IFFI kag Iloilo City Government bangud ara ini sa ila jurisdiction.
english: However, he explained that it still depends on the decision of the IFFI and the Iloilo City Government because it is under their jurisdiction.

text: Gin-ulan sang kritisismo ang FIFA ukon ang world governing body sang football matapos gin-anunsyo nga ang Saudi Arabia ang maga-host sang 2034 World Cup.
english: FIFA or the world governing body of football was showered with criticism after it was announced that Saudi Arabia will host the 2034 World Cup.

text: Sentro sang kahangawa sang mga grupo amo ang human rights record sang Saudi partikular na ang mga ebidensya nga nagatudlo kay Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman nga may ginmandu nga torture, mass executions kag forced disappearances.
english: Central to the groups' concern is Saudi's human rights record particularly evidence pointing to Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman with ordered torture, mass executions and forced disappearances.

text: Base sa Human Rights Watch, ang hosting documents sang Saudi Arabia ang nagapakita sang plano sini sa kun paano preparahan ang World Cup.
english: According to Human Rights Watch, Saudi Arabia's hosting documents show its plans for how to prepare for the World Cup.

text: Lakip diri ang pagtukod sang 11 ka bag-o nga stadiums, masobra 185,000 ka bag-o nga hotel rooms, kag pagpasangkad pa sang mga imprastraktura lakip na ang dalan kag paluparan.
english: This includes the construction of 11 new stadiums, more than 185,000 new hotel rooms, and further expansion of infrastructure including roads and airports.

text: Ginakahangaw-an sang mga grupo nga mabutang sa alang-alang ang kabuhi sang construction workers kag iban pa nga migrant workers.
english: The groups fear that the lives of construction workers and other migrant workers will be put at risk.

text: Nagsulat naman ang Human Rights Watch — kaupod ang 10 ka iban pa nga rights groups kag labor organizations lakip na ang Amnesty International and Football Supporters Europe — sa law firm nga naga-produce sang report para sa Saudi federation nga mapaguwa man ang ila nga concerns.
english: Human Rights Watch — along with 10 other rights groups and labor organizations including Amnesty International and Football Supporters Europe — wrote to the law firm producing the report for the Saudi federation to express their concerns.

text: “As global and regional human rights organizations, trade unions, fans groups and organizations representing migrant workers, many of us have long highlighted the severe risks posed by Saudi Arabia’s hosting of mega-sporting events,” kabahin pa sang statement nga ginpaguwa sang grupo.
english: “As global and regional human rights organizations, trade unions, fans groups and organizations representing migrant workers, many of us have long highlighted the severe risks posed by Saudi Arabia’s hosting of mega-sporting events,” the group said in a statement.

text:
“By awarding the 2034 World Cup to Saudi Arabia without meaningful protections, FIFA has today decided both to ignore our warnings and discard its own human rights policies.”

Antes ang World Cup, naga-host naman ang Kingdom sa high-profile events kaangay sa Formula One, heavyweight boxing kag WTA Finals.
english:
“By awarding the 2034 World Cup to Saudi Arabia without meaningful protections, FIFA has today decided both to ignore our warnings and discard its own human rights policies.”

Before the World Cup, the Kingdom hosts high-profile events such as Formula One, heavyweight boxing and the WTA Finals.

text: Gina-akusaran man ini sang “sportswashing” — ukon ang termino kun sa diin ginagamit ang sports agud maliso ang atensyon sang publiko kun ano ang ila record sa paglapas sa kinamatarong sang mga tawo.
english: It is also accused of “sportswashing” — or the term where sports are used to divert public attention to their record of human rights violations.

text: Indi ini ang una nga tion nga kontrobersyal ang pag-host sang nasyon sang FIFA World Cup bangud ginkwestyon man anay ang Russia kag Qatar nga pareho man nga may kontrobersyal nga record sa human rights.
english: This is not the first time the country’s hosting of the FIFA World Cup has been controversial as Russia and Qatar, both of which have controversial human rights records, have also been questioned in the past.

text: Sang 2022, ginpatigayon ang tournament sa Qatar nga gin-ulan man sang kritisismo bangud sa pagtratar sini sa migrant workers.
english: In 2022, the tournament was held in Qatar, which was also showered with criticism for its treatment of migrant workers.

text: Nagpasaka sang ethics complaint ang abogado nga si Atty. Eldrige Marvin Aceron batok kay Senator JV Ejercito nga amo mismo ang chairperson sang Senate Committee on Ethics and Privileges.
english: An ethics complaint was filed by lawyer Atty. Eldrige Marvin Aceron against Senator JV Ejercito who is himself chairperson of the Senate Committee on Ethics and Privileges.

text: Ginareklamo si Ejercito sang “gross neglect of constitutional duty in office” bangud wala ini sang hulag nga ginhimo sa separado nga ethics complaint batok kay Sen.
english: Ejercito is accused of “gross neglect of constitutional duty in office” for not acting on a separate ethics complaint against Sen.

text: Chiz Escudero nga ginpasaka sadtong Oktubre 2, 2025.
english: Chiz Escudero who was filed on October 2, 2025.

text: “Despite the passage of 109 days since the filing of the ethics complaint against Sen.
english: “Despite the passage of 109 days since the filing of the ethics complaint against Sen.

text: Escudero, respondent has failed to assign a case number, failed to provide any notice or communication, failed to take any action whatsoever,” kabahin sang gin-file nga reklamo.
english: Escudero, respondent has failed to assign a case number, failed to provide any notice or communication, failed to take any action whatsoever,” part of the filed complaint.

text: Sa iya complaint, ginhingyo man sang abogado ang pagkakas kay Ejercito bilang chairperson sang amo nga committee.
english: In his complaint, the lawyer also requested the removal of Ejercito as chairperson of the committee.

text: Nagpanindugan naman si Ejercito nga indi pa makapatigayon sang hearings ang iya nga komitiba bangud wala pa nakumpleto ang ila nga mga myembro.
english: Ejercito insisted that his committee cannot conduct hearings because their members are not yet complete.

text: Magluwas diri suno sa iya, nangin masako man ang Senado sa budget deliberations kag sa bicameral conference committee.
english: Besides, he said, the Senate has also been busy with budget deliberations and the bicameral conference committee.

text: “But rest assured that the Ethics Committee will convene and hear pending cases once it is fully constituted and when session resumes.
english: “But rest assured that the Ethics Committee will convene and hear pending cases once it is fully constituted and when session resumes.

text: The said cases will be heard in order of filing,” kabahin naman sang sabat sang senador.
english: The said cases will be heard in order of filing,” the senator said.

text: Matandaan nga ang ethics complaint batok kay Escudero sang 2025 ang nag-ugat sa P30-million nga campaign donation nga iya ginbaton halin sa kontraktor nga si Lawrence Lubiano kadungan sang 2022 elections.
english: It can be recalled that the ethics complaint against Escudero in 2025 stemmed from a P30-million campaign donation he received from contractor Lawrence Lubiano during the 2022 elections.

text: Gindala na pauli sa Britanya ang bangkay sang former One Direction star nga si Liam Payne tatlo ka semana matapos nahulog ini sa balkonahe sang isa ka hotel sa Argentina.
english: The body of former One Direction star Liam Payne has been brought back to Britain three weeks after he fell from the balcony of a hotel in Argentina.

text: Nagbiya halin sa Buenos Aires kag pakadto sa London ang flight nga nagakarga sang bangkay ni Liam 1:58 pm local time suno sa sources.
english: The London-bound flight carrying Liam's body left Buenos Aires at 1:58 pm local time, sources said.

text: Yara man ang iya amay nga si Geoff sa Ezeiza International Airport matapos ginproseso ang repatriation kag ginbisitahan ang lugar kun sa diin ginbawian sang kabuhi ang English singer.
english: His father, Geoff, was also present at Ezeiza International Airport after processing the repatriation and visited the place where the English singer died.

text: Gin-report man sang Argentine media nga Myerkules sang aga sang ginsaylo ang bangkay ni Liam halin sa British Cemetery sa Buenos Aires kun sa diin ini gin-embalsamar.
english: Argentine media also reported that Liam's body was moved from the British Cemetery in Buenos Aires on Wednesday morning where it was embalmed.

text: Oktubre 16 sang napatay si Liam.
english: Liam died on October 16th.

text: Nangin makakilibot ang kamatayon sini sa edad nga 31-anyos kag gilayon nga nag-ulan ang mensahe sang kasubo sang fans, pamilya, kag former bandmates sini nga sanday Niall Horan, Harry Styles, Louis Tomlinson, kag Zayn Malik nga nagpaguwa man sang joint statement.
english: His death at the age of 31 came as a shock and immediately rained messages of condolences from his fans, family, and former bandmates Niall Horan, Harry Styles, Louis Tomlinson, and Zayn Malik who also released a joint statement.

text: Antes ang insidente, nabukaran sa record sang otoridad nga duha ka beses pa nga nagtawag ang hotel staff sa emergency services agud i-report nga may guest sila nga natam-an sa droga kag alcohol kag naga-eskandalo sa hotel room.
english: Before the incident, it was revealed in the records of the authorities that the hotel staff called the emergency services twice to report that they had a guest who was high on drugs and alcohol and was causing a scandal in the hotel room.

text: Pagkasunod sadto, nakit-an na ang lawas ni Liam sa idalom sang hotel kag ginkumpirma man nga may “substances” sa hulot sini nga ginaangot sa na-consume sini nga alcohol kag drugs antes napatay.
english: Subsequently, Liam's body was found under the hotel and it was also confirmed that there were substances in his room that were linked to the alcohol and drugs he consumed before his death.

text: Ang English-Irish pop boy band nga One Direction ukon ID nga natukod sa London sang 2010 ang isa sa highest-grossing live acts sa kalibutan apang natabo ang indefinite hiatus sang 2016.
english: English-Irish pop boy band One Direction or ID formed in London in 2010 were one of the highest-grossing live acts in the world but took an indefinite hiatus in 2016.

text: Isa ka semana matapos ang kamatayon ni Liam, nagbalik sa UK charts ang lima tanan ka albums sang boy band.
english: A week after Liam's death, all five of the boy band's albums returned to the UK charts.

text: Ang ila third album nga Midnight Memories ang amo ang nanguna sang nagsulod sa chart sa number 13 nga may sales kag streams nga nagsaka 517% week-on-week suno sa Official Charts Company.
english: Their third album Midnight Memories topped the chart at number 13 with sales and streams up 517% week-on-week according to the Official Charts Company.

text: Tatlo man sa ila singles ang nagsulod liwat sa Top 40 samtang ang final solo single ni Liam nga Teardrops ang nakasulod man sa chart sa labing-una nga tion nga yara sa number 85.#
english: Three of their singles also entered the Top 40 again while Liam's final solo single Teardrops also entered the chart for the first time at number 85.#

text: INDI ini pagpakalain sa aton mga utod nga Muslim.
english: This is NOT an insult to our Muslim brothers and sisters.

text: In fact, wala kita sing rason nga pakalainon ang mga Muslim kag ang iban sa lain nga pagtuo.
english: In fact, we have no reason to criticize Muslims and others of a different faith.

text: Pareho kita nga mga Filipino kag handom ta ang kaayuhan sang tanan.
english: We are all Filipinos and we want the best for everyone.

text: Isa pa, katapo ako sang isa ka daku nga fraternity sa pungsod nga may madamo nga brod kag sis nga Muslim diri sa pungsod kag bisan sa iban pa nga bahin sang kalibutan.
english: Also, I belong to a large fraternity in the country with many Muslim brod and sis here in the country and even in other parts of the world.

text: Apang may problema seguro ang pangabay sang sini lang ni Presidente Duterte para sa mga utod ta nga mga Muslim diri sa Filipinas.
english: But there must be a problem with President Duterte's recent request for our Muslim brothers and sisters here in the Philippines.

text: Ginpangabay ni Presidente sa Commission on Audit nga i-reconsider, ukon tugtan, ang paggamit sang P5 ka milyon nga pondo para sa Marawi City housing project agud isaylo kag gamiton ini sa pilgrimage sa Mecca, nga Hajj kon tawgon sang mga utod naton nga mga Muslim.
english: The President asked the Commission on Audit to reconsider, or allow, the use of the P5 million fund for the Marawi City housing project to be transferred and used for the pilgrimage to Mecca, which is called Hajj by our Muslim brothers.

text:
***

Ang Hajj isa ka pagpanakayon sa Mecca, ang “holy land” sang mga Muslim, sa diin obligado ang mga Muslim nga makasarang sa pagduaw labi na gid sa panahon sang ika-12 nga Muslim lunar month.
english:
***

The Hajj is a journey to Mecca, the “holy land” of Muslims, where Muslims are obliged to be able to visit especially during the 12th Muslim lunar month.

text:
***

Wala nagpahayag ang balita kon ngaa gin-disallow sang COA ining anay request ni Presidente Duterte nga gamiton ining P5 ka milyon sa pilgrimage sa Mecca sang mga utod ta nga mga Muslim, nga karon gina-request niya sa COA nga i-reconsider.
english:
***

The news did not reveal why the COA disallowed President Duterte's earlier request to use the P5 million for the pilgrimage to Mecca of our Muslim brothers, which he is now requesting the COA to reconsider.

text: Wala man kita medyos nga mahibal-an kon ano ang rason sang COA sa pag-disallow sini.
english: We also have no way of knowing what the COA's reason was for disallowing it.

text: Kon ang rason ugaling tungod indi puede ang paghatag sang P5 ka milyon para sa Hajj sa idalom sang “Separation of Church and State” nga probisyon sang aton Konstitusyon, gapati kita nga indi matuod ini puede i-reconsider pa sang COA.
english: If the reason is because the P5 million for Hajj is not allowed under the “Separation of Church and State” provision of our Constitution, we believe that this is not true and the COA can reconsider.

text: Ang aton Konstitusyon nagasiling sa idalom sang Section 6 (Principles): “ The Separation of Church and State shall  be inviolable”.
english: Our Constitution states under Section 6 (Principles): “ The Separation of Church and State shall  be inviolable”.

text: Ining aton pagpati indi katulad sang mga pungsod sa idalom sang pagginahum theocracy, sa diin ang nagagahum sa gobyerno amo man ang mga pinuno sang simbahan.
english: This belief is not like that of countries under theocracy, where the rulers of the government are also the leaders of the church.

text: Makita naton ini nga pagginahum sa mga pungsod sang mga Muslim.
english: We see this domination in Muslim countries.

text: Kon ngaa indi naton masunod ining theocracy sa aton Demokrasya, ina tungod mismo sang sugo ni Jesukristo sa mga Kristiyano nga “ihatag sa Diyos ang sa Diyos kag kay Caesar ang kay Caesar”.
english: The reason why we cannot follow this theocracy in our Democracy is because of Jesus Christ's command to Christians to “render to God what is God's and to Caesar what is Caesar's”.

text: Ngaa, suliton naton, indi gid puede gamiton ining P5 ka milyon para sa pilgrimage sang mga Muslim?
english: Why, let's repeat, can't this P5 million be used for the Muslim pilgrimage?

text: Sa nasiling ta na, ang rason amo mismo ang ginsugo sang Konstitusyon nga may “Separation of Church and State”.
english: As we have already said, the reason is that the Constitution itself mandates the “Separation of Church and State”.

text: Of course, may pagpaathag man ini sa iban nga probisyon sang Konstitusyon nga nagatugot sang pagsimpon sang Simbahan kag Estado sa pila ka bagay.
english: Of course, it also explains other provisions of the Constitution that allow the merger of Church and State in certain matters.

text: Katulad sang pag-empleyo sang mga pari, pastor, mga imam kag iban pa nga ministro sang mga simbahan bilang chaplain ukon kasubong nga kategoriya sang pagpang-empleyo, nga kinahanglan man gani sang gobyerno nga nagapati sa Diyos.
english: Such as the employment of priests, pastors, imams and other ministers of churches as chaplains or similar categories of employment, which is also needed by a government that believes in God.

text: Subong man ang pagsulod sa diin man nga eskwelahan regardless kon ano ang imo relihiyon.
english: Also getting into any school regardless of your religion.

text: Nasulod seguro ini nga ideya sa “equal opportunity” nga probisyon sang Konstitusyon.
english: This idea is probably embedded in the “equal opportunity” provision of the Constitution.

text: Nanotaran man naton nga ginatugot man gani sang gobyerno ang paggasto sa pag-repair sang mga daan nga mga simbahan sang nagakalain-lain nga relihiyon kag iban pa nga edificio religiosa nga nagapadumdumon sa aton sang mga importante nga mga hitabo sa kasaysayan sang mga pumuluyo sa kabug-usan.
english: We also note that the government even allows spending on the repair of old churches of various religions and other edificio religiosa that remind us of important events in the history of the people as a whole.

text: Ginatugutan man nga makaboto ang mga pari, madre, pastor, iman kag iban pa nga mga lideres sang mga simbahan sa ila “right to suffrage”.
english: Priests, nuns, pastors, imams and other church leaders are also allowed to vote in their “right to suffrage”.

text: Ginpahanugutan man, paagi sa paghatag permiso, sa mga aktibidad sang mga simbahan, katulad sang prosesyon kag prayer rally, sa ila kinamatarong sa Freedom of Religion sa idalom man sang aton Konstitusyon.
english: It also allowed, by issuing permits, the activities of churches, such as processions and prayer rallies, in their right to Freedom of Religion under our Constitution.

text: In other words, kon ginapahanugot man lang sa kasuguan kag maka-benepisyo man lang ang tanan, nga abe indi.
english: In other words, if it is allowed by law and everyone can benefit, which is not.

text: Ugaling, kon ang mga Muslim lang ang pahanugutan sing bulig para sa ila pilgrimage kag indi ang iban, indi na ini puede.
english: However, if only Muslims are allowed to receive assistance for their pilgrimage and not others, this is no longer permissible.

text: Inanunsyo ni US President Donald Trump na magkikita sila ni Russian President Vladimir Putin ng Russia sa darating na Biyernes, Agosto 15, 2025 sa Alaska para talakayin ang mga usaping pangkapayapaan.
english: US President Donald Trump announced that he will meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin of Russia on Friday, August 15, 2025 in Alaska to discuss peace issues.

text: Ayon kay Trump, ang pagpupulong ay bahagi ng pagsisikap na maabot ang tigil-putukan sa pagitan ng Russia at Ukraine, na may deadline na itinakda noong Agosto 8 para pumayag si Putin sa ceasefire o harapin ang posibleng parusang pang-ekonomiya.
english: According to Trump, the meeting is part of efforts to reach a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine, with a deadline set on August 8 for Putin to agree to a ceasefire or face possible economic sanctions.

text: Bagama’t hindi nilinaw ni Trump kung ipatutupad ang mga parusang ito, sinabi niyang nakadepende ito kay Putin.
english: Although Trump did not specify whether the sanctions would be implemented, he said it would depend on Putin.

text: Kasabay nito, sinabi niya na bibigyan ng lahat ng kailangan si Pangulong Zelenskyy ng Ukraine upang makamit ang kapayapaan.
english: At the same time, he said that he will give President Zelenskyy of Ukraine everything he needs to achieve peace.

text: Pahayag naman ni Zelenskyy na handa silang makipagtulungan para sa tunay at pangmatagalang kapayapaan, ngunit dapat maintindihan ng lahat kung ano ang nararapat na kapayapaan.
english: Zelenskyy said they are ready to work together for a true and lasting peace, but everyone must understand what peace is.

text: Patuloy ang pag-igting ng tensyon sa pagitan ng U.S. at Russia, kasabay ng mga hakbang ni Trump tulad ng paggalaw ng mga nuclear submarines at pagtaas ng taripa sa langis mula India na nagmula sa Russia.
english: Tensions between the U.S. and Russia continue to escalate, along with Trump's moves such as the movement of nuclear submarines and increased tariffs on oil from India that originated in Russia.

text: Nagapadumdum ini sa aton sang Philippine Independence Day sa sini nga adlaw.

text: Pero, matuod gid bala nga independiente ang aton pungsod – nga makahimo ini sang mga desisyon nga hilway kag indi kinahanglan diktahan, kag, kon bukas man kita sa ideya sang iban, kita gihapon ang masunod kay wala sang kadena nga nagagahum?
english: But, is our country really independent – ​​that it can make decisions freely and without needing to be dictated to, and, even if we are open to the idea of ​​others, we are still the next because there is no chain of command?

text: Tagsa-tagsa na gid lang kita seguro ang magsabat sining aton pamangkot.
english: I guess it's up to each of us to answer this question.

text: Ako ya wala nagapati nga independiente na ang aton pungsod.
english: I don't believe that our country is independent.

text: Ngaa man?

text: Man sige gihapon ang pagpahigot naton sa pagpamentaha sang iban nga pungsod, pagpa-ekslabo sang aton mga kauturan nga OFW sa mga mapiguson nila nga mga amo, kag bisan mismo sang pigos naton nga kahimtangan diri sa pungsod sa diin laptahon pa ang gutom, kapigaduhon kag kahadlok sa nagakalain-lain nga mga krimen sa palibot.
english: We are still tied to the exploitation of other countries, the exile of our OFW brothers and sisters to their oppressive employers, and even our own oppressive situation here in the country where hunger, poverty and fear of various environmental crimes are still widespread.

text: Nonetheless, wala kita nagakawad-an sing paglaum sa isa ka hilway kag mapagros nga ekonomiya diri sa pungsod para sa tanan.
english: Nonetheless, we are not losing hope in a free and healthy economy here in the country for all.

text:
***

LUAS sa 99,899 ka boto nga wala kuno maisip (unaccounted for) ukon “missing”, gintudlo man ni Congressman Ferjenel Biron sa iya election protest ang pre-election survey sang Ranom Access Consultants Inc.
english:
***

In addition to the 99,899 votes that were allegedly unaccounted for or “missing”, Congressman Ferjenel Biron also pointed to the pre-election survey of Ranom Access Consultants Inc.

text: Sa ining survey, sunu sa ginpagwa nila sa tri-media, nag-abanse si Biron kay Congressman Arthur “Toto” Defensor Jr.
english: In this survey, according to the tri-media, Biron is ahead of Congressman Arthur “Toto” Defensor Jr.

text: Tungod sini, kag iban pa nga rason, nangayo si Biron sa Comelec sing “manual recount” sang mga boto.
english: For this reason, and other reasons, Biron asked the Comelec for a “manual recount” of the votes.

text: Ambot lang kon entertenaron ini sang Comelec kay sa pagpati sang madamo daw drama lang ini sang kapaslawan nga wala sing basehan.
english: I don't know if the Comelec will entertain it because many believe it's just a drama of failure without any basis.

text: Abanse si Defensor sa mga nahauna nga survey sang Ramon Acess Consultants Inc.
english: Defensor is ahead in the preliminary surveys of Ramon Acess Consultants Inc.

text: Sang ulihi na lang si Biron nag-abanse sa survey sang ini man nga survey firm.
english: It was only later that Biron advanced in a survey by the same survey firm.

text: Apang indi ayhan ginpili lang ang mga respondent agud paboran si Biron?
english: But weren't the respondents just chosen to favor Biron?

text: Si Toto Defensor nagdaug batok kay Biron sing mga 87,678 ka boto sa ila pagpadalagan para Gobernador sang Iloilo sadtong Mayo 13 nga eleksyon.
english: Toto Defensor won against Biron by about 87,678 votes in their race for Governor of Iloilo in the May 13 election.

text: Nag-angkon siya sing 479,081 ka boto, samtang si Biron may ara lang 391,403 ka boto.
english: He secured 479,081 votes, while Biron had only 391,403 votes.

text: Sa lakat sang botohay sang nagligad nga eleksyon nga bisan sa pila ka lugar nga teritoryo niya napierde pa si Biron, malayo na ang bisan ang pinakamatayog nga speculation nga malagas pa ni Biron ining 87,678 nga abanse ni Toto Defensor halin sa kuno “unaccounted for” kag “missing” nga mga boto.
english: In the course of the voting in the last election that even in some areas of his territory Biron lost, even the highest speculation that Biron will overtake Toto Defensor's 87,678 lead from the allegedly "unaccounted for" and "missing" votes is far from.

text: Pero paano natabo ang subong kadamo nga boto nga kuno wala maisip?
english: But how did such a large number of votes supposedly go uncounted?

text: Basi tungod wala mabasa sang election machine?
english: Maybe because the election machine didn't read it?

text: Kon may ara gid man, sa aton pagpati, indi man seguro amo na kadamo.
english: If there are, we believe, it's probably not that many.

text: In fact, wala ako nakabati nga may nagsiling nga may boto nga “missing” sa kopya sang mga botante.
english: In fact, I didn’t hear anyone say there was a vote “missing” on the voters’ copy.

text: Kag paano na-“missing” ang pila ka balota?
english: And how did some ballots go “missing”?

text: Wala man sing nabalita nga inagaway sing balota box.
english: There were also no reports of ballot box fights.

text: Gin-akusar man ni Biron ang pihak nga kampo sing vote-buying.
english: Biron also accused the other camp of vote-buying.

text: Pero daw sa kampo man gani ni Biron ang na-akusaran sing vote-buying mismo sa tion pa lang sang kampanya.
english: But it seems that Biron's camp was accused of vote-buying during the campaign.

text: Gapanghatag kuno sang binalde nga groceries sa mga pumuluyo.
english: They are distributing packaged groceries to the residents.

text: Kon indi ina vote-buying, ti ano ato?
english: If that's not vote-buying, then what is?

text: Wala man sunog ukon bagyo nga kinahanglan buligan ang mga pumuluyo.
english: There were no fires or typhoons that required resident assistance.

text:
***

Ang gintudlo ni Biron nga resulta sang survey pila ka semana bag-o mag-eleksyon, sa diin nag-abanse siya, indi ina ya resulta sang aktwal nga botohay.
english:
***

Biron pointed out that the results of the survey a few weeks before the election, where he advanced, are not the results of the actual vote.

text: Survey lang ina ya.
english: That's just a survey.

text: Kon tuod man ining survey, laban-laban nabaliswa na ini sang pagpati sang iban sa padayon nga kampanyahanay kag sa padayon man nga “information cascade” sang pagsaylo-saylo sang suporta.
english: If this survey is true, it has probably been distorted by the beliefs of others in the continuous campaigning and the continuous “information cascade” of shifting support.

text: Ang daku seguro nga rason kon ngaa madamo ang nagbaliskad sing boto amo ang credibilidad sang pila ka block timers ni Biron.
english: The biggest reason why many people flipped their votes is probably the credibility of some of Biron's block timers.

text: Ang isa ka block timer ni Biron, sunu sa block timers ni Toto Defensor, indi mapatihan tungod ang iya ginabungat sa waragwagan pagbali mismo sang iya pinamulong sa nagligad nga naka-tape pa.
english: Biron's one block timer, according to Toto Defensor's block timers, is unbelievable because what he says on the radio is a violation of his previous speech that was still on tape.

text: Kon san-o gintirada niya sadto si Biron, gindayaw na niya si Biron sa sining eleksyon.
english: When he criticized Biron, he praised Biron in this election.

text: Ti, paano mo abe siya mapatihan sa iya isyu nga ginadala?
english: Well, how can you believe him on his issue?

text: Para sa akon, isa ato ka rason kon ngaa madamo nga mga supporter ni Biron ang nagliso sang ila balatyagon pakadto kay Toto Defensor./PN
english: For me, that's one of the reasons why many of Biron's supporters turned their feelings towards Toto Defensor./PN

text: Ang Ethics Committee amo ang nagapanguna sa pag-uyat sang mga isyu nga naangot sa conduct, kinamatarong, pribilehiyo, safety, dignidad, integridad, kag reputasyon sang Senado kag mga senador.
english: The Ethics Committee takes the lead in handling issues related to the conduct, rights, privileges, safety, dignity, integrity, and reputation of the Senate and senators.

english: There is a smuggler.

text: May ara man nga daw hari sa kwarto.

text:
***

UGTO sadto sang nagligad nga semana sang makalabay kita sa pila ka abyan nga metro aide (street sweepers) nga nagapahuway-huway sa gwa sang ila upisina sa tupad sang Jaro Gym sa Jaro Plaza.
english:
***

IT WAS noon last week when we passed some friends who are metro aides (street sweepers) who were resting outside their office next to the Jaro Gym in Jaro Plaza.

text: Nakig-sugilanon kita sa ila kag namangkot kon kamusta man sila sa ila trabaho.
english: We talked to them and asked how they were doing at work.

text: Gintudlo nila ang pila ka problema, katulad sang mga guba nila nga mga kariton kag suludlan sang basura.
english: They pointed out some problems, such as their broken carts and garbage cans.

text: Ginmono man nila ang indi maaros nga kahimtangan nila sa ila magamay nga upisina.
english: They also complained about the poor conditions in their small office.

text: Nanotaran ko nga naga-ubo-ubo ang isa sa ila.
english: I noticed that one of them was coughing.

text: Nakasiling gani ako nga basi sa sobra na ina nga trabaho kag tungod sa nahaklo nila nga higko kag mikrobyo nga dala sang basura nga ginatrabaho nila.
english: I even said that maybe it was too much work and because of the dirt and germs they inhaled from the garbage they worked on.

text: Sa wala ko ginpaabot, ang isa sa ila nagmono nga tani may “hazard pay” man sila tungod sa kabudlay kag kahigko sang ila ubra.
english: Unexpectedly, one of them offered to have hazard pay because of the hard work and dirt.

text: Medyo natingala man gani ako nga wala sila gali sing “hazard pay”.
english: I was a little surprised that they didn't have hazard pay.

text: Dapat, siling ko gani, sandig sa nahibal-an naton kon ano kabudlay kag kahigko sang ila trabaho nga nagabutang sa risgo sang ila ikaayong lawas.
english: It should, I say, based on what we know about how hard and dirty their job is, putting their health at risk.

text: Paathag sining nagmono nga ang ila katulad wala sing “hazard pay” kay wala sila malakip diri sa idalom sang Magna Carta for Health Workers kag sa iban pa nga layi.
english: The protesters explained that their peers do not have hazard pay because they are not covered under the Magna Carta for Health Workers and other laws.

text: Sa nahibal-an naton, ang”hazard pay” diri sa pungsod ginahatag sa mga empleyado nga ang trabaho makahalalit sa ila ikaayong lawas, katulad sang mga health workers.
english: As far as we know, hazard pay in the country is given to employees whose work is harmful to their health, such as health workers.

text: Ang mga soldado kag mga pulis may yara man sini tungod sa peligro sa ila kabuhi.
english: Soldiers and policemen also have them because of the danger to their lives.

text: Subong man ang mga empleyado nga na-assign sa mga lugar nga makatalagam, katulad sang mga social workers sa mga lugar nga may gyera ukon magamo.
english: The same applies to employees assigned to dangerous areas, such as social workers in areas of war or conflict.

text: Lakip man dira ang mga scientist, mga researcher kag mga espesyalista nga exposed sa makamamatay nga kondisyon katulad sang exposure sa nuclear radiation kag mga pasyente nga may  makalalaton nga balatian.
english: This includes scientists, researchers and specialists exposed to deadly conditions such as exposure to nuclear radiation and patients with infectious diseases.

text: Kon ginahatag ining “hazard pay” sa mga nagatrabaho sa gobyerno kinahanglan ugaling ang kasuguan.
english: If hazard pay is given to government employees, however, the law is required.

text: Kon wala sing kasuguan diri, indi man ini mahatag.
english: If there is no law here, it cannot be given.

text: Nahibal-an naton nga madamo sang aton mga basurero (metro aide kag garbage collector), pati na ang mga traffic aide kag mga tanod, ang mga emergency ukon casual lang nga mga empleyado.
english: We know that many of our garbage collectors (metro aide and garbage collector), as well as traffic aides and tanods, are emergency or casual employees.

text: Tungod sina indi sila maka-qualify sa “hazard pay” nga para lang sa regular nga mga empleyado.
english: As a result, they cannot qualify for hazard pay, which is only for regular employees.

text: Paano abe ini matagaan sila sing “hazard pay” paagi sa kasuguan?
english: How can they be given hazard pay by law?

text: Pwede seguro ang ordinansa nga nagahatag sa ila sing “incentive”, ukon “extra pay”, agud may pangamlig man sila sa risgo sang ila trabaho.
english: Maybe an ordinance that gives them an incentive, or extra pay, so that they can be protected from the risks of their jobs.

text:
***

Ang isa ka survey sa “occupational hazard”, labi na gid sa kaso sang mga basurero, nagapahayag nga,  sa masami, ini sila naga-sufrir sang “allergies, cough and cold, asthma and bronchitis, hearing disorder, fever and vomiting after completion of work”, luas pa sa mas malala nga mga kondisyon.
english:
***

A survey on “occupational hazard”, especially in the case of garbage collectors, reveals that, often, they suffer from “allergies, cough and cold, asthma and bronchitis, hearing disorder, fever and vomiting after completion of work”, in addition to more serious conditions.

text: Ining malala nga mga kondisyon nagalakip sang “musculoskeletal disorders (100% sang mga respondents), respiratory problems (95%), dermatological problems (90%), headache (75%) and gastrointestinal problems (15%) during work”.
english: These chronic conditions include “musculoskeletal disorders (100% of respondents), respiratory problems (95%), dermatological problems (90%), headache (75%) and gastrointestinal problems (15%) during work”.

text: Ang suhestyon naton sa mga nagreklamo nga mga metro aide kag mga garbage collector amo nga maghimo sila sing petisyon sa Sanggunian agud basi pa lang pamatian man ang ila reklamo.
english: Our suggestion to the complaining metro aides and garbage collectors is that they make a petition to the Sanggunian so that their complaint may be heard.

text: Meantime, pwede man sila mabuligan sang mga protective gears, katulad sang mask, long sleeves, kalu sa init, kag kapote kon tig-ululan.
english: Meantime, they can also be helped by protective gears, such as masks, long sleeves, heat hats, and raincoats.

text: Good luck sa inyo petisyon.
english: Good luck with your petition.

text: Indi lang maghuya-huya kay kaayuhan na ina ninyo kag sang inyo mga pamilya.
english: Don't be ashamed because it's good for you and your families.

text: Bangud willing man ini nga magtuon, nagsulod si Dimla sa klase kun sa diin ang iya mga classmates ang naga-edad sang 4-5 ka tuig.
english: Because she was willing to learn, Dimla entered the class where her classmates were 4-5 years old.

text: Suno pa sa titser, malapit ang buot ni Dimla sa mga bata kag “Auntie” ang tawag sa iya sa classroom.
english: According to the teacher, Dimla is close to the children and is called “Auntie” in the classroom.

text: Ginpakigbahin man sini nga wala siya naka-eskwela bangud nadulaan ini sang gana matapos nga gin-una sang iya nanay ang pagpaeskwela sa iya nga stepsister.
english: She also shared that she did not go to school because she lost her appetite after her mother put her stepsister's education first.

text: Subong nga manugtapos na ini sa Kindergarten, plano sini nga padayunon pa ang iya nga edukasyon.
english: Now that she is about to graduate from Kindergarten, she plans to continue her education.

text: Natalana ang iya nga graduation ceremony sa Hulyo 14.
english: His graduation ceremony is scheduled for July 14.

text: ANG ROTC, ukon Reserved Officers’ Training Corps, ginahingyo sa karon nga ibalik sa eskwelahan sang pila ka kongresista kag mga senador.
english: THE ROTC, or Reserved Officers’ Training Corps, is currently being urged to be brought back to school by some congressmen and senators.

text: Luyag nila ipatuman ini sa Grade 11 kag 12 nga mga estudyante sang aton karon 12-year high school curriculum.
english: They want to impose it on Grade 11 and 12 students of our current 12-year high school curriculum.

text: Ginapatuman ini sa kolehiyo pagkatapos sang sadto 10-year high school.
english: It is implemented in college after the then 10-year high school.

text: Ang ROTC nangin compulsory sa tanan nga kolehiyo kag unibersidad sa Pilipinas sadtong 1939 sa idalom ni anay Presidente Manuel L. Quezon.
english: ROTC became compulsory in all colleges and universities in the Philippines in 1939 under former President Manuel L. Quezon.

text: Ginpatuman niya ini sa iya Executive Order No.
english: He implemented this in his Executive Order No.

text: 207 nga ginlakip na sa National Defense Act.
english: 207 which has been incorporated into the National Defense Act.

text: Sang panahon sang mga Katsila sa Pilipinas, una nagtuhaw ang kasubong nga ideya (ROTC) sa University of Santo Tomas.
english: During the Spanish era in the Philippines, a similar idea (ROTC) first emerged at the University of Santo Tomas.

text: Gin-organisa sadtong 1762 ni Father Domingo Collantes, O.P., Rector kag Chancellor sang UST, ang isa ka military training sang isa ka batalyon nga mga estudyante sa pagtudlo sang isa ka sarhento sang Royal Spanish Army.
english: Organized in 1762 by Father Domingo Collantes, O.P., Rector and Chancellor of UST, a military training of a battalion of students was taught by a sergeant of the Royal Spanish Army.

text: Gin-train ini sila, agud makigbato, upod sa mga hangaway nga mga Katsila, batok sa mga 7,000 ka tropa sang Ingles halin sa 13 nila ka warship.
english: They were trained, to fight, alongside Spanish fighters, against about 7,000 English troops from 13 of their warships.

text: Nangin madinalg-on ang pagpasakop sining batalyon sang mga estudyante batok sa English invaders.
english: This battalion of students successfully fought against the English invaders.

text: Naghatag ini sang padungog sa unibersidad, nga nagbaton pa gani sang Royal Cedula halin sa Hari sang Espanya kag sang titulo nga “Regalia” kag seal of loyalty nga “Muy Leal”.
english: This brought honor to the university, which even received the Royal Cedula from the King of Spain and the title “Regalia” and seal of loyalty “Muy Leal”.

text: Ang “real ROTC” gid sa pungsod ginsugudan sa UP-Diliman, bilang pundasyon sang Army sanag Pilipinas, sa bulig sang isa ka US Army instructor, nga amat-amat man ginsunod sang iban nga eskwelahan katulad sang UST kag Ateneo.
english: The “real ROTC” in the country was started at UP-Diliman, as the foundation of the Philippine Army, with the help of a US Army instructor, which was gradually followed by other schools such as UST and Ateneo.

text: Pagkatapos nga ipatuman ang ROTC sa bug-os nga pungsod halin sadtong 1939 sa idalom ni anay President Quezon, gin-abolish ini ugaling sadtong 2002 sa pagpasar sang Republic Act 9163, ukon ang National Service Training Program (NSTP), nga ginpatuman mismo sa school year 2002-2003.
english: After being implemented nationwide since 1939 under former President Quezon, the ROTC was abolished in 2002 with the passage of Republic Act 9163, or the National Service Training Program (NSTP), which was implemented during the 2002-2003 school year.

text: Natabo ini tungod sang iskandalo sa korapsyon kag tungod sa brutal man nga pagpatay sang isa ka kadete nga nag-expose sining korapsyon.
english: This happened because of the corruption scandal and also because of the brutal murder of a cadet who exposed this corruption.

text: Ining NSTP, nga nag-abolish sang ROTC bilang military training para sa mga lalake nga estudyante bilang prerequisite sa ila pag-gradwet, ginhimo na nga requirement sa mga lalake kag mga babaye nga estudyante.
english: This NSTP, which abolished ROTC as military training for male students as a prerequisite for their graduation, has been made a requirement for both male and female students.

text: May duha ini ka option sa mga estudyante – ang Literacy Training Service kag ang Civic Welfare Service.
english: It has two options to students – the Literacy Training Service and the Civic Welfare Service.

text: Samtang ang mga gradwet sadto sang ROTC ginlakip sa Citizen’s Armed Force sa idalom sang AFP Reservist Act (RA 7077).
english: Meanwhile, former ROTC graduates were inducted into the Citizen’s Armed Force under the AFP Reservist Act (RA 7077).

text:
***

Indi kita ya sugot nga ibalik ang ROTC.
english:
***

We are not willing to bring back the ROTC.

text: Kon ipilit gid ini, tani “optional” ukon “elective” lang ini nga pwede pilian sang mga estudyante.
english: If it is insisted on, it should be “optional” or “elective” that students can choose.

text: Una nga rason sang indi naton pagpasugot amo ang titulo mismo sang kurso nga ROTC.
english: The first reason for our refusal is the title of the course itself, ROTC.

text: Maathag diri nga para lang ini nga kurso sa mga interesado nga mangin opisyal sa ulihi sang Armed Forces.
english: It is clear here that this course is only for those who are interested in becoming officers later in the Armed Forces.

text: Indi bala para lang ini sa mga “Reserved Officers”?
english: Isn’t this only for “Reserved Officers”?

text: Ikaduha,  indi man kinahanglan nga mangin hangaway ang isa ka pumuluyo agud makabulig depensa sa iya pungsod.
english: Second, a citizen does not have to be a soldier to help defend his country.

text: Mahimo niya ina sa mga bagay kon diin siya angayan kag kon diin siya nalipay.
english: He can do that in things where he is suitable and where he is happy.

text: Mas ginakilala pa gani ang pagka-baganihan sang indi hangaway, katulad ni Dr. Jose Rizal, Graciano Lopez-Jaena, Marcelo del Pilar kag Apolinario Mabini nga mga manunulat kag “intellectual”.
english: The heroism of non-combatants, such as Dr. Jose Rizal, Graciano Lopez-Jaena, Marcelo del Pilar and Apolinario Mabini were writers and “intellectuals”.

text: Ikatatlo, ang gyera subong indi man padamo-damo sing hangaway.
english: Third, today's war is not about increasing the number of soldiers.

text: Sa karon nga modern warfare mas masaligan pa ang galamiton sa gyera.
english: In today's modern warfare, the tool of war is more reliable.

text: Ang epektibo nga hinganiban katumbas na gani sang linibo nga kaaway.
english: An effective weapon is even equivalent to thousands of enemies.

text: Nagyaub ang Japan sa duha lang ka atomic bomb sa Hiroshima kag Nagsaki.
english: Japan bowed to only two atomic bombs in Hiroshima and Nagsaki.

text: Tutok na lang kita sa mga highly-trained nga mga soldado nga sagad sa paggamit sang epektibo nga mga hinganiban.
english: Let's just focus on highly-trained soldiers who are used to using effective weapons.

text: Dugangan man naton ang pag-empleyo sang mga skilled workers sa pabrika sang aton mga defensive weaponry.
english: We will also increase the employment of skilled workers in the factory of our defensive weaponry.

text: Mag-producir man kita sang masaligan nga mga scientist kag mga imbentor sang sining mga defensive nga mga armas.
english: We will also produce reliable scientists and inventors of these defensive weapons.

text: Ikaapat, paangay-angay ang huyog sang tawo.
english: Fourth, adjust human tendencies.

text: Kon indi angayan indi pag-ipilit kay indi mo na siya mapuslan sing husto.
english: If it's not appropriate, don't force it because you won't be able to use it properly.

text: Ako ya indi angayan mag-soldado ukon bisan pulis lang.
english: I'm not fit to be a soldier or even a policeman.

text: Mas mapuslan ako sa pag-apin sa aton pungsod paagi sa pagsulat kag pag-amot sang akon panghuna-huna bilang isa ka “intellectual”, sunu sa pila ka abyan.
english: I am more useful in defending our country by writing and contributing my thoughts as an “intellectual”, according to some friends.

text: Ti, ngaa kinahanglan ko pa ang ROTC?
english: Well, why do I need ROTC?

text: Kon nakaagi ako ROTC sadto, ina lang kay kinahanglan ko ini sa pag-gradwet.
english: If I went through ROTC back then, it was only because I needed it to graduate.
