english: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)

text: Nakahanda si Vice President Sara Duterte nga magpaidalom sa neuropsychological test.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte is ready to undergo a neuropsychological test.

text: Ini ang sa tunga sang mga nabaton sini nga pagpakamalaot kag nagatawag sa iya nga “mentally unstable” ukon wala sa iya insakto nga paminsaron.
english: This is among those who received this condemnation and called him “mentally unstable” or not in his right mind.

text: “𝗪𝗮𝗹𝗮 𝗮𝗸𝗼𝗻𝗴 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗯𝗹𝗲𝗺𝗮 𝗱𝗼𝗼𝗻.
english: “Suffering 𝗮𝗸𝗼𝗻𝗴 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗯𝗲𝗺𝗮 𝗱𝗼𝗼𝗻.

text: 𝗚𝗮𝗺𝗲 𝘁𝗮𝘆𝗼.” pahayag ni Duterte.
english: 𝗚𝗮𝗺𝗲 𝘁𝗮𝘆𝗼.” Duterte's statement.

text: Apang suno kay Duterte, himuon lang niya ini kun ang tanan nga mga kongresista sa nga magapadalagan sa 2025 midterm elections ang magapaidalom man sa drug tests.
english: However, Duterte said he will only do so if all congressmen running in the 2025 midterm elections also undergo drug tests.

text: “𝗔𝘀 𝗮 𝘃𝗼𝘁𝗲𝗿, 𝗜 𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗱 [𝗻𝗮] 𝗺𝗮𝗴𝗽𝗮-𝗱𝗿𝘂𝗴 𝘁𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘀𝗶𝗹𝗮 [𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗴𝗿𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀].
english: “A 𝗔𝘀 𝘃𝗼𝘁𝗲𝗿, 𝗜 𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗱 [𝗻𝗮] 𝗺𝗮𝗴𝗽-𝗮𝗿𝗿𝗴 𝘁𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘀𝗶𝗹𝗮 [𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗴𝗿𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀].

text:
𝗞𝗮𝘆𝗼𝗻𝗴 𝗹𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗺𝗴𝗮 𝗸𝗮𝗯𝗮𝗯𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗻, 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗻𝗮 𝗺𝗮𝗴-𝗱𝗿𝘂𝗴 𝘁𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗴𝗮 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗴𝗿𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗱𝗮𝗵𝗶𝗹 𝗸𝘂𝗻𝗴 𝘂𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗮𝗸𝗼, 𝘀𝗮 𝗽𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻 𝗸𝗼, 𝘂𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗿𝗶𝗻 𝘀𝗶𝗹𝗮.”

Nagpanawagan man si Duterte sa Philippine Medical Association nga mag-set sang guidelines para sa tests, apang nagakadapat nga patigayunon ini sang isa ka independent third party pinaagi sa hair follicle testing.
english:
𝗞𝗮𝘆𝗼𝗻𝗴 𝗹𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗺𝗴𝗮 𝗸𝗮𝗯𝗮𝗯𝗮𝘆𝗯𝗻, 𝗮𝗼𝗼 𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗻𝗮 𝗺𝗮𝗴-𝗱𝗿𝘂𝗴 𝘁𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗴𝗴𝗴 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗴𝗿𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗱𝗮𝗮𝗲 𝗱𝗵𝗶𝗶 𝗸𝘂𝗻𝗴 𝘂𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗮𝗸𝗼, 𝘀𝗮 𝗽𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗻𝗴, 𝘂𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗿𝗶𝗻 𝘀𝗶𝗹𝗮.”

Duterte also called on the Philippine Medical Association to set guidelines for the tests, but it should be conducted by an independent third party through hair follicle testing.

text: Ang kritisismo nga nabaton ni Duterte ang kasunod man sang ginpatigayon sini nga press conference sang Oktubre 18 sa diin lunsay pagpakamalaot ang iya ginhimo batok kay President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: The criticism received by Duterte also follows his press conference on October 18 where he condemned President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: Makapila ka beses nga ginradyuhan sang People’s Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) sang China ang aircraft sang Philippine Coast Guard samtang nga yara ini sa Bajo de Masinloc.
english: China's People's Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) radioed the Philippine Coast Guard aircraft several times while it was in Bajo de Masinloc.

text: Ang Bajo de Masinloc nga kilala man bilang Scarborough Shoal ukon Panatag Shoal ang nahamtang 124 nautical miles halin sa Masinloc, Zambales.
english: Bajo de Masinloc also known as Scarborough Shoal or Panatag Shoal is located 124 nautical miles from Masinloc, Zambales.

text: Sulod ini sa 200-nautical-mile exclusive economic zone sang Pilipinas sandig sa nakabutang sa United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS).
english: It is within the 200-nautical-mile exclusive economic zone of the Philippines as stipulated in the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS).

text: Suno sa PCG, sang amo nga tion, naga-conduct ang aircraft sang kinaandan nga Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA) flight.
english: According to the PCG, at the time, the aircraft was conducting a routine Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA) flight.

text: Sa amo nga flight, na-detect ang indi awtorisado nga presensya sang maritime forces sang China sa teritoryo sang Pilipinas.
english: During the flight, the unauthorized presence of Chinese maritime forces in Philippine territory was detected.

text: Lakip diri ang duha ka barko sang China Coast Guard kag duha ka warships sa idalom sang People’s Liberation Army Navy.
english: These include two ships of the China Coast Guard and two warships under the People's Liberation Army Navy.

text: May yara man sang lima kag mga barko nga ginapatihan nga Chinese maritime militia nga malapit man sa Bajo de Masinloc.
english: There are also five ships believed to be Chinese maritime militia near Bajo de Masinloc.

text: Sang nagradyo sila sa Philippine aircraft, nagbalos naman ang aircrew kag nagpaathag nga ang ila ginahimo ang nagasunod sa UNCLOS, 2016 Arbitral Award, kag Philippine Maritime Zones Act.
english: When they radioed the Philippine aircraft, the aircrew retaliated and explained that their actions were in compliance with UNCLOS, the 2016 Arbitral Award, and the Philippine Maritime Zones Act.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginahimo ang aerial patrol para nga ma-monitor kag maproteksyunan ang Filipino fishermen kag ang marine resources, kag malantaw man ang illegal nga presensya sang Chinese maritime forces sa West Philippine Sea.
english: The aerial patrol is being conducted to monitor and protect Filipino fishermen and marine resources, as well as to monitor the illegal presence of Chinese maritime forces in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Off the market na ang Filipino basketball star nga si Kiefer Ravena matapos gin-anunsyo ang iya engagement sa beauty queen nga si Diana Mackey.
english: Filipino basketball star Kiefer Ravena is off the market after announcing his engagement to beauty queen Diana Mackey.

text: Ginpaagi ini sang 31-anyos nga former Gilas Pilipinas captain sa isa ka Instagram post nga may caption “An October to remember” kun sa diin ginlakip ang siyam ka assorted photos sang sceneries, self-portraits, iya iloy nga si Mozzy, kag ang picture nila ni Mackey nga may suksok nga engagement ring.
english: The 31-year-old former Gilas Pilipinas captain made the announcement in an Instagram post captioned “An October to remember” which included nine assorted photos of sceneries, self-portraits, his mother Mozzy, and a picture of him and Mackey wearing an engagement ring.

text: Gilayon nga nagbubo ang panginbulahan halin sa kaangay ni Kiefer nga mga atleta lakip sanday former Ateneo stars Dave Ildefonso kag Vanie Gandler kag kaangay sini nga Japan B. League veteran import nga si Ray Parks, Jr.
english: Congratulations immediately poured in from fellow athletes like Kiefer including former Ateneo stars Dave Ildefonso and Vanie Gandler and fellow Japan B. League veteran import Ray Parks, Jr.

text: Sunod sini nga ginkumpirma ang development sa iya masunod nga Instagram stories nga nagapakita sang snapshots ni Mackey nga nagapakita sang iya tudlo nga may diamond ring samtang naga-video call.
english: She subsequently confirmed the development in her subsequent Instagram stories showing snapshots of Mackey showing off her diamond ring finger while on a video call.

text: Si Diana, 26, isa anay ka flight attendant, kag kilala sa iya stint sa Binibining Pilipinas kag nakadangat sa top 12 sang gintiglawas sini ang Nueva Ecija sa 2022 edition.
english: Diana, 26, is a former flight attendant, and is best known for her stint with Binibining Pilipinas and reached the top 12 when she represented Nueva Ecija in the 2022 edition.

text: Naka-intra man siya sa Pinoy Big Brother kun sa diin nagpanglima siya sa PBB 8 – Part 4: Adult Edition.
english: He also participated in Pinoy Big Brother where he placed fifth in PBB 8 – Part 4: Adult Edition.

text: Naka-sentro naman ang karera ni Ravena sa Yokohama B-Corsairs bilang isa ka Asian import sa Japan B.League.
english: Ravena's career is centered on Yokohama B-Corsairs as an Asian import in the Japan B.League.

text: Nahibaluan nga apat ka adlaw antes ginsapubliko ang ila engagement, gin-“hard launch” ni Mackey ang ila relasyon sa labing-una nga tion sa amo man nga social media platform kag gintawag ang Ilonggo basketball star nga “biggest plot twist” sang iya 2024.
english: Four days before their engagement was made public, Mackey “hard launched” their relationship for the first time on the same social media platform and called the Ilonggo basketball star the “biggest plot twist” of his 2024.

text: Naghimo sang record ang Dinagyang Festival 2026 matapos nanghatag ini sang masobra sa P21-M nga kabilugan nga balor sang papremyo sa mga tribu sang Dinagyang tribes competition nga ginakabig pinakadako nga total prize sa kasaysayan sang festival.
english: The Dinagyang Festival 2026 set a record after it awarded more than P21-M in total prizes to the tribes of the Dinagyang tribes competition, which is considered the largest total prize in the history of the festival.

text: P11.5 million ang nabaton sang Tribu Salognon sang Jaro National High School nga kampeon sa nasambit nga kompetisyon.
english: P11.5 million was received by Tribu Salognon of Jaro National High School, the champion of the competition.

text: Sa nasambit nga premyo, P1.5 million ang cash kag ang P10 million amo ang balor sang infrastructure projects halin sa city government.
english: Of the said prize, P1.5 million is cash and P10 million is the value of infrastructure projects from the city government.

text: One million cash prize naman kag three million worth of infrastructure project ang nabaton sang first runner-up nga Tribu Paghidaet sang La Paz National High School.
english: One million cash prize and three million worth of infrastructure project went to the first runner-up Tribu Paghidaet of La Paz National High School.

text: Cash prize nga P700,000 kag two million worth of infrastructure project ang ginhatag sa second runner-up nga Tribu Pan-ay sang Fort San Pedro National High School.
english: Cash prize of P700,000 and two million worth of infrastructure project was awarded to second runner-up Tribu Pan-ay of Fort San Pedro National High School.

text: P600,000 cash prize kag one million worth of infrastructure project ang ginbaton sang third runner-up nga Tribu Taga-Baryo sang Brgy.
english: P600,000 cash prize and one million worth of infrastructure project were received by the third runner-up Tribu Taga-Baryo of Brgy.

text: Bo.
english: Them.

text: Obrero, Lapuz.
english: Obrero, Lapuz.

text: Cash nga P500, 000 kag dugang nga P500,000 nga balor sang infrastructure project ang ginbaton kada isa sang tatlo pa nga mga tribu nga nagpasakop.
english: Cash of P500,000 and an additional P500,000 worth of infrastructure project were received by each of the three other participating tribes.

text: Ginakabig naman ni Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas nga ang tuig nga ini amo ang most successful Dinagyang festival.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas considers this year to be the most successful Dinagyang festival.

text: Gin-hostage sang duwa ka oras sang isa ka hubog nga anak ang iya kaugalingon nga iloy sa ila balay sa Barangay Highway Hills, Mandaluyong City.
english: A drunk son held his own mother hostage for two hours at their house in Barangay Highway Hills, Mandaluyong City.

text: Ang biktima nagaedad sang 80-anyos samtang ang suspek ang nagaedad sang 53-anyos.
english: The victim is 80 years old while the suspect is 53 years old.

text: Nakapangayo sang bulig ang tigulang matapos nakatamwa ini sa bintana.
english: The elderly man called for help after he looked out the window.

text: Didto na kag nakaresponde ang Special Weapons and Actions Team (SWAT) sang Mandaluyong City Police kun sa diin halos isa ka oras ang negosasyon antes nasulod sang operatiba ang balay.
english: The Special Weapons and Actions Team (SWAT) of Mandaluyong City Police responded and negotiated for almost an hour before the operatives entered the house.

text: Natigayon naman nga maaresto ang suspek kun sa diin narekober man ang isa ka pusil.
english: The suspect was arrested and a firearm was recovered.

text: Ginpaidalom naman sa medical examination ang iloy.
english: The mother was subjected to a medical examination.

text: Sampaw-sampaw nga kaso ang posible atubangon sang suspek.
english: The suspect is likely to face multiple charges.

text: Nasawi ang 68 migrante mula sa Africa habang 74 iba pa ang nawawala matapos tumaob ang kanilang sinasakyang bangka malapit sa Yemen.
english: Sixty-eight migrants from Africa were stranded while 74 others are missing after their boat capsized near Yemen.

text: Patay sang 68 ka mga migrante halin sa Africa samtang 74 kag iban pa ang missing matapos nagkulob ang ila ginasakyan nga bangka malapit sa Yemen.
english: Sixty-eight migrants from Africa have died while 74 others are missing after their boat capsized near Yemen.

text: Ginkumpirma ni Internationa Organization for Migration head sa Yemen nga si Abdusatoor Esoev nga may sakay nga 154 ka mga Ethiopian migrants ang amo nga vessel nga nagkulob sa may Gulf of Aden malapit sa southern province sang Abyan sa Yemen.
english: International Organization for Migration head in Yemen Abdusatoor Esoev confirmed that the vessel was carrying 154 Ethiopian migrants that capsized in the Gulf of Aden near the southern province of Abyan in Yemen.

text: Ang lawas sang 54 ka mga migrante ang naanod sa mga pampang sa distrito sang Khanfar samtang ang 14 kag iban ang nasapwan nga wala na sang kabuhi kag gindala sa morgue sa Zinjibar.
english: The bodies of 54 migrants washed up on beaches in Khanfar district while 14 others were found lifeless and taken to a morgue in Zinjibar.

text: Base sa report, 12 ka mga migrante lamang ang buhi sa nagluntad nga insidente samtang ang mga bangkay naman sang mga nagkaladula kag ginapatihan nga patay na.
english: According to the report, only 12 migrants are alive in the incident while the bodies of those who are missing are believed to be dead.

text: Naglunsyar naman sang search and rescue operation sa mga dako nga numero sang mga napatay kag nagkaladula nga mga migrante.
english: A search and rescue operation was launched for the large number of dead and missing migrants.

text: SA ISA KA interbyu sang media sadtong nagligad lang nga adlaw, si P/Brig.
english: IN A media interview just the other day, P/Brig.

text: General John Bulalacao nagpahibalo nga nakabaton siya sang text sang pagpamakal boto sa mga banwa sang Igbaras kag Miag-ao sa Iloilo.
english: General John Bulalacao announced that he received a text of vote buying in the towns of Igbaras and Miag-ao in Iloilo.

text: Gin-mensyonar pa gani niya ang ngalan nga Biron-Garin, sunu sa texter.
english: He even mentioned the name Biron-Garin, according to the texter.

text: Wala ugaling niya ginhatag ang lubos nga mga ngalan sining duha.
english: However, he did not give the full names of the two.

text: Gani, basi ginadala lang ang ngalan sining duha sang kon sin-o nga nagapatigayon sining aktibidad.
english: So, maybe the names of these two are just being brought up by whoever is conducting this activity.

text: Kon naangot gid man ang ila ngalan, ina tungod kay may mga nagasugid nga may nagapanagtag sing mga balde sang grocery, mga notebook kag mga school bag sa pila ka miting ni Cong.
english: If their names are indeed linked, it is because there are reports that someone distributed buckets of groceries, notebooks and school bags at some meetings of Cong.

text: Ferjenel  Biron.
english: Ferjenel  Biron.

text: Kon husto ang pagpamati naton mismo sa isa niya ka tagpamaba, may ara gid man kuno nga pagpanghatag sining mga bagay sa mga miting ni Congresman Biron.
english: If we listen to one of his spokesmen correctly, there is indeed a distribution of these items in Congressman Biron's meetings.

text: Indi ugaling kuno baylo sa pagboto sa iya kundi dala lang sang iya kaalwan.
english: However, it was not in exchange for voting for him but because of his kindness.

text: Si Congressman Biron kasumpong ni Congressman Toto Defensor sa pagka-gobernador sa Iloilo.
english: Congressman Biron is running against Congressman Toto Defensor for governor of Iloilo.

text: Wala sing kasubong nga huring-huring man lang nga nakaabot sa aton nga nagapanghatag si Congressman Toto Defensor sang sining mga bagay.
english: There is no such rumor that has reached us that Congressman Toto Defensor is distributing these things.

text: Ang ginapasalig lang ni Toto Defensor amo ang daku nga kaayuhan nga nadala sang amay niya nga si Gob.
english: Toto Defensor is only assured of the great benefits brought by his father, Gob.

text: Art Defensor Sr.
english: Art Defensor Sr.

text: nga luyag niya sundon, kag ang limpyo nga ngalan nila nga duha.
english: that he wanted to follow, and the clean name of both of them.

text: Ang PRO-6 regional director nagpanugyan sa publiko nga agud maseguro gid, dapat kuhaan sing retrato ang ining mga buhat para mapresentar bilang ebidensya.
english: The PRO-6 regional director advised the public that to be sure, these acts should be photographed to be presented as evidence.

text: Isa ka radio station gani ang nag-report nga madamo na nga mga retrato angot sini ang ila nabaton, kag tani matindugan ini nga ebidensya sang testigo agud madakpan ining nagahimo sini kag mapasakaan kaso.
english: A radio station even reported that they have received many photographs of the incident, and hopefully this will be used as evidence by the witness to arrest the perpetrator and prosecute him.

text: Pero, may mangisug ayhan nga mag-presentar sang ila kaugalingon agud magpasaka sang kaso sa mga natungdan nga dala ang ebidensya sining retrato?
english: But, will anyone dare to present themselves to file a case against the concerned with the evidence of this photo?

text: Kag mangisug man bala siya agud mag-testigo?
english: And will he be brave enough to testify?

text: Wala kapuslan ang ining akusasyon kon wala sing magtindug agud ipahayag ining iya nakit-an nga pagpanghatag sining mga bagay.
english: This accusation is useless if no one stands up to declare this distribution of these things.

text: Tani, may ara, agud matagaan sing leksyon ining tagbuhat ukon mga tagbuhat agud mapabakud pa gid ang aton kawsa para sa “clean and honest election”.
english: Hopefully, there will be, to teach this perpetrator or perpetrators a lesson to further strengthen our cause for a “clean and honest election”.

text:
***

Sunu sa Omnibus Election Code, vote-buying, pati na ang vote-selling, mga election offenses ini.
english:
***

According to the Omnibus Election Code, vote-buying, as well as vote-selling, are election offenses.

text: Ang madakpan kag mapamatud-an maga-sufrir sang pagkabilanggo sa sulod sang 1 tubtub 6 ka tuig, disqualification sa pag-hold public office, kag ang indi pagtugot sini nga makaboto liwat.
english: Those caught and convicted will suffer imprisonment for 1 to 6 years, disqualification from holding public office, and not being allowed to vote again.

text: Makasala sing vote-buying ang isa ka tawo kon nagahatag (gives), nagatanyag (offers), ukon may pangako (promises) sing kwarta (money) ukon ano man nga may balor (value) agud mahikayat (induce) ang isa ka tawo agud magboto pabor ukon kontra sa isa ka kandidato ukon punggan (withhold) ang iya boto sa tion sang eleksyon, sunu sa sining Omnibus Election Code.
english: A person is guilty of vote-buying if he or she gives, offers, or promises money or anything of value to induce a person to vote for or against a candidate or withhold his or her vote during an election, according to the Elections Code.

text: Ang vote-buying nagalakip sang paghatag, pagtanyag ukon pagpangako sang kwarta; trabaho; promotion; food, groceries, gadgets, livestock, water and electricity services, franchise ukon grant, infrastructure projects, scholarships, political, financial and other forms of favor (among others).
english: Vote-buying involves giving, offering or promising money; employment; promotion; food, groceries, gadgets, livestock, water and electricity services, franchise or grant, infrastructure projects, scholarships, political, financial and other forms of favor (among others).

text: Sunu gani kay Comelec spokesperson James Jimenez, ang vote-buying magalakip man sang vouchers, katulad sang voucher para sa isa ka hospital confinement, nga wala na pulos kon malutos ang kandidato.
english: According to Comelec spokesperson James Jimenez, vote-buying will also include vouchers, such as a voucher for a hospital confinement, which is useless if the candidate loses.

text: Lakip man sa vote-buying ang pangako nga ilakip ang isa ka botante sa Conditional Cash Transfer (CCT program), ukon ang 4Ps, kon magdaug ang kandidato.
english: Vote-buying also includes the promise to include a voter in the Conditional Cash Transfer (CCT program), or the 4Ps, if the candidate wins.

text: Tungod ugaling wala sing mag-aku nga kandidato kag ang gintagaan sang ano man nga pabor, importante nga makapakita ang naga-akusar sing mabakud gid nga ebidensya, nga kon mahimo lang isa ini ka eye-witness account.
english: Since, however, neither the candidate nor the beneficiary can claim any favor, it is important that the accuser can show very strong evidence, preferably an eye-witness account.

text: ILOILO CITY – Ikaw bala ang kalaslon na?
english: ILOILO CITY – Are you the bride?

text: Ano ang imo nga dream wedding venue?
english: What is your dream wedding venue?

text: Ari, basi gusto mo ini.
english: Here, you might like it.

text: Nakabati ka na sang space wedding?
english: Ever heard of a space wedding?

text:
Sa Florida, isa ka space travel company ang naga-offer sang chance para sa mga magkahagugma nga magpatigayong sang grand wedding sa punta sang space- “above 99% sang Earth’s atmosphere.”

Suno sa website sang Space Perspective, ang mga bisita ang maga-enjoy sa “quintessential astronaut experience” sa sulod sang duha ka oras agud nga makita ang curve sang kalibutan, ang iya total blackness, kag ang kahawa-an.
english:
In Florida, a space travel company is offering a chance for couples to have a grand wedding at the edge of space- “above 99% of Earth’s atmosphere.”

According to Space Perspective’s website, visitors will enjoy the “quintessential astronaut experience” for two hours to be able to see the curve of the earth, its total blackness, and the void.

text: Sa baylo nga rocket, magagamit ini sang Spaceship Neptune nga isa ka pressurized capsule powered by a “SpaceBalloon” nga mahinay nga nagasaka kag matalunsay.
english: Instead of a rocket, it will use the Spaceship Neptune which is a pressurized capsule powered by a “SpaceBalloon” that rises gently and smoothly.

text: Ang period sang pagpasaka kag pagpanaog ang nagadangat sa anum ka oras, gani, may enought time gid kamo sang inyo partner nga magbayluhanay sang “I do’s” kag mag-celebrate sang okasyon upod ang inyo pinalangga sa kabuhi sa Space Lounge.
english: The period of ascent and descent is six hours, so, you and your partner will have enough time to exchange “I do’s” and celebrate the occasion with your loved one in the Space Lounge.

text: Of course, indi ini libre.
english: Of course, it’s not free.

text: Ini ang nagabalor sang $125,000 ukon masobra sa P7 million sa kada isa.
english: These are worth $125,000 or more than P7 million each.

text: Ang Space Perspective ang ginalauman nga magabukas officially sa 2024.
english: Space Perspective is expected to open officially in 2024.

text: Kun ini ang gusto mo nga mangin wedding venue, mag-amat-amat na supot subong nga yara ka pa lang sa stage nga nagahibi sa sala nga tawo.
english: If this is the wedding venue you want to be, slow down now that you're still on stage crying for the wrong person.

text: Indi mahimo maggamit sang mga kandidato sa 2025 elections ang short-form video platform nga TikTok para sa ila pagpangampanya.
english: Candidates in the 2025 elections cannot use the short-form video platform TikTok for their campaigning.

text: Suno kay Tiktok Philippines public policy manager Peachy Paderna, indi nila pag-ipaguwa ini nga political advertisements bangud ang ila mayor nga tuyo indi amo nga tungaon ang mga tawo kundi i-promote ang environment nga naga-isa ang mga tawo paagi sa positibo nga mga dayalogo.
english: According to Tiktok Philippines public policy manager Peachy Paderna, they will not release these political advertisements because their main purpose is not to divide people but to promote an environment that unites people through positive dialogues.

text: Nagtambong kahapon, Oktubre 21, ang mga tiglawas sang amo nga social media platform sa ceremonial signing sang pledge of support sang technology companies sa Commission on Elections (Comelec).
english: Representatives of the social media platform attended yesterday, October 21, the ceremonial signing of the pledge of support of technology companies to the Commission on Elections (Comelec).

text: Gin-abi-abi naman sang poll body ini nga tikang bangud nabuhinan ang ila iga-monitor nga social media platform sa tion na sang campaign period.
english: The poll body welcomed the move as it reduced the number of social media platforms they will monitor during the campaign period.

text: Sa bahin sang Google, ginsiling man sini nga dumilian man nila ang paid political advertisements sa ila platform.
english: For its part, Google has also said that it will also ban paid political advertisements on its platform.

text: Apang sa Meta nga amo ang parent company sang Facebook kag Instagram, ginsiling nga tugutan sini ang advertisements agud nga ma-promote ang transparency kag hatagan sang patas nga oportunidad ang tanan nga mga kandidato.
english: However, Meta, the parent company of Facebook and Instagram, said it would allow advertisements in order to promote transparency and give equal opportunities to all candidates.

text: Dugang sang Meta, ginatapna man nila ang troll accounts sa ila platforms paagi sa pag-implementar sang mga tikang kag nagapartner man sa nagkalain-lain nga stakeholders.
english: Meta added that they are also preventing troll accounts on their platforms by implementing measures and also partnering with various stakeholders.

text: Sa second quarter pa lamang sang 2024, may yara na sang at least 1.2-billion nga peke nga accounts sa bilog nga kalibutan nga nakarehistro sa Meta.
english: As early as the second quarter of 2024, there will be at least 1.2-billion fake accounts worldwide registered with Meta.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa idalom sang pagsulundan sang Comelec, gina-require ang mga kandidato nga magparehistro sang ila social media accounts kag ginahingyo man nga mag-isyu sang disclosure sa tanan nga election and campaign paraphernalia nga nahimo paagi sa artificial intelligence.#
english: Under the Comelec's guidelines, candidates are required to register their social media accounts and are also required to issue disclosure on all election and campaign paraphernalia made through artificial intelligence.

text: ILOILO CITY- Untatan sang Western Visayas Medical Center sub-national laboratory ang pagbaton sang mga specimen sa sulod sang tatlo ka adlaw.
english: ILOILO CITY- The Western Visayas Medical Center sub-national laboratory will stop accepting specimens for three days.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Dr. Marie Jocelyn Te, Medical Coordinator sang Emerging and Re-emerging Infectious Diseases sang Department of Health 6, iya ginpahayag nga mismo si Dr. Stephanie Abello, chief pathologist sang Western Visayas Medical Center sub-national laboratory ang naghingyo sini agud matatapan ang mga backlogs sa COVID-19 testing.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Dr. Marie Jocelyn Te, Medical Coordinator of Emerging and Re-emerging Infectious Diseases of the Department of Health 6, she said that Dr. Stephanie Abello, chief pathologist of the Western Visayas Medical Center sub-national laboratory, requested this to address the backlogs in COVID-19 testing.

text: Suno kay Dr. Te, sa tion nga maaprubahan, magasugod ang indi pagbaton sang specimen sa Hulyo 17,Byernes tubtob Hulyo 18,Domingo.
english: According to Dr. Well, once approved, the specimen will not be accepted from July 17, Friday to July 18, Sunday.

text: Apang gin-athag ni Te nga sa sulod sang tatlo ka adlaw, mahimo naman nga i-reroute sa iban nga testing laboratory sa rehiyon 6 nga amo ang masunod: Teresita Lopez Jalandoni Provincial Hospital Molecular Laboratory sa Silay City, Negros Occidental; Corazon Locsin Montelibano Memorial Regional Hospital (CLMMRH) sa Bacolod City; kag Qualimed Hospital sa Iloilo City.
english: However, Te explained that within three days, they can be rerouted to other testing laboratories in Region 6 as follows: Teresita Lopez Jalandoni Provincial Hospital Molecular Laboratory in Silay City, Negros Occidental; Corazon Locsin Montelibano Memorial Regional Hospital (CLMMRH) in Bacolod City; and Qualimed Hospital in Iloilo City.

text: May kaangtanan naman sa tatlo ka mga RT-PCR machines sa Western Visayas Medical Center sub-national laboratory nga wala ginagamit bangud indi compatible sa test kits, ginpahayag ni Te nga gina-fast track na ang pag-purchase sang mga test kits nga compatible sa mga machines agud mapadasig ang pagprosesos sang mga specimen kag malikawan ang backlogs.
english: Regarding the three RT-PCR machines at the Western Visayas Medical Center sub-national laboratory that are not being used because they are not compatible with the test kits, Te said the purchase of test kits compatible with the machines is being fast tracked to speed up the processing of specimens and avoid backlogs.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa 5000 ka mga backlogs, may nabilin pa nga masobra sa 2,000 ka mga specimen ang wala pa napaidalom sa test.
english: Of the 5,000 backlogs, there are still more than 2,000 specimens that have not been tested.

text: PAVIA,ILOILO- Gindula sang Local Government Unit sang Pavia, Iloilo ang kahangawa sang dugang nga transmission sang Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) kasunod sang pagpositibo sang 14 ka mga Locally Stranded Individuals sa nasambit nga banwa.
english: PAVIA, ILOILO- The Local Government Unit of Pavia, Iloilo has dispelled the concern of further transmission of Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) following the positivity of 14 Locally Stranded Individuals in the said town.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Pavia Mayor Luigi Gorriceta, iya ginpahayag nga ang 14 ka mga nagpositibo sa COVID-19 ang kabahin sang duha ka batches sang Locally Stranded Individuals nga nag-abot sang Hunyo 26 kag 27 gikan sa Metro Manila.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Pavia Mayor Luigi Gorriceta said the 14 COVID-19 positives were part of two batches of Locally Stranded Individuals who arrived on June 26 and 27 from Metro Manila.

text: Suno kay Gorriceta, pag-abot sa Iloilo, gindiretso sa quarantine facility ang mga Locally Stranded Individuals kag wala na nakasimpon sa iban nga tawo gani wala naman ginkinahanglan pa ang pagpatigayon sang contact tracing.
english: According to Gorriceta, upon arrival in Iloilo, the Locally Stranded Individuals were directed to the quarantine facility and were not in contact with other people so there was no need to conduct contact tracing.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang nasambit nga 14 ka mga pasyente ang nalakip sa 91 ka kaso nga nagdugang sa Western Visayas base sa COVID-19 case bulletin No.
english: The 14 patients are among the 91 new cases in Western Visayas based on COVID-19 case bulletin No.

text: 108 nga ginpagwa kahapon, Hulyo 12.
english: 108 issued yesterday, July 12.

text: ILOILO CITY – Atensyon sa mga may boyfriends ukon girlfriends dira.
english: ILOILO CITY – Attention to those who have boyfriends or girlfriends here.

text: Sa mga wala, magbasa lang kay basi may madumduman ka!
english: For those who don't, just read on because you might remember something!

text: Ano ang sarang mo nga mahimo para sa tawo nga palangga mo?
english: What can you do for the person you love?

text: Kun ikaw ang ginatunto, i-tolerate mo ini ayhan agud lamang nga mapabilin ang inyo nga relasyon?
english: If you were being tempted, would you tolerate it just to keep your relationship?

text: Sa Venezuela, isa ka babayi ang yara sa hot seat subong matapos gin-anunsiyo sa iya social media account nga nagpakig-abyan ini sa other woman sang iya nga nobyo kag nagpasugot pa ini nga makig-share sa iya.
english: In Venezuela, a woman is now in the hot seat after it was announced on her social media account that she was friends with her boyfriend's other woman and she agreed to share with him.

text: Suno kay Sofía Gutiérrez nagikan sa Lecheria, Venezuela, natukiban niya ang pagpanglu-ib sang iya nobyo sang gin-check niya ang messages sini.
english: According to Sofía Gutiérrez from Lecheria, Venezuela, she discovered her boyfriend's infidelity when she checked his messages.

text: Sa baylo nga kumprontahun, nagdesisyon ini nga makig-angut sa secret lover sang iya nobyo.
english: Instead of confronting her, she decided to contact her boyfriend's secret lover.

text: Ang resulta, nangin mag-abyan na sila sang babayi nga ginkilala kay Sarahy Gill.
english: As a result, she became friends with the woman identified as Sarahy Gill.

text: Suno pa kay Sofia, nabaton na niya nga ang iya nobyo ang ginapanag-iyahan man ni Sarahy nga yara lang sa tion nga kinahanglan ini sang iya boyfriend.
english: According to Sofia, she has accepted that her boyfriend is also owned by Sarahy who is only there when her boyfriend needs him.

text: Matapos naglapta ang amo nga social media post, may yara sang nagkomento nga ang nobyo sang duha ang pinakamaswerte sa bilog nga kalibutan samtang ang iban ang may negatibo nga komento.
english: After the social media post spread, some commented that the boyfriend of the two is the luckiest in the world while others had negative comments.

text: Nag walk out si US President Donald Trump sa Senado pagkatapos nga gin-akusahan ang US Senate Minority Leader nga si Chuck Schumer sang “political extortion” kag nagsiling nga “GO TO HELL” sa isa ka post sa Truth Social.
english: US President Donald Trump walked out of the Senate after accusing US Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer of “political extortion” and saying “GO TO HELL” in a post on Truth Social.

text: Gintawag ni Trump nga “egregious and unprecedented”, ang pangabay ni schumer, suno sa iya nagapanawagan para sa pagpaguwa sang mga pundo sang gobyerno kag mga garantiya batuk sa dugang nga pagbuhin sa mga pundo sang gobyerno.
english: Trump called Schumer’s request “egregious and unprecedented”, saying he called for the release of federal funds and guarantees against further cuts to federal funds.

text: Ini ang nagtulod sa kasugtanan nga malab-ot, lakip ang pag-aprubar sang nominasyon ni Trump, subong man ang 60 ka mga gintangdo nga may suporta sang duha ka partido.
english: This pushed the agreement to be reached, including the approval of Trump’s nomination, as well as 60 appointees with bipartisan support.

text: Ang kasugtanan nagalakip man sang mga ginapangayo sang mga Democrats, pareho sang pagdula sang mga freeze sa National Institutes of Health (NIH) kag foreign aid funding.
english: The deal also includes Democrats’ demands, such as lifting freezes on the National Institutes of Health (NIH) and foreign aid funding.

text: Apang ginpanginwala ini ni Trump, kag gin-akusahan si Schumer nga nagapangayo sang masobra isa ka bilyon ka dolyar kabaylo sang minimal nga nominasyon.
english: But Trump has denied that, and accused Schumer of demanding more than a billion dollars in exchange for a minimal nomination.

text: Gintawag niya ini nga “political extortion,” nga suno sa iya mangin makahuluya para sa iya partido sa Republicans kon batunon ang nominasyon.
english: He called it “political extortion,” which he said would be embarrassing for his party to the Republicans if the nomination were accepted.

text: Samtang, sa isa ka press conference, ginmulay ni Schumer si Trump sa madasig nga pag-untat sa kasugtanan, kag namangkot ang mamalidha kon bala amo ini ang iya ginasiling nga “Art of the Deal”?
english: Meanwhile, at a press conference, Schumer criticized Trump for quickly backing out of the deal, and the lawmaker asked if this was what he claimed was the “Art of the Deal”?

text: Pagkatapos sang insidente, ang Senado nagboto sa pito ka mga nominasyon antes mag-adjourn para sa recess, kag ginpaisol ang nabilin nga mga nominasyon tubtob sa Septyembre, 2025.
english: After the incident, the Senate voted on seven nominations before adjourning for recess, postponing the remaining nominations until September, 2025.

text: Gin-ako ni Vice President Sara Duterte nga may duha ini ka bagay nga ginhingyo kay President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte acknowledged that she has two requests from President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: antes ang ila tandem sa eleksyon.
english: before their electoral tandem.

text: Suno kay Duterte, duha lang ka bagay ang iya ginpangayo kay Marcos sa tion nga magdaog na ini bilang Presidente.
english: According to Duterte, he only asked Marcos for two things when he won as President.

text: Una amo nga makapungko ini bilang Defense Secretary kag ang ikaduha amo nga makapauli ini sa Davao City via air travel.
english: The first is that he can sit as Defense Secretary and the second is that he can return to Davao City via air travel.

text: Apang sang nagdaog na si Marcos, ginhimo sini si Duterte bilang Secretary sang Education.
english: But when Marcos won, he made Duterte Secretary of Education.

text: Samtang nabutang naman si Duterte sa kontrobersiya matapos ginapahayag nga gingamit sini ang presidential chopper agud magpauli sa Davao City.
english: Meanwhile, Duterte was embroiled in controversy after he allegedly used the presidential chopper to return to Davao City.

text: NAAPRUBAHAN na ang resolusyon nga naga-deklarar sang State of Calamity sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: A resolution declaring a State of Calamity in Iloilo City has been approved.

text: Partikular ini sa problema sang kakulang sang tubig sa pagsulod liwat sang El Niño Phenomenon diri sa siyudad sugod pa sadtong Abril nga amat-amat nagalala tubtub subong.
english: This is particularly the problem of water shortage with the re-entry of the El Niño Phenomenon here in the city since April which is gradually getting worse until now.

text: Gin-predict gani sang Pag-asa nga magaluntad ini sa sulod sang tatlo ka bulan tubtub sa Hunyo.
english: Pag-asa even predicted that it would last for three months until June.

text: Nagapuyo kita sa isa ka Demokrasya kag, syempre, normal lang ang pagbungguanay sang intereses sa panghimanwa agud matungkad gid ang kamatuoran.
english: We live in a Democracy and, of course, it is normal for civic interests to clash in order to get to the bottom of the truth.

text: Kag agud man malikawan ang ano man nga kalainan, hungod man ukon indi, para sa kaayuhan sang mga pumuluyo.
english: And also to avoid any evil, whether intentional or not, for the benefit of the people.

text: In fact, gina-kwestyon gani sang pihak nga kampo kon bala balido ang resolusyon nga naga-deklarar sang State of Calamity angot sa kakulangan sang tubig.
english: In fact, the other camp is even questioning the validity of the resolution declaring a State of Calamity regarding the water shortage.

text: Ugaling lang, naaprubahan na ang resolusyon kag napirmahan na ni meyor.
english: However, the resolution was approved and signed by the mayor.

text: Ang mahimo na lang sang pihak nga kampo amo ang seguruhon nga wala sing pinilian ang pagtatap sa kinahanglanon sang mga pumuluyo, kag kon paano amligan ang kwarta sang banwa.
english: All the other camp can do is ensure that the needs of the people are taken care of impartially, and how to protect the city's money.

text: Ina tungod indi na naton mapunggan ang pagpatuman sini sa karon.
english: That’s because we can’t stop its implementation right now.

text: Tungod man ini sa legal presumption of regularity sang akto sang mga opisyales sang gobyerno.
english: This is also due to the legal presumption of regularity of the acts of government officials.

text: Ang presumption of regularity nagasiling nga ang mga akto sang mga opisyales sa gobyerno ginakabig nga lawful (santu sa kasuguan) tubtub mapawala, kon mapawala gid man, sang korte.
english: The presumption of regularity states that the acts of government officials are considered lawful until overturned, if at all, by a court.

text:
***

Samtang, ginpahayag ni Councilor Love Baronda, sang mag-preside siya sa meeting sang City Disaster Risk and Management (CDRRM) Council, nga wala makalab-ut sa “calamity portion” ang halit sining kakulangan sang tubig.
english:
***

Meanwhile, Councilor Love Baronda, when she presided over the meeting of the City Disaster Risk and Management (CDRRM) Council, said that the damage of this water shortage did not reach the “calamity portion”.

text: Siling niya, apat lang ka barangay ang nagreklamo – isa lang ang nagpasar sang resolusyon nga naga-deklarar sang State of Calamity sa barangay, kag tatlo ang nangayo lang ayuda sang gobyerno sang siyudad.
english: He said only four barangays complained – only one passed a resolution declaring a State of Calamity in the barangay, and three only asked for assistance from the city government.

text: Sa report ugaling sang CRRDM, nga ginapangunahan ni Ms. Donna Magno, kag ni City Agriculturist Romulo Pangantihon, sadtong special session sang Sanggunian sang Biyernes, Abril 26, ginsugid nila nga nalab-ut na ang “calamity proportion” sang kahalitan sa pumuluyo.
english: However, in the report of the CRRDM, led by Ms. Donna Magno, and City Agriculturist Romulo Pangantihon, during the special session of the Sanggunian on Friday, April 26, they said that the “calamity proportion” of the damage to the people has been reached.

text: Amo ini ang ginpatihan sang walo ka konsehal sa ila pagpasar sang resolusyon.
english: This is what the eight councilors believed in passing the resolution.

text:
***

Samtang, plano subong sang grupo nanday Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon kag anom ka konsehal nga ipasaka ang ila reklamo sa DILG kag CDRRM Central Office sa Metro Manila agud kwestyunon ang quorum sang paghiwat sang special session sadtong Abril 26.
english:
***

Meanwhile, the group of Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon and six councilors plan to file a complaint with the DILG and CDRRM Central Office in Metro Manila to question the quorum for the special session on April 26.

text: Ang quorum amo ina ang “minimum nga majority” sang nagapasakop sa isa ka miting agud maka-aksyon sing opisyal sa ano man nga kinahanglan pasaran nila sang resolusyon ukon kasuguan.
english: A quorum is the “minimum majority” of those present at a meeting to take official action on whatever resolution or law they need to pass.

text: Ang general rule amo nga ang quorum nagadamo sing katunga sang nagapasakop plus ang isa ka boto (one-half plus 1).
english: The general rule is that a quorum increases by half the number of votes plus one vote (one-half plus 1).

text: Ang Sanggunian may myembro nga 15 ka tawo – 12 ka elective officials, duha ka ex-officio (Liga kag SK) kag si vice mayor (presiding officer).
english: The Sanggunian has 15 members – 12 elective officials, two ex-officio (Liga and SK) and the vice mayor (presiding officer).

text: Ti ano ang pag-isip sang mayoriya?
english: So what is the majority count?

text: Lakip bala ang presiding officer sa isip sang mayoriya?
english: Is the presiding officer included in the minds of the majority?

text: Sa nagtambong nga walo (8) ka konsehal, wala sing quorum sa nagtambong sa special session sunu sa grupo nanday Vice Mayor Ganzon.
english: Of the eight (8) councilors present, there was no quorum in the special session, according to Vice Mayor Ganzon's group.

text: Siling nila nga, samtang ang katunga plus 1 nagalab-ut sa minimo nga 8, indi maisip nga may quorum ini kay indi maisip ang Presiding Officer nga tal-os ni VM Ganzon nga si Councilor RLeoni Gerochi.
english: They said that, while half plus 1 reaches a minimum of 8, it cannot be counted as having a quorum because the Presiding Officer who replaced VM Ganzon, Councilor RLeoni Gerochi, cannot be counted.

text: Pitu lang ang masiling nga “deliberating and voting members”, sunu sa tagmaba gani nila nga si Atty. Rommel Duron.
english: There are only seven “deliberating and voting members”, according to their spokesman Atty. Rommel Duron.

text: Ang Pambansang Blg.
english: The National No.

text: 337 sadto nagasiling nga ang local vice chief executive (katulad sang Vice Mayor) isa ka “ex-officio member with all the rights, duties and privileges of any other member thereof”.
english: 337 then states that the local vice chief executive (like the Vice Mayor) is an “ex-officio member with all the rights, duties and privileges of any other member thereof”.

text: Tungod sini ang Vice Mayor may dual personality bilang ex-officio member sang Sanggunian kag Presiding Officer, nga pwede maka-break sang tie (patas) sa botohay.
english: Because of this, the Vice Mayor has a dual personality as an ex-officio member of the Sanggunian and Presiding Officer, who can break the tie (equal) in the vote.

text: Gin-amendar ugaling ini sang RA 7160 nga naghimo sang local vice chief executive nga isa lang ka “composite member (indi regular ukon ex-officio lang)” kag “Presiding Officer” lang.
english: This was however amended by RA 7160 which made the local vice chief executive only a “composite member (not regular or ex-officio only)” and only a “Presiding Officer”.

text: Tungod sini, sa pagpati sang grupo ni Vice Mayor Ganzon, kay indi regular ukon bisan ex-officio member sang Sanggunian si Vice Mayor, ang sal-i ukon substitute sa iya indi man maisip sa quorum.
english: Therefore, in the belief of Vice Mayor Ganzon's group, since Vice Mayor is not a regular or even ex-officio member of the Sanggunian, his substitute will not be counted in the quorum.

text: Of course, kinahanglan maathagan gid ini sang publiko sa ining ila pagpasaka sang reklamo sa DILG kag CDRRM Central Office.
english: Of course, the public needs to be clear about this in filing a complaint with the DILG and CDRRM Central Office.

english: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)

text: Na-eleher liwat si Abraham “Bambol” Tolentino bilang presidente sang Philippine Olympic Committee (POC).
english: Abraham “Bambol” Tolentino was re-elected as president of the Philippine Olympic Committee (POC).

text: Magapabilin ini sa posisyon sa masunod nga apat ka tuig matapos nakuha ang 45 ka mga boto sa POC elections batok sa 15 nga nakuha naman sang iya kasumpong nga amo ang baseball chief nga si Chito Loyzaga.
english: He will remain in office for the next four years after winning 45 votes in the POC elections against 15 for his opponent, baseball chief Chito Loyzaga.

text: Antes ang eleksyon, ginpadayaw ni Tolentino ang mga kadalag-an sang Pinoy athletes sa idalom sang iya termino.
english: Before the election, Tolentino praised the achievements of Pinoy athletes under his term.

text: Lakip diri ang maragtason nga gold medal nga nakuha ni Hidilyn Diaz sa weightlifting sa Tokyo 2020 kag ang duha ka bulawan nga medalya nga nakuha naman ni Carlos Yulo sa gymnastics sa Paris Summer Games sini lang nga 2024.
english: These include the historic gold medal won by Hidilyn Diaz in weightlifting at Tokyo 2020 and the two gold medals won by Carlos Yulo in gymnastics at the Paris Summer Games in 2024.

text: Ikatatlo na ini nga termino ni Tolentino bilang chief sang Olympic body sang Pilipinas matapos una nga nagpungko sang 2019 sang nagbulos siya sa wala natapos nga termino ni Ricky Vargas paagi sa special election kag sunod nga nagdaog sa regular elections sang 2021.
english: This is Tolentino's third term as chief of the Philippine Olympic body after first taking office in 2019 when he replaced the unexpired term of Ricky Vargas through a special election and subsequently won the regular elections in 2021.

text: Sa mga nagboto sa eleksyon sang Olympic Committee, kadam-an ang halin sa national sports associations, may duha nga halin sa Athletes Commission, kag isa halin sa International Olympic Committee.
english: Of those who voted in the Olympic Committee election, most were from national sports associations, with two from the Athletes Commission, and one from the International Olympic Committee.

text: Naaresto sang mga otoridad ang pareho nga akusado ni anay Senator Ramon “Bong” Revilla Jr.
english: Authorities arrested the co-accused of former Senator Ramon “Bong” Revilla Jr.

text: nga si Christina Mae del Rosario Pineda sa Benguet kaina sang aga sang Martes, Enero 20.
english: Christina Mae del Rosario Pineda in Benguet yesterday morning Tuesday, January 20.

text: Nadakpan si Pineda sang PNP-CIDG Mountain Province Provincial Field Unit kag 1st Provincial Mobile Force Company sang Benguet Police Provincial Office sa may Barangay Bangai, Buguias, Benguet.
english: Pineda was arrested by the PNP-CIDG Mountain Province Provincial Field Unit and the 1st Provincial Mobile Force Company of the Benguet Police Provincial Office in Barangay Bangai, Buguias, Benguet.

text: Ini ang may kaangtanan sa kaso nga malversation bangud sa P92.8 million ghost flood control project sa Pandi, Bulacan.
english: This is in connection with the case of malversation due to the P92.8 million ghost flood control project in Pandi, Bulacan.

text: Si Pineda ang cashier sang DPWH Bulacan First District Engineering Office.
english: Pineda is the cashier of the DPWH Bulacan First District Engineering Office.

text: Kalakip siya sa pito nga gin-isyuhan sang arrest warrant sang Sandiganbayan Third Division kag hold departure order sang Lunes.
english: He was among the seven who were issued an arrest warrant by the Sandiganbayan Third Division and a hold departure order on Monday.

text: Ang iban pa nga akusado nga si Revilla ang nag-surrender sa PNP-CIDG.
english: The other accused, Revilla, surrendered to the PNP-CIDG.

text: Samtang, sanday anay DPWH Bulacan Assistant District Engineer Brice Hernandez kag Jaypee Mendoza, nga pareho nga nagtambong sa hearing sang Senado sa flood control anomaly, ang gin-aresto man kahapon sang NBI operatives sa Senado.
english: Meanwhile, former DPWH Bulacan Assistant District Engineer Brice Hernandez and Jaypee Mendoza, who both attended the Senate hearing on the flood control anomaly, were also arrested yesterday by NBI operatives in the Senate.

text: Nagbisita sa Iloilo agud mag-upod sa Dinagyang Festival 2026 si anay Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief kag subong Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) General Manager Nicolas Torre III.
english: Former Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief and current Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) General Manager Nicolas Torre III visited Iloilo to join the Dinagyang Festival 2026.

text: Antes sini, nag-courtesy visit anay si Torre kay Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: Earlier, Torre paid a courtesy visit to Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol.
english: at the Iloilo Provincial Capitol.

text: Apisar ginbun-ag kag nagdaku si Torre sa Mindanao partikular sa Jolo, Sulu, gina-claim sini ang pagka-Ilonggo ilabi na bangud tumandok sang Tigbauan ang iya amay nga si Rodolfo “Dolping” Molarto Torre kag tumandok naman sang Dumangas ang iya iloy nga si Julia Deloso.
english: Although Torre was born and raised in Mindanao particularly in Jolo, Sulu, he claims to be Ilonggo especially since his father Rodolfo “Dolping” Molarto Torre is a native of Tigbauan and his mother Julia Deloso is a native of Dumangas.

text: Siya ang nagpungko nga ika-31 nga hepe sang PNP antes gin-relieve kag subong gin-appoint sa MMDA.
english: He was the 31st PNP chief before being relieved and now appointed to the MMDA.

text:
MGA AKTIBIDAD SA DINAGYANG

Subong nga adlaw, Enero 24, ginabantayan sang mga Ilonggo ang Dinagyang Pet Parade kag ang Festive Parade Sponsors’ Mardi Gras.
english:
FESTIVAL ACTIVITIES

Today, January 24, Ilonggos are watching the Dinagyang Pet Parade and the Festive Parade Sponsors’ Mardi Gras.

text: Ala una karon sa hapon, patigayunon ang Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan sa Iloilo Freedom Grandstand at 1 p.m. kag sa Iloilo Sports Complex umpisa naman 3 p.m. Isa ini sa major highlights sang kapistahan.
english: At 1 pm today, the Town Festival will be held at the Iloilo Freedom Grandstand at 1 p.m. and at the Iloilo Sports Complex starting at 3 p.m. This is one of the major highlights of the festival.

text:
Ang katapusan nga aktibidad subong nga adlaw amo ang Grand Religious Sadsad sa San Jose Parish Placer nga maga-umpisa alas syete sa gab-i.

Buwas, Enero 25, amo ang schedule para sa Dinagyang Tribes Competition.#
english:
The last activity today is the Grand Religious Sadsad at San Jose Parish Placer which will start at 7 pm.

Tomorrow, January 25, is the schedule for the Dinagyang Tribes Competition.#

text: Madamo na nga beses nga ginpamatud-an sang ido nga abyan ini sang tawo.
english: The dog has proven itself many times to be man’s best friend.

text: May yara gani sang ido nga ginbalewala ang kalayo, mabalikan lang ang iya nga tag-iya nga yara pa sa sulod sang nasunog nga balay!
english: There was even a dog that ignored the fire, only to return to its owner who was still inside the burning house!

text: Sa Japan naman, ginkilala nga isa ka hero ukon baganihan ang isa ka ido ang nagbulig sa isa ka lalaki nga ginaatake sa korason.
english: In Japan, a dog that helped a man suffering a heart attack was considered a hero.

text: Ini nga ido ang lima ka tuig nga mixed-breed nga si Koume nga naga-trabaho sa isa ka horse-riding club sa Wakaba-ku, Chiba City bilang isa ka “mascot.” Nahibaluan nga tradisyon na sa amo nga club nga himuon nga empleyado ang mga babayi nga ido agud nga makatamyaw sa mga members sang club.
english: This dog is five-year-old mixed-breed Koume who works at a horse-riding club in Wakaba-ku, Chiba City as a “mascot.” It is learned that it is a tradition in the club to make female dogs employees in order to greet the members of the club.

text: Ang doggy nga si Koume ang kilala man nga nanamian gid mag-upod sa tawo.
english: The doggy Koume is also known to love human company.

text: Isa ka adlaw, nagasunod ini sa isa ka lalaki sang gulpi lang natumba ang amo nga tawo.
english: One day, he was following a man when the man suddenly fell down.

text: Suno sa riding instructor nga yara sa amo nga area sang natabo ang insidentea, masami nga hipuson si Koume apang sang amo nga tion, tuman ka tunog kag wala untat ang taghol sini agud makaagaw lamang sang atensyon.
english: According to the riding instructor who was in the area when the incident occurred, Koume is usually quiet but at that time, his barking was too loud and constant to attract attention.

text: Ini ang rason kun ngaa nasapakan sang iban nga tawo ang lalaki nga kaupod sang ido, nagtawag sang ambulansya, kag nahingagaw sang paramedics nga masalbar pa ang iya nga kabuhi.
english: This is why other people noticed the man with the dog, called an ambulance, and the paramedics managed to save his life.

text: Gindayaw naman sang Wakaba Fire Department ang ginhimo sang ido kag gintawag ini nga perfect response.
english: The Wakaba Fire Department praised the dog's actions and called it a perfect response.

text: Naka-recover na ang lalaki sa heart attack kag nagbalik sa nakaandan nga riding activities sa club.
english: The man has recovered from the heart attack and has returned to his usual riding activities at the club.

text: Bilang pasalamat naman kag pagkilala kay Koume, ginpatambong ini sa isa special ceremony kun sa diin nakabaton ini sang letter of thanks halin sa Wakaba Fire Department.
english: As a thank you and recognition to Koume, he was invited to attend a special ceremony where he received a letter of thanks from the Wakaba Fire Department.

text: Ginpahayag nga ang mentor ni Koume amo ang isa pa ka ido nga si Ume nga amo ang nagtudlo sa iya nga magpangayo dayun sang bulig kun may kaangay sini nga insidente.
english: Koume's mentor was reportedly another dog named Ume who taught her to seek help immediately in case of such an incident.

text: Isa ang ginbawian sang kabuhi kag apat ang pilason matapos nag-amok ang isa ka pasyente sa sulod sang Aleosan District Hospital sa Brgy.
english: One person was killed and four others injured after a patient rioted inside the Aleosan District Hospital in Brgy.

text: Bancal, Alimodian, Iloilo.
english: Bancal, Alimodian, Iloilo.

text: Ang suspek amo si alyas Roy, residente sang Barangay Cagay, Leon nga na-admit sa nasambit nga ospital matapos ginpahayag nga nag-inom sang kemikal.
english: The suspect was identified as alias Roy, resident of Barangay Cagay, Leon who was admitted to the said hospital after allegedly drinking chemicals.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Chrysler John Ledesma, hepe sang Alimodian Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga i-discharge na kuntani ang suspek apang sang yara na ini sa nurses’ station, didto na sini ginpanglampusan ang mga tawo sa iya palibot gamit ang IV stand ukon salab-itan sang dextrose.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Chrysler John Ledesma, chief of the Alimodian Municipal Police Station, said the suspect was about to be discharged but when he was at the nurses' station, he stabbed people around him with an IV stand or dextrose container.

text: Isa sa napilasan amo ang 24-anyos nga nurse na si alyas Patricia nga residente ng San Miguel, Iloilo.
english: One of the injured was identified as 24-year-old nurse alias Patricia, resident of San Miguel, Iloilo.

text: Nag-angkon man sang samad ang tatlo ka mga bantay sa mga pasyente sa ospital.
english: Three guards also sustained injuries to the patients at the hospital.

text: Ini amo sanday alyas Marjorie,48, residente sang Alimodian; alyas John, 23, residente sang San Miguel; kag alyas Frederico, 62, residente sang San Miguel.
english: They are alias Marjorie, 48, resident of Alimodian; alias John, 23, resident of San Miguel; and alias Frederico, 62, resident of San Miguel.

text: Ang napatay naman amo si alyas Lilia, 80-anyos, residente sang Alimodian kag isa man sa mga pasyente sa ospital.
english: The deceased was identified as Lilia, 80, a resident of Alimodian and one of the patients at the hospital.

text: Siya ang nag-angkon sang pilas sa dughan nga gintunaan sang iya kamatayon.
english: He sustained a gunshot wound to the chest that caused his death.

text: Natigayon naman nga mapunggan ang suspek nga manghalit sa iban pa paagi sa bulig sang mga bantay sang iban nga pasyente.
english: The suspect was prevented from harming others with the help of other patients' guards.

text: Yara na kustodiya sang Alimodian Municipal Police Station ang suspek kag natalana nga pasakaan sang kaso nga homicide kag physical injuries.
english: The suspect is now in the custody of the Alimodian Municipal Police Station and is scheduled to face charges of homicide and physical injuries.

text: Nagtambong ang linibo ka mga tawo sa pro-Palestinian nga protesta sa Sydney Harbor Bridge.
english: Thousands of people attended the pro-Palestinian protest on the Sydney Harbor Bridge.

text: Ang protesta gin-aprubahan sangt Korte Suprema sang Australia isa ka adlaw antes ang kahiwatan.
english: The protest was approved by the Supreme Court of Australia a day before the event.

text: Sa pihak sang pag-ulan, wala ginsapak sang mga partisipante ang mga tinaga nga nakasulat sa karatula nga may mensahe sa mga pulitiko nga untaton na ang giyera.
english: Despite the rain, the participants ignored the words written on the sign with a message to politicians to stop the war.

text: Nakit-an man sa protesta si WikiLeaks Julian Assange kag pila ka mga kilala nga mga tawo lakip ang mga federal Members of Parliament Ed Husic kag anay NSW Premier Bob Carr.
english: Also spotted at the protest were WikiLeaks Julian Assange and several high-profile figures including federal Members of Parliament Ed Husic and former NSW Premier Bob Carr.

text: Ang Sydney Harbor Bridge katapusan nga ginsirado sang 2023 para sa World Pride, nga gintambungan sang masobra 50,000 ka mga tawo.
english: The Sydney Harbor Bridge was last closed in 2023 for World Pride, which was attended by more than 50,000 people.

text: Nagpadulong na sa Japan si Binibining Pilipinas International 2023 Angelica Lopez para itiglawas ang Pilipinas sa 62nd Miss International Beauty Pageant!
english: Binibining Pilipinas International 2023 Angelica Lopez has left for Japan to represent the Philippines in the 62nd Miss International Beauty Pageant!

text: Handom ni Lopez nga mangin ikapito nga Pinay nga makakuha sang titulo.
english: Lopez dreams of becoming the seventh Filipina to win the title.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, 3rd runner-up ang tiglawas sang Pilipinas nga si Nicole Borromeo.
english: Last year, Philippine representative Nicole Borromeo was 3rd runner-up.

text: Ang Miss International 2024 ang natalana sa Nobyembre 12, 2024 sa Tokyo Dome City Hall sa Japan kun sa diin koronahan sang reigning Miss International 2023 Andrea Rubio sang Venezuela ang iya successor gikan sa masobra 70 tanan nga mga kandidata.
english: Miss International 2024 is scheduled for November 12, 2024 at the Tokyo Dome City Hall in Japan where reigning Miss International 2023 Andrea Rubio of Venezuela will crown her successor from more than 70 total candidates.

text: May ginakaptan si Vice President Sara Duterte nga lima ka impeachable offense ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte has five impeachable offenses against President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: Suno kay Duterte, sang nagpungko ini bilang bise presidente, nahibaluan niya nga isa siya ka impeachable officer.
english: According to Duterte, when he took office as vice president, he knew he was an impeachable officer.

text: Apang gin-athag ni Duterte nga mangin si Marcos ang impeachable man.
english: But Duterte clarified that Marcos will also be impeachable.

text:
“𝙎𝙞 𝘽𝘽𝙈… 𝙈𝙖𝙮 𝙡𝙞𝙨𝙩𝙖𝙝𝙖𝙣 𝙖𝙠𝙤 𝙣𝙜 𝙡𝙞𝙢𝙖𝙣𝙜 𝙗𝙖𝙜𝙖𝙮 𝙣𝙖 𝙞𝙢𝙥𝙚𝙖𝙘𝙝𝙖𝙗𝙡𝙚 𝙤𝙛𝙛𝙚𝙣𝙨𝙚 𝙣𝙞𝙮𝙖”

Nagapati naman si Duterte nga indi man ini sa gihapon makalusot ang impeachment ni Marcos sa House of Representatives.
english:
“I 𝙎𝙞 𝘽𝘽𝙈… 𝙈𝙖𝙮 𝙡𝙞𝙨𝙩𝙖𝙝𝙖𝙣 𝙖𝙠𝙤 𝙣𝙜 𝙡𝙜𝙜𝙜𝙜 𝙗𝙖𝙜𝙖𝙮 𝙣𝙖 𝙞𝙢𝙥𝙚𝙖𝙘𝙝𝙖𝙗𝙡𝙚 𝙤𝙛𝙛𝙚𝙣𝙚 𝙣𝙞𝙮𝙖”

Duterte believes that Marcos' impeachment will not pass the House of Representatives.

text: Ini bangud si House Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez kag President Marcos ang magpakaisa kag magkaalyado.
english: This is because House Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez and President Marcos are brothers and sisters and allies.

text: SA NASILING ta na gani diri sa aton kolum, mahuyang kita nga nasyon kag indi naton matuod kaya ang makig-gyera – sing harapan – sa Tsina.
english: AS we have already said here in our column, we are a weak nation and we cannot really afford to fight – face to face – with China.

text: Of course, gaugyon kita sa panghuna-huna ni Senador Panfilo Lacson nga pwede gihapon kita makabatu sa Tsina.
english: Of course, we agree with Senator Panfilo Lacson that we can still fight China.

text: Bisan indi man sing harapan, mahimo ta man ini sa hipos lang nga paagi, siling gani niya.
english: Even if we don't have a face, we can do it quietly, he said.

text: Katulad bala sa paghupot sang batu sa slingshot ni David agud i-kontra kay Goliath kon kinahanglanon na?
english: Is it like holding a stone in David's slingshot to fight Goliath when necessary?

text: Samtang, ang mahimo ta lang amo ang makig-compromise, katulad sa paghilisugot sa Tsina nga indi lang anay pag-istoryahan ang aton tagsa-tagsa nga claims sa South China Sea kag maghilisugot sa mga butang diin may igual nga benepisyo ang isa kag isa sa overlapping naton nga mga claims.
english: Meanwhile, all we can do is compromise, such as agreeing with China not to discuss our individual claims in the South China Sea and agree on things where there is equal benefit to each other in our overlapping claims.

text: Maayo pa seguro itugyan ta na gid lang kag ihulat anay ang pag-resolbar sang aton mga claims sa angay nga panahon.
english: I guess it's better to just hand it over and wait for our claims to be resolved in due course.

text: Katulad bala sa ginahimo man gani sang Tsina sa iya pag-resolbar sang gumuntang sini sa Taiwan, nga samtang sakop sang Mainland China bulag ini sa ideolohiya.
english: Is it similar to what China is doing in its resolution of its dispute with Taiwan, which while part of Mainland China is ideologically separate.

text: Komunista ang pag-pangabuhi sa Mainland China, Demokrasya naman ang iya sang Taiwan.
english: Mainland China is a communist country, while Taiwan is a democracy.

text: Pero, sa gihapon, gina-tolerar kag gina-respeto nila ang isa kag isa sa sulod na gani sang mga 70 anyos.
english: However, they have tolerated and respected each other for some 70 years.

text: Nagagwa ugaling nga lain ya ang pagtratar sang Tsina sa Filipinas bisan pa gani sa legitimo naton nga mga claims sa South China Sea.
english: However, it turns out that China treats the Philippines differently despite our legitimate claims in the South China Sea.

text: Ining legitimo nga mga claims naangkon naton sa idalom sang Law of the Sea, sa diin may sovereign rights kita sa mga 200-mile exclusive economic zone (EEZ) halin sa aton baybayon, nga lakip na dira ang Scarborough Shoal, nga gin-agaw sa aton sang Tsina sadtong  2012, kag pati ang Pag-asa Island kag iban pa nga isla sa Spratlys.
english: These legitimate claims are acquired under the Law of the Sea, where we have sovereign rights in a 200-mile exclusive economic zone (EEZ) from our coast, which includes the Scarborough Shoal, which China seized from us in 2012, as well as Pag-asa and other Spratly Islands.

text: Sa kaso gani nga gin-file naton sa International Tribunal sa Hague sa aton claim sa Scarborough, nagdaug kita ugaling wala ini gin-respeto sang Tsina.
english: In the case that we filed with the International Tribunal in The Hague on our claim in Scarborough, we won but China did not respect it.

text: Wala man gani sini ginakilala ang EEZ naton sa idalom sang UN Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) tungod sa bogus sini nga claim sa mga 90 porsyento sang South China Sea sa idalom kuno sang 9-dash line.
english: It does not even recognize our EEZ under the UN Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) because of its bogus claim that about 90 percent of the South China Sea is supposedly under the 9-dash line.

text: Sa karon, luyag na gani agawon sang Tsina ang Pag-asa Island, pagkatapos nga naagaw na sini ang Scarborough Shoal.
english: Now, China even wants to take over Pag-asa Island, after it has already taken over Scarborough Shoal.

text: Aba, may ginpadala na gani ini sing sobra sa 200 ka mga salakyan naval agud pahugon kita sa Pag-asa Island.
english: Well, it has even sent more than 200 naval vehicles to threaten us on Pag-asa Island.

text: About time nga indi na naton mabaton ining pambu-bully sang Tsina kag himuon na naton ang aton dapat himuon agud madepensahan ang aton sovereignty sa Scarborough kag Spratlys.
english: About time we can no longer accept this Chinese bullying and do what we must do to defend our sovereignty in Scarborough and the Spratlys.

text: Indi man tani kita pagpabay-an sang Diyos nga Makagagahum sa sining aton kinamatarong sa aton mga teritoryo.
english: May God Almighty not abandon us in this right of our territories.

text: Nadeklarar na naton gani, sang sini lang, ang pagdepensa sang Pag-asa Island sing lubos paagi sa isa ka “suicide mission” sa order mismo ni President Duterte.
english: We have even declared, recently, the complete defense of Pag-asa Island through a “suicide mission” on the orders of President Duterte himself.

text: Samtang, padayon man kita gasalig sa mabulig sa aton sang Estados Unidos sa idalom sang aton mutual defense pact kon atakehon gid man kita sang Tsina sa diin man nga bahin sang aton pungsod, lakip ang aton mga teritoryo sa Spratlys kag Scarborough.
english: Meanwhile, we continue to rely on the United States to help us under our mutual defense pact if China ever attacks us anywhere in our country, including our territories in the Spratlys and Scarborough.

text: Samtang gasalig man kita sa pag-apin sa aton sang iban nga mga nasyon, labi na gid sa gindaug naton nga kaso batok sa pag-agaw sang Tsina sa Scarborough Shoal kag sang kinamatarong nation sa idalom sang UN Law of the Sea (UNCLOS).
english: While we also rely on the support of other countries, especially in the case we won against China's seizure of the Scarborough Shoal and the rights of nations under the UN Law of the Sea (UNCLOS).

text: May claim man kita sa pila pa ka isla dira sa Spratlys by discovery nga gina-recognize sang international law.
english: We also have a claim to several other islands in the Spratlys by discovery that are recognized by international law.

text: Ginpasalig nanday Senator Kiko Pangilinan kag Quezon 1st District Rep.
