text: Mark Enverga nga matun-an ang mga problema sa industriya sang tubo kasunod sang ginpatigayon nga public consultation sa Talisay City, Negros Occidental.
english: Mark Enverga to learn about the problems in the sugarcane industry following the public consultation held in Talisay City, Negros Occidental.

text: Si Pangilinan amo ang chairperson sang Senate Committee on Agriculture, Food, and Agrarian Reform, samtang si Enverga amo man ang chairperson sang amo man nga komitiba sa Kamara.
english: Pangilinan is chairperson of the Senate Committee on Agriculture, Food, and Agrarian Reform, while Enverga is also chairperson of the same committee in the House.

text: Ang ginpatigayon nga congressional inquiry ang nag-ugat sa mga separado nga resolusyon sa Kamara nga nagahingyo nga malantaw ang pagsarurot sang mill-gate prices sang kalamay kag molasses kag ang epekto sini sa sugar producers, mangunguma, kag ila mga trabahador.
english: The congressional inquiry is rooted in separate resolutions in the House calling for a look into the rise in mill-gate prices of sugarcane and molasses and its impact on sugar producers, farmers, and their workers.

text: Yara man ang representative gikan sa nanarisari nga sugar federations, mga tiglawas sang Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) kag iban pa nga national agencies kag local public officials.
english: Also present were representatives from various sugar federations, representatives of the Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) and other national agencies and local public officials.

text: Ang kada sugar federation ang ginhatagan man sang tyansa nga makapabutyag sang ila concerns.
english: Each sugar federation was also given the opportunity to express their concerns.

text: Ginpangayo naman nanday Pangilinan kag Enverga ang demand letters gikan sa tagsa ka sugar federation.
english: Pangilinan and Enverga requested demand letters from each sugar federation.

text: Suno kay Pangilinan, kaangay sa kun paano nila ginsolusyonan sadto ang problema sa bugas, hatagan man nila sang solusyon ang problema sa kalamay.
english: According to Pangilinan, just like how they solved the rice problem, they will also give a solution to the sugarcane problem.

text: Pahayag pa ni Pangilinan, indi lang padayaw-dayaw ang public consultation kundi isa ka importante nga tikang nga mapakita sang konkreto nga solusyon sa isyu.
english: Pangilinan said the public consultation is not just a show but an important step to show a concrete solution to the issue.

text: Ginpasalig man sini nga dal-on ang problema sang amo nga industriya sa Malacañang.
english: He also promised to take the problem of the industry to Malacañang.

text:
‘KAMI GID ANG MAKALULUOY’

Nagakahangawa naman ang mga Ilonggo nga nagatrabaho sa kampo nga madulaan man sila sang palangabuhian kun magpadayon ang krisis sa industriya sang tubo.
english:
‘WE ARE REALLY POOR’

Ilonggos working in the camp are worried that they will lose their livelihood if the crisis in the sugarcane industry continues.

text: Lakip sila sa nag-upod sa protesta sang sugargane workers sa syudad sang Passi subong nga semana agud magpanawagan nga maghulag na ang gobyerno sa tunga sang pagsarurot sang presyo sang kalamay.
english: They were among those who joined the protest of sugargane workers in Passi City this week to call on the government to act amid the rising price of sugarcane.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Terry Balboa, isa ka trabahador sa kampo, iya ginpahayag nga maapektuhan gid sila pananglitan mag-untat sa pagtanum sang tubo ang ila nga amo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Terry Balboa, a worker in the camp, said they will be affected if their employer stops planting sugarcane.

text: Suno kay Balboa, madamo sa ila ang wala man sang kaugalingon nga uma, kag ang kampo lang gid ang ila ginasaligan nga trabaho.
english: According to Balboa, many of them do not have their own farms, and the camp is their only job.

text: Pananglitan madulaan sila sang trabaho suno sa iya, makaluluoy gid ang ila kahimtangan bangud maapektuhan pati ang pag-eskwela sang ila kabataan.
english: If they lose their jobs, he said, their situation will be very miserable because their children's education will be affected.

text: Subong suno sa iya, pagkatapos nga nakapatapas na sang tubo, wala anay gintandog ang duta sang iya amo bangud sa problema subong sa sugarcane industry.
english: Now, he said, after the pipeline was cut, his employer's land was not touched because of the problems in the sugarcane industry.

text: Matandaan nga ginpangunahan sang Jalasig Sugar Planters Association ang demonstrasyon sa syudad sang Passi.
english: The demonstration was led by the Jalasig Sugar Planters Association in Passi City.

text: Ginapanawagan nila ang pag-akto sang gobyerno sa tunga sang tuman ka nubo nga farm-gate prices kasunod sang pagpanglakaak sang pag-import sang kalamay kag kapalpakan sang SRA nga ma-regulate ang merkado.#
english: They are calling for government action amid extremely low farm-gate prices following the spike in sugarcane imports and the SRA's failure to regulate the market.

text: Kun masarangan mo nga magtinir sa idalom sang tubig sa sulod sang pila ka minutos, indi anay magpatama sang tikal bangud may yara gali sang tawo nga nangguba sang rekord kun kalawigon lang sang tinir sa tubig ang istoryahan!
english: If you can stay underwater for a few minutes, don't hit the tikal because there is someone who broke the record when it comes to staying underwater!

text: Ini amo ang isa ka researcher sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga amo na subong ang ginakilala nga pinakamalawig ang tinir sa idalom sang tubig nga mas malawig pa sa 73 ka adlaw nga gintinir sang duha ka professors sang 2014 sa isa man ka Largo lodge.
english: This is a researcher in the United States of America who is now recognized as the longest stay underwater longer than the 73 days that two professors stayed in 2014 in the same Largo lodge.

text: Ang bag-o nga record holder amo si Dr. Joseph Dituri nga 74 ka adlaw na sa idalom sang tubig sa Key Largo, Florida.
english: The new record holder is Dr. Joseph Dituri who has been underwater for 74 days in Key Largo, Florida.

text: Kag wala pa ini sang plano nga mag-untat bangud may plano pa ini nga maglawig didto sa sulod sang 100 ka adlaw!
english: And it has no plans of stopping yet as it has plans to stretch there for another 100 days!

text: Si Dr. Dituri, 55, isa ka retired Navy officer, kag isa subong ka biomedical engineering professor sa University of South Florida.
english: Drs. Dituri, 55, is a retired Navy officer, and a current biomedical engineering professor at the University of South Florida.

text: Gin-umpisahan ang iya misyon sang nagligad nga Marso 1, kag ang mayor nga katuyuan amo nga matun-an kun paano gina-handle sang lawas sang tawo ang long-term effects sang pagtinir sa idalom sang tubig nga may yara sang extreme pressure.
english: Its mission was launched on March 1, and its main purpose is to study how the human body handles the long-term effects of being underwater under extreme pressure.

text: Nagatinir siya sa isa ka 100-square-foot nga habitat nga nahamtang 30 ka tapak ang kadalumon halin sa surface.
english: He stays in a 100-square-foot habitat located 30 feet deep from the surface.

text: Ginatawag niya ini nga Jules’ Undersea Lodge.
english: She calls it Jules’ Undersea Lodge.

text: Samtang yara siya didto, ginapadayon man ni Dituri ang pagtudlo sa biomedical engineering course apang online lamang.
english: While he was there, Dituri also continued teaching the biomedical engineering course but only online.

text: Ini bangud sa amo nga underwater habitat, may yara man siya sang tululugan, may bathroom area nga may toilet kag fresh-water shower, kag may yara man sang kusina kag workspace.
english: This is because of the underwater habitat, he also has a bedroom, a bathroom area with a toilet and fresh-water shower, and a kitchen and workspace.

text: Samtang padayon ang mission, may mga nagabisita man sa iya agud magdala sang pagkaon, kag may yara man sang medical team nga naga-check sa iya nga ikaayong lawas kag naga-conduct sang test.
english: While the mission continues, there are also visitors to bring him food, and there is also a medical team that checks his health and conducts tests.

text: Ginapaidalom man siya sa psychosocial kag psychological tests agud mahangpan ang mental effects kun nagaisahanon kag kun ma-stuck sa isa ka lugar nga limitado ang hulag.#
english: He is also undergoing psychosocial and psychological tests to understand the mental effects of being alone and being stuck in a place with limited movement.

text: HALOS natilawan ta na ang tanan nga medyos agud mapauntat ang mahaliton nga bisyo sang paggamit sang ilegal nga droga nga nagapabuang kag nagatulod sa iban agud maghimo sang makasiligni nga mga krimen.
english: WE HAVE tried almost every means to stop the harmful habit of using illegal drugs that drives others crazy and commits heinous crimes.

text: Padayon man ang aton paglagas sa mga courier kag ang mga drug pusher sang sining mahaliton nga droga.
english: We also continue to pursue the couriers and drug pushers of this dangerous drug.

text: Sige man ang lagas naton sa mga naga-producir sini (manufacturer) kag ang dalagkuan nga pagbaligya sang mga dealer.
english: We are also chasing the manufacturers and the big sales of the dealers.

text: Wala man kita nagakataka sa paglagas sa mga protector sa mga kapulisan, mga pulitiko, kag bisan ang mga hwes kag mga prosecutor, kag ang iban pa.
english: Nor do we hesitate to pursue protectors in the police, politicians, and even judges and prosecutors, among others.

text: Apang kansar lang kay ara man gihapon sila nga daw bange-bange nga mga kasag nga magwa sa aton pagtalikod kag madula sa aton pagbalikid, nga kinahanglan maabtik ka gid agud madakpan ang pila sa ila.
english: But it's just cancer because they're still like bange-bange crabs that come out when we turn away and disappear when we turn around, that you have to be very quick to catch some of them.

text: Tungod sini, isa lang ang mahimo naton agud matapna ang salot nga ini – ang wala pahuway man nga panglagas naton sa ila!
english: Therefore, there is only one thing we can do to stop this plague – our relentless pursuit of them!

text: Samtang, natingala ang isa ta ka abyan kon ngaa wala sing kasuguan nga nagahimo bilang krimen ang paggamit sang ilegal nga droga (drug use).
english: Meanwhile, a friend of ours wondered why there is no law that makes drug use a crime.

text: Kon isa ini ka krimen, kasubong sang mga courier kag drug pusher, sunu pa sa ining aton abyan, ti pwede na sila pasakaan kaso kag ihunong sa prisuhan katulad gani sang mga courier kag drug pusher.
english: If it is a crime, like the couriers and drug pushers, according to our friend, then they can be charged and imprisoned like the couriers and drug pushers.

text: Sa karon, ang pagtan-aw ta sa mga durugista (drug user) indi mga kriminal kundi mga masakiton nga dapat lang ipabulong.
english: Today, we see drug users not as criminals but as sick people who need to be treated.

text: In fact, kon madakpan ang ining mga durugista ginadala lang sila sa mga rehabilitation center – agud gani ipabulong.
english: In fact, when these drug pushers are caught they are taken to rehabilitation centers – even for treatment.

text: Pero pwede gid man bala sila pasabton sa sining ila bisyo?
english: But can they really be held accountable for their addiction?

text: Kag kon pwede gid man, sa ano nga rason?
english: And if you can, for what reason?

text: Kon may ideya kita parti sini, ina angot lang sa aton natural nga obligasyon agud respetuhon ang kinamatarong sang kada isa sa iya kaugalingon nga pagginawi nga indi makahalit sang isigkatawo.
english: If we have any idea about it, it is only in connection with our natural obligation to respect the right of each one to his own conduct without harming others.

text: Sunu gani sa Golden Rule: Indi paghimua sa iban ang indi mo luyag himuon sa imo kaugalingon (ukon pwede mo mahimo ang luyag mo basta indi ka lang makahalit sa iban).
english: According to the Golden Rule: Do not do to others what you do not want to do to yourself (or you can do what you want as long as you do not harm others).

text: Kag kon may nahimo kita nga may salabton kita, ina lang ang salabton ta sa kasuguan sang Diyos nga nagalakip sang mga kahimuan nga makahalit sa aton kaugalingon.
english: And if we have done something that we are responsible for, that is the only responsibility we have in God's law that includes actions that harm ourselves.

text: Angot sa sining moral nga pagtan-aw, may tion nga wala gani sadto gina-bendisyunan sang pari ang isa ka napatay paagi sa suicide ukon paghikog tungod sa pagpati nga wala sing kapatawaran ang ini nga pagpakasala.
english: In connection with this moral view, there was a time when the priest did not even bless a person who died by suicide or suicide because of the belief that there was no forgiveness for this sin.

text: Sang ulihi ugaling, sa nahibal-an man naton, ginkuha ining pagdumili kag pwede na mabendisyunan ang napatay sa paghikog.
english: Later, however, as we know, this prohibition was lifted and the deceased could be blessed by suicide.

text: In fact, may isa ka nasyon gani nga naghingyo nga hulugan sing penalidad ang isa ka naghikog, ugaling wala ato mag-madinalag-on.
english: In fact, one country even demanded that a suicide be punished, but it was unsuccessful.

text: Seguro tungod kon may dapat siya sabton nga sala, ina direkta lang nga salabton niya sa Diyos.
english: Perhaps because if he had to answer for a sin, it was directly his responsibility to God.

text: Siling gani mismo ni Kristo sa krus: “Patawara sila Amay kay wala sila kahibalo sang ila ginahimo.” In other words, indi naton mapihu nga lubos gid nga kasal-anan ang paghikog kay posible nga ginhimo niya ini nga “wala siya kahibalo sang iya ginahimo”.
english: Christ himself said on the cross: “Forgive them, Father, for they do not know what they are doing.” In other words, we cannot be sure that suicide is completely wrong because it is possible that he did it “without knowing what he was doing”.

text: Ina man seguro ang rason kon ngaa wala kita sing kasuguan nga nagahatag sing penalidad sa pag-usar sang ilegal nga droga kay ang ginahalitan lang amo ang kaugalingon sang tawo.
english: That's probably why we don't have a law that penalizes the use of illegal drugs because the only thing that hurts is the person himself.

text: Madamo pa nga pagpanghalit sa kaugalingon nga wala gina-entrahan sang aton kasuguan- katulad lang sa pagpahimo sang tattoo sa bahin sang lawas sang tawo.
english: There are many other forms of self-harm that are not covered by our law - such as getting a tattoo on a part of the human body.

text: Isa ka pastor sa Filipinas – nga bantog man nga personalidad sa pelikula kag sports – ang wala gani gapati nga ang pagpa-tattoo isa ka kasal-anan bisan sa atubangan sang Diyos.
english: A pastor in the Philippines – who is also a famous movie and sports personality – does not even believe that getting a tattoo is a sin even before God.

text: May negosyo ini siya sa paghimo sang tattoo didto sa Estado Unidos.
english: He owns a tattoo business in the United States.

text: Well, kon amo gid man ina ang pagpati naton, tani tuod-tuodon gid sang aton gobyerno ang pag-rehab sining mga durugista agud mapabulong sila sing maayo kag mapabalik sa mainstream society sang mga wala sining bisyo.
english: Well, if that's what we believe, I hope our government will seriously rehabilitate these drug addicts so that they can be treated properly and returned to the mainstream society of those who do not have this addiction.

text: Ang anom lang ka bulan nga pagpa-rehab, sa aton pagpati, indi sufficiente sa pagpaayo sa isa ka durugista.
english: Just six months of rehab, we believe, is not enough to cure a drug addict.

text: Indi bala matuod ini, in your honest opinion, kamo nga mga doktor mismo sa rehabilitation center?
english: Isn't this true, in your honest opinion, you doctors yourselves in the rehabilitation center?

text: May yara sang mabakod nga ebidensya nga ang babaye nga nagabusong ang makalaton sang coronavirus disease 2019 sa lapsag sa iya tago-angkan.
english: There is strong evidence that a pregnant woman can transmit coronavirus disease 2019 to the baby in her womb.

text: Suno kay Claudio Fenizia, lead study author sa University of Milan, sa 31 ka mga babaye nga nagabusong nga gin-admit sa ospital, natukiban ang virus nga yara sa at-term placenta, umbilical cord, vagina kag sa breast milk.
english: According to Claudio Fenizia, lead study author at the University of Milan, in 31 pregnant women admitted to the hospital, the virus was found to be present in the at-term placenta, umbilical cord, vagina and in breast milk.

text: Na-identify man ang specific COVID-19 antibodies sa umbilical cords sang pila ka mga nagabusong amo man sa milk specimens.
english: Specific COVID-19 antibodies were also identified in the umbilical cords of some pregnant women as well as in milk specimens.

text: Bangud sini, posible pahayag sang eksperto ang in-vitro transmission.
english: Because of this, the expert said in-vitro transmission is possible.

text: Napuno sang pagpasalamat ang tagipusuon sang mga deboto nga Ilonggo nga nag-upod sa fluvial kag solemn foot procession.
english: The hearts of the Ilonggo devotees who joined the fluvial and solemn foot procession were filled with gratitude.

text: Kabahin ini sang tuigan nga selebrasyon sang Dinagyang Festival sa Iloilo bilang pagpasidungog kay Señor Santo Niño.
english: This is part of the annual celebration of the Dinagyang Festival in Iloilo in honor of Señor Santo Niño.

text: Isa sa mga nag-upod sa prusisyon amo si Evelyn Garnica, 63-anyos, nga masobra 50 ka tuig na nga deboto.
english: One of those who joined the procession was Evelyn Garnica, 63, who has been a devotee for more than 50 years.

text: Nag-umpisa ini sang naga-upod-upod pa lamang siya sa iya nga iloy sang una kag nadala niya ang pagtuo tubtub nga siya naman ang may kaugalingon nga pamilya.
english: It started when he was still living with his mother and he carried the faith until he had his own family.

text: Ginpasalamatan sini ang Señor Santo Niño sa tanan nga bugay ilabi na sa ikaayong lawas.
english: He thanked Señor Santo Niño for all the blessings especially in health.

text: Suno kay Garnica, mabudlay ang ila pangabuhi ilabi na bangud nawad-an siya sang negosyo sa Iloilo Central Market bangud sa tuman ka pigado nga kita.
english: According to Garnica, their lives are difficult especially since he lost his business in the Iloilo Central Market due to his poor income.

text: Sa iya pagsulod sa simbahan, ginpangabay sini nga bisan sa puraot nga kabuhi, makalikaw sa balatian ang iya mga apo, iya bana, kag iban pa nga katapo sang ila pamilya.
english: As she entered the church, she prayed that even in a short life, her grandchildren, her husband, and other members of their family would be spared the disease.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, apisar masako man sa iya trabaho bilang tricycle driver, naghingalit gid ang isa ka deboto nga si Mild Enriquez nga mag-upod sa prusisyon.
english: Meanwhile, despite being busy with his job as a tricycle driver, a devotee named Mild Enriquez was eager to join the procession.

I know that God will not abandon me, because I am innocent.”

He said he can't describe how he feels right now.

text: Mapatay siya sa Byernes Santo kag magakayab sa Sabado de Gloria.

text: Sa sining aton pagpamalandong sa Semana Santa personal naton ginatagaan sing talupangod kag ginapangamuyuan gid nga makatibawas tani ang Simbahan sa problema sini sa subong sa indi lang madugay.
english: In this reflection on Holy Week, we personally pay attention and pray that the Church will be able to overcome its current problems in the near future.

text: Ina tungod nagapati kita nga ang Maayo gid ang magadaug sa ulihi – kag bisan sa katubtuban – sa sining masakit nga mga iskandalo nga nagapatay-ug sa Simbahan Katolika sa karon.
english: That’s because we believe that the Absolute Good will ultimately – and even forever – triumph over these painful scandals rocking the Catholic Church right now.

text: Apang wala kita nagakatingala sa sining mga hitabo.
english: But we are not surprised by these events.

text: Tandaan naton nga mortal nga kaaway ni Satanas ang Simbahan kag ang mga pari, kag iban pa nga nagapanguna sa sining away sang Maayo kontra Malain.
english: Let us remember that Satan's mortal enemies are the Church and the priests, and others who lead this battle of Good versus Evil.

text: Natural lang nga ang tanan nga kalainan himuon ni Satanas agud indi mangin madinalag-on ini sila sa ila misyon agud luwason ang mga tumuluo padulong sa kaharian sang Diyos.
english: It is only natural that Satan will do all kinds of evil to prevent them from succeeding in their mission to save believers into the kingdom of God.

text: In fact, wala sing katapusan ining away sang Simbahan kag ni Satanas nga nagdala sa Simbahan sa madamo na nga patag-awayan ispiritwal.
english: In fact, there is no end to this struggle between the Church and Satan that has brought the Church to many spiritual battlefields.

text: Pati na gani ang pila ka Papa sang Roma ang nadalahig man sa dalagku nga mga iskandalo.
english: Even some of the Popes of Rome have been involved in major scandals.

text: Apang nalampuwasan ini tanan tubtub sa ining iskandalo naman sa karon.
english: But all of this has been overcome until this scandal is now.

text: Syempre una na dira ang mga pari nga kaaway ni Satanas sa sining padayon nga away sang Simbahan kontra sa Malain.
english: Of course, the priests are the enemies of Satan in this ongoing battle of the Church against Evil.

text: Kag natural lang nga ang mga may mahuyang sing pagtuo kag pagpanikasug ang mauna malaglag.
english: And it is only natural that those who are weak in faith and effort will be destroyed first.

text: In fact, sa kada misa ginaupod ta gid sa aton pagpangamuyo ang Papa kag ang mga relihiyoso agud mabuligan pagpabakud sa ila padayon nga pagpakig-away kay Satanas.
english: In fact, at every mass we include the Pope and the religious in our prayers to help strengthen them in their continued fight against Satan.

text: Tani mahangpan ini sang mga tuod-tuod gid nga mga katoliko kag sa lugar nga kondenahon ipangamuyo pa naton sila.
english: I hope the true Catholics will understand this and instead of condemning us let us pray for them.

text: Gin-aku ni Pope Francis ang ining mga hitabo, nga nagalakip sang “clergy sex abuse” kag ang paghinago (cover-up) sini sang mga pamunuan sa ila nasakupan.
english: Pope Francis has acknowledged these incidents, which include clergy sex abuse and its cover-up by local authorities.

text: Gin-denunsyar ni Pope Francis ining mga kalainan sa diin nahulog ining mga pari kag nanakga nga “koreheran” ini.
english: Pope Francis denounced these evils into which these priests fell and promised to “correct” them.

text: Nangabay siya ugaling nga indi naton pagdid-an ang ining mga nakasala nga mga pari sang aton gugma bisan pa dapat man ini sila manabat sa ila kasal-anan.
english: He asked, however, that we do not withhold our love from these guilty priests even though they must also be held accountable for their sins.

text:
Kon may kondenahon gid man, sunu mismo sa tudlo sang Simbahan, ina ang aton Kasal-anan kag indi ang Makasasala kay may kahigayunan kita tanan agud magbag-o.

Paano?
english:
If there is anything to be condemned, according to the Church itself, it is our sin and not the sinner because we all have the opportunity to change.

How?

text: Wala ini mapaathag, sa aton nahibal-an sa karon, ni Pope Francis kag sang iya mga tulugyanan.
english: This has not been explained, as far as we know at the moment, by Pope Francis and his trustees.

text:
***

Kon ako ang pamangkuton, ang ining mga pari nga nakasala sang pang-abuso sa mga kabataan (a la pedophile) kag sang pagpamentaha sa mga kababaihan dapat patalsikon na halin sa Simbahan.
english:
***

If you ask me, these priests who are guilty of child abuse (a la pedophile) and women's exploitation should be expelled from the Church.

text: Dapat lang, agud lubos nga makakas na ang dagta nga dala nila sa Simbahan.

text:

Pabakudon man ang pagtuo sang mga pari sa ila misyon sa Simbahan kag sa Diyos, sa pagsugod mismo sang ila pagtuon sa pagka-pari.

They should return to private life and repent of their sins and be renewed.

text: Kahapon sang ginpatigayon ang ribbon-cutting ceremony sa pagpanguna ni Obiena kag Ilocos Norte Gov.
english: Yesterday, during the ribbon-cutting ceremony led by Obiena and Ilocos Norte Gov.

text: Matthew Manotoc kag gintambungan sang student-athletes halin sa mga eskwelahan sa probinsya.
english: Matthew Manotoc and was attended by student-athletes from schools in the province.

text: Gintukod ang facility para malab-ot ang World Athletics standards para sa palaabuton nga mga kumpetisyon sang Filipino athletes.
english: The facility was built to meet World Athletics standards for future competitions of Filipino athletes.

text: Magluwas diri, may palaabuton man nga pasilidad sa Tagum, Davao del Norte nga magabukas sa temprano nga bahin sang 2025.
english: Besides, there is also an upcoming facility in Tagum, Davao del Norte that will open in early 2025.

text: Sa Disyembre 6-9, may yara sang pole vault coaching clinic kag seminar sa Marcos Stadium kag si Emerson nga amay ni EJ kag coach sang national team kag UST high school athletics team amo ang magapanguna sa sessions.
english: On December 6-9, there will be a pole vault coaching clinic and seminar at Marcos Stadium and Emerson who is EJ’s father and coach of the national team and UST high school athletics team will lead the sessions.

text: Handum ni Obiena nga maka-produce ang Pilipinas sang dugang nga homegrown pole vault talents nga maga-excel sa mga international competitions rason kun ngaa ginsuguran sini ang pagpatukod sini nga mga facility.
english: Obiena wants the Philippines to produce more homegrown pole vault talents who will excel in international competitions which is why he started building these facilities.

text: Si Obiena isa ka Asian record holder kag nagpang-apat sa Paris Olympics sini nga tuig.
english: Obiena is an Asian record holder and placed fourth at the Paris Olympics this year.

text: Wala sini natapos ang 2024 season bangud sa back injury, apang nagalaum nga makabalik liwat sa masunod nga tuig matapos nga nagnubo na ini sa iya anay ikaduha nga pwesto sa world rankings.
english: He missed the 2024 season with a back injury, but hopes to return again next year after having already dropped to his previous second place in the world rankings.

text: Nagapang-apat siya subong sa ranking kasunod kanday Armand Duplantis sang Sweden, Sam Kendricks sang USA, kag Emmanouil Karalis sang Greece.
english: He is currently ranked fourth behind Armand Duplantis of Sweden, Sam Kendricks of the USA, and Emmanouil Karalis of Greece.

text: Nangin fashion na sang kadam-an ang hair color ukon pagpalugom sang buhok.
english: Hair color has become a fashion for many.

text: Iban sa inyo ang may luyag nga mag eksperimento sang buhok agud nga mangin trendy kag fashionable lantawon.
english: Some of you want to experiment with your hair to look trendy and fashionable.

text: Apang kinahanglan nga man nga mangin mahinalungon sa paglugom sang imo nga buhok bangud mahimo ini makaapekto sa health sang imo buhok amo man sa imo ikaayong lawas.
english: But you also need to be careful with drying your hair because it can affect the health of your hair as well as your health.

text: Suno kay, Manuela Gago-Dominguez, medical doctor kag assistant professor sa Keck School of Medicine, ang paggamit masami sang lugom ang madasig nga makapa-upos sang imo nga buhok.
english: According to Manuela Gago-Dominguez, medical doctor and assistant professor at the Keck School of Medicine, frequent use of bleach can quickly dry out your hair.

text: Ang mga lugom sa buhok ang may yara sang paraphenyldiamine kag labi nga maapektuhan amo ang mga tawo nga may dematitis.
english: Hair dyes contain paraphenyldiamine and are most affected by people with dematitis.

text: Ang mga tawo nga may eczema kag psoriasis ang indi dapat magpalugom sang buhok.
english: People with eczema and psoriasis should not dye their hair.

text: Nagpanglakaak na ang kaso sang whooping cough ukon pertussis sa Japan.
english: Whooping cough or pertussis cases have increased in Japan.

text: Base sa preliminary data halin sa Institute for Health Security, halin sang Hulyo 14-20, naglab-ot sa 3,908 ka mga kaso ang na-report sang mga ospital kag clinic.
english: Based on preliminary data from the Institute for Health Security, from July 14-20, a total of 3,908 cases were reported by hospitals and clinics.

text: Record-high ini sa ika-lima na nga sunod-sunod nga semana.
english: This is a record-high for the fifth consecutive week.

text: Bangud sini, nagdangat na ang cumulative total sa 52,490 ka mga kaso.
english: As a result, the cumulative total has reached 52,490 cases.

text: Suno kay Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent sa Japan, mas mataas ang numero nga ini sa 16,845 cases nga napagkit sa bilog na nga tuig sang 2019.
english: According to Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent in Japan, this figure is higher than the 16,845 cases recorded in the whole year of 2019.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang pertussis isa ka highly infectious bacterial disease nga nagapakita sang mga sintomas kaangay sang trangkaso kag naga-amat-amat lala ang pag-ubo.
english: Pertussis is a highly infectious bacterial disease that causes flu-like symptoms and a progressively worsening cough.

text: Ang mga lapsag amo ang masami naga-develop sang malala nga mga kumplikasyon kaangay sang pneumonia kag encephalitis nga mahimo mangin rason sang kamatayon.
english: Infants are most likely to develop serious complications such as pneumonia and encephalitis that can lead to death.

text: AMAT-amat na naton nahangpan kon ngaa nagtutok gid ang pangontra sa mga akusasyon batok kay Gob Art Defensor, kag indi sa anak nga amo gid ang kandidato sa pagka-gobernador sang Iloilo.
english: WE are gradually understanding why the opposition focused on the accusations against Gob Art Defensor, and not on his son who is the real candidate for governor of Iloilo.

text: Of course, sunu kay Gob, mga patu-patu lang ini nga mga akusasyon sang korapsyon.
english: Of course, according to Gob, these are just false accusations of corruption.

text: Gani  wala anay ginsapak ni Gob.
english: So Gob.

text: Ugaling nangin malisyoso na ini kag ang handom manghalit gid lang.
english: But it has become malicious and the desire is to harm.

text: Gani na-obligar na si Gob sa pag-file sang kaso nga libelo sa pila sini sa ila nga luyag lang mangguba sa malimpyo nga ngalan ni Gob kag sang iya administrasyon.
english: So Gob is obliged to file a case of libel against some of them who just want to tarnish the clean name of Gob and his administration.

text: Pagpatalang lang ini sa ila luyag matabo.
english: It's just misleading what they want to happen.

text: In fact, sa kadugayon ni Gob sa gobyerno – bilang mayor, congressman kag gobernador – wala pa gid ini maakusahan sing anomaliya samtang sa pwesto.
english: In fact, in Gob's tenure in government – ​​as mayor, congressman and governor – he has never been accused of anomalies while in office.

text: Ebidensya ini nga patu-patu lang ining mga akusasyon.
english: This is evidence that these accusations are fabricated.

text: Ang masakit pa kay luyag nila pakalainon si Gob samtang manughalin na ini sa pagka-gobernador sa ulihi na nga tinion sang iya kabuhi sa edad nga dapat magpahuway na.
english: What is more painful is that they want to criticize Gob as he is about to step down as governor at the late stage of his life at the age of retirement.

text: Cruel kag indi ugali Kristiyano!
english: Cruel and unchristian!

text: Indi bala?
english: Isn't it?

text: Ang iban nga naga-retiro ginabinlan sing maayo nga handumanan.
english: Some who retire are left with a good memory.

text: Indi dagta!
english: Not dirty!

text: In fact, bisan ang may malain nga hinimuan – katulad sang mga criminal, rapist kag iban pa – indi gani  naton luyag mulayon pa bilang respeto na lang sa ila pagtaliwan kag sa ila kinamatarong nga ang Diyos na gid lang ang maghusgar sa ila.
english: In fact, even those who have done bad things – such as criminals, rapists and others – we don't even want to praise them out of respect for their passing and their right to be judged by God alone.

text:
***

Sa nauna ta nga pahangop diri, may luyag gid man ang ining mga malisyoso nga luyag matabo sa sining pagpakalain kay Gob, nga indi man gani kandidato sa pagka-gobernador kundi ang iya anak nga si Congressman Toto Defensor.
english:
***

In our previous understanding, these malicious people really want to happen in this insult to Gob, who is not even a candidate for governor but his son Congressman Toto Defensor.

text: Ano ini nga daku nga rason nga luyag nila matabo?
english: What is this big reason they want to happen?

text: Sunu sa isa ka political analyst nga nasugilanon naton, luyag sining mga malisyoso nga gub-on ang credibilidad ni Gob sa iya matarong kag mabungahon nga pang-gobyerno nga luyag niya padayunon ni Toto Defensor.
english: According to a political analyst we spoke to, these malicious people want to destroy the credibility of Gob in his fair and productive governance that he wants Toto Defensor to continue.

text: Kon maguba ang credibilidad ni Gob, nga ginapatay-patayan gid nila himuon, sunu sa sining political analyst, indi na ini magamit ni Toto Defensor sa pag-suporta sang iya kandidatura.
english: If Gob's credibility is damaged, which they are trying to do, according to this political analyst, Toto Defensor will not be able to use it to support his candidacy.

text: Matuod no.
english: True no.

text: Man kon maguba na nila ang credibilidad ni Gob, ano pa abe nga legasiya ni Gob nga magamit ni Toto agud ipasalig man niya sa mga pumuluyo?
english: If they destroy the credibility of Gob, what else is Gob's legacy that Toto can use to assure the people?

text: Syempre, isa pa ka rason amo nga ang kasumpong ni Toto Defensor wala man sing matudlo nga matarong nga hinimuan dira mismo sa iya distrito.
english: Of course, another reason is that Toto Defensor's opponent has nothing to point to in his district.

text: Kay wala ka sing isugid nga maayo nga hinimuan kundi damgo nga wala sing katumanan – luas sa imo negosyo nga ang iban pa ang nagapulos kag indi ang imo distrito (kay sa siyudad sang Iloilo ini nahamtang) – natural lang nga ipaupok mo ang imo kakulangan sa pagpangguba sa kasumpong.
english: Because you have no good deeds to tell but dreams that have no fulfillment – ​​except for your business that benefits others and not your district (because it is located in Iloilo City) – it is natural for you to blame your lack of destruction on the opponent.

text: Kon ako ang kontra sining kasumpong, mapilitan ako matuod nga ibalik sa iya ang iya akusasyon agud mahibal-an niya nga dira mismo sa iya distrito wala man siya gani sang matarong nga hinimuan.
english: If I were the opponent of this opponent, I would be forced to return his accusation to him so that he would know that in his own district he has not done anything right.

text: Kag amo ina ang matuod.
english: And that’s the truth.

text: Madamo pa gani ang mga isyu ang indi pa malimtan sang mga pumuluyo halin pa sa pagpadalagan sining kasumpong ni Gob kag ni Toto sing pila ka beses sadto nga amo ang kabangdanan sang iya pagkalutos.
english: There are even many issues that the people will never forget since this opponent of Gob and Toto ran several times in the past that caused his defeat.

text: Ti, paano abe siya patihan sang mga pumuluyo sa iya ginapasalig nga kaayuhan sa bug-os nga probinsya sang Iloilo nga indi man gani niya mahimo bisan dira lang sa iya distrito?
english: Well, how can the people believe him in his promises of good for the entire province of Iloilo that he cannot even do in his district?

text: Tsk,tsk,tsk!
english: Tsk,tsk,tsk!

text: Sa siling na naton gani, patu-patu lang ining mga akusasyon kay Gob.
english: As we have already said, these accusations against Gob.

text: Gani, indi dapat magduha-duha ang mga pumuluyo nga matindugan ni Toto Defensor ang hayahay sang matarong kag mabungahon nga pang-gobyerno sang iya amay.
english: Therefore, the people should not doubt that Toto Defensor will uphold the legacy of his father's righteous and fruitful governance.

text: In fact, kon may maguba indi si Gob kag si Toto.
english: In fact, if something goes wrong, it's not Gob and Toto.

text: Sila!
english: They!

text: “He who comes to destroy Samarkand shall he himself be destroyed!” ang masiling gani sang tagpangapin ni Gob kag ni Toto sa binutig sang ila mga kasumpong.
english: “He who comes to destroy Samarkand shall he himself be destroyed!” what the defenders of Gob and Toto can say about the lies of their opponents.

text: Aprubado na sa House Committee on Labor and Employment nga ginapangunahan ni Rep.
english: Approved by the House Committee on Labor and Employment led by Rep.

text: Fidel Nograles ang hagna nga may katuyuan nga magpatuman sang P200 across the board wage hike sa private sector.
english: Fidel Nograles the bill that aims to implement a P200 across the board wage hike in the private sector.

text: Sa hearing sang komitiba subong nga adlaw, ginpasar sang house panel ang substitute bill para sa House Bill 514, 756, 7871 kag 10319 nga lunsay mga hagna agud magpatuman sang saka sa sweldo.
english: In the committee hearing today, the house panel passed the substitute bill for House Bill 514, 756, 7871 and 10319 which are both bills to implement the salary increase.

text: Santo sa P200 Daily Across-the-Board Wage Increase Act, tanan nga employers sa pribado nga sektor, agricultural man ukon indi, anuman kadako ang capitalization kag numero sang empleyado ang kinahanglan nga magbayad sang dugang nga P200 sa mga empleyado.
english: According to the P200 Daily Across-the-Board Wage Increase Act, all employers in the private sector, whether agricultural or not, regardless of capitalization and number of employees, are required to pay an additional P200 to employees.

text: Nasaad sa hagna nga ang sin-o man nga indibidwal, korporasyon, trust, firm, partnership, association ukon entity nga magalapas ang mahimo multahan sang P50,000 tubtob P100,000 ukon pagkapreso sang duha tubtob apat ka tuig.
english: The bill states that any individual, corporation, trust, firm, partnership, association or entity that violates the law can be fined P50,000 to P100,000 or imprisoned for two to four years.

text: Ginamanduan man ang employer nga bayaran ang iya empleyado sang doble sang balor sang wala nabayaran nga benepisyo.
english: The employer is also ordered to pay his employee twice the value of the unpaid benefit.

text: Ang Department of Labor and Employment ang magapanguna sa paghimo sang implementing rules and regulations sang layi.
english: The Department of Labor and Employment will take the lead in developing the implementing rules and regulations of the law.

text: INDI man lang gali puro dada kag pamuyawyaw lang si Presidente Duterte kag maisug lang sa mga kayang-kaya n’ya.
english: President Duterte is not just a braggart and a brave man.

text: Maisug man gali siya bisan sa mga kasubong ni Goliath, kag kon medyo kabado siya sa Tsina sadto ina tungod praktikal lang siya.
english: He was brave even against the likes of Goliath, and if he was a little brave in China then it was because he was practical.

text: Kon madala ta man lang sa paghilisugot, ti ngaa mangita gid kita sing kaaway, paathag gani ni Presidente.
english: If we can bring it to consensus, then why should we look for enemies, the President explained.

text: Tungod sini, ginpakamaayo ni Presidente ang makighisugot lang sa Tsina angot sa ila overlapping claims, katulad sang pagsulod sa joint economic venture.
english: Therefore, the President preferred to agree with China on their overlapping claims, such as entering into a joint economic venture.

text: Gina-protestahan ugaling ini sang iban tungod wala salig ang mga pumuluyo sa Tsina.
english: However, some are protesting because the people do not trust China.

text: Sa survey gani, negatibo ang “trust rating” sa Tsina.
english: In the survey, the trust rating in China is negative.

text: Wala man pagsapaka ni Presidente Duterte ang pang-agaw sang Tsina sa Scarborough Shoal kay “aktuhan ta man ini sa husto nga tion”.
english: President Duterte also ignored China's seizure of the Scarborough Shoal because “we will act on it at the right time”.

text: Samtang, ang political opposition padayon nga naga-insistir sa kay Duterte nga maghimo sing mabaskug nga protesta sa Tsina sa pang-agaw sini sa Scarborough kag pang-bully sa aton mga mangingisda sa aton 200-mile EEZ nga may sovereignty rights ang Filipinas sa idalom sang UNCLOS.
english: Meanwhile, the political opposition continues to insist on Duterte to make a strong protest against China for its seizure of Scarborough and bullying of our fishermen in our 200-mile EEZ that the Philippines has sovereignty rights under UNCLOS.

text: Sining ulihi lang ugaling, daw namarasmasan na si Presidente Duterte sa ginpakita sang Tsina sa ugsaran naton sa Pag-asa Island.
english: Recently, however, President Duterte seems to have become aware of what China has shown in our backyard on Pag-asa Island.

text: Nagpakita na ang Tsina sang padayon sini nga malain nga handom agud lubos-luboson na ang pag-agaw sang aton sovereignty rights tubtub sa Pag-asa Island nga sakop man sang aton EEZ.
english: China has already shown its continued evil desire to completely seize our sovereignty rights up to Pag-asa Island which is also part of our EEZ.

text: In fact, daku gid ang aton kakibut nga sobra 200 ka mga salakyan, nga ang madamo sini mga salakyan pang-gyera, ang naghululhut  sa palibot sang Pag-asa Island agud pahugon kita katulad sang ginhimo nga pag-agaw sini sa Scarborough sadtong 2012.
english: In fact, we are shocked that more than 200 vehicles, many of them military vehicles, have been lurking around Pag-asa Island to intimidate us as they did in Scarborough in 2012.

text: Tungod sini, nagpaandam na si Presidente Duterte sa Tsina,samtang ginatawag gihapon ini nga “abyan”, nga kon handom man sang Tsina ang agawon ang Pag-asa ma- “suicide mission” ang mga soldado naton sa Pag-asa Island agud dampigan ini tubtub kamatayon.
english: Because of this, President Duterte has warned China, while still calling it a “friend”, that if China wants to take over Pag-asa, our soldiers on Pag-asa Island will be on a suicide mission to defend it to the death.

text: Timing man ang ining pangisug ni Presidente sa sining ulihi nga pahayag ni US Secretary of State Mike Pompeo nga nagapaandam man sa Tsina nga indi gid pagtandugon ang Filipinas.
english: The President's boldness is also timed with the recent statement of US Secretary of State Mike Pompeo who also warned China not to touch the Philippines.

text: “As the South China Sea is part of the Pacific, any armed attack on any Philippine forces, aircraft, or public vessels in the South China Sea will trigger mutual defense obligations under Article 4 of our [Mutual Defense Treaty],” siling ni Pompeo sa English bag-o ining pagpangisug ni Presidente.
english: “As the South China Sea is part of the Pacific, any armed attack on any Philippine forces, aircraft, or public vessels in the South China Sea will trigger mutual defense obligations under Article 4 of our [Mutual Defense Treaty],” Pompeo said in English before the President's bold move.

text: Sa aton pulong, nagapasalig ang Estados Unidos nga dampigan sini ang Filipinas – ang iya armed forces, eroplano kag salakyan publiko – sa ining pag-athag na sang UN Arbitration Court sadtong 2016 sang aton kinamatarong sa Scarborough kag Pag-asa Island sa sulod sang aton EEZ.
english: In our words, the United States pledges to stand by the Philippines – its armed forces, aircraft and public transportation – in this clarification by the UN Arbitration Court in 2016 of our rights to Scarborough and Pag-asa Island within our EEZ.

text: Well, lain ang sugid sa hulid.
english: Well, the rest is a different story.

text: Tan-awon ta anay kon ano gid ang mahimo sang Estados sa pagdampig sa Filipinas.
english: Let's see what the United States can do to support the Philippines.

text: Indi kita malipat nga ang mayor nga interes sang Estados Unidos amo ang ila “national interest” kag basi paaman lang ang aton interes nga pwede sini ibahig lang.
english: Let us not forget that the main interest of the United States is its “national interest” and maybe our interest is just a warning that it can just ignore.

text:
***

Sa sining Lenten Season, ginahanduraw naton ang pag-antos, kamatayon kag pagkayab ni Jesukristo, nga Diyos nga Isahanon sa tatlo ka manifestacion sang Amay, Anak kag Ispiritu Santo.
english:
***

In this Lenten Season, we imagine the suffering, death and ascension of Jesus Christ, the One God in three manifestations of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.

text: Mayor sa aton sa sining tion ang pagdumdum sang lubos nga pagpalangga sang Diyos sa katauhan.
english: It is important for us at this time to remember God's great love for mankind.

text: Sa kaso sang babaye nga nakasala sing adulteryo, nga sa kasuguan ni Moses dapat batuhon tubtub mapatay, ginsaway niya ang mga nagaakusa sa iya samtang wala man nagpakalain sang kasuguan ni Moses.
english: In the case of the woman guilty of adultery, who under the Mosaic Law was to be stoned to death, he rebuked her accusers while not condemning the Mosaic Law.

text: Siling niya: “Ang wala sing sala maghaboy sang una nga bato.” Kag wala sing bisan isa sa ila ang naghaboy sang bato sa makasasala nga babaye.
english: He said: “Let him that is without sin cast the first stone.” And not one of them threw a stone at the sinful woman.

text: “Wala ko man ikaw gina-kondena.
english: “I’m not condemning you either.

text: Magbag-o ka na kag indi magpakasala…,” siling lang ni Kristo.
english: Repent and do not sin…,” Christ simply said.

text:
Sa krus sang kamatayon, siling ni Kristo: “Amay patawara sila kay wala sila makahibalo sang ila ginahimo!”

Ining ginhimo kag pulong ni Kristo nagapanugyan sang wala katapusan nga kaluoy sang Diyos.
english:
On the cross of death, Christ said: “Father forgive them for they do not know what they are doing!”

These actions and words of Christ suggest the infinite mercy of God.

text: In fact, bisan ang pagmulay sang Diyos ni Presidente Duterte may kapatawaran tungod sunu kay Kristo wala siya kahibalo sang iya ginahimo.
english: In fact, even President Duterte's blasphemy is forgivable because according to Christ he does not know what he is doing.

text: Tuod gid man kay kulang lang ang iya paghangop sa mga doktrina.
english: It was true that he had a lack of understanding of the doctrines.

text: Ang bugay nga kapatawaran sang Diyos, katulad sang donasyon, mabaton lang ugaling kon ginbaton man naton ang aton pagpakasala kag maghinulsol.
english: God's grace of forgiveness, like a donation, can only be received if we also acknowledge our sin and repent.

text: Kon indi, paano ka abe mapatawad?
english: If not, how can you be forgiven?

text: Suspendido ang isa ka intelligence police chief nga nakabase sa Oriental Mindoro bangud sa pagpahog sa isa ka abogado.
english: An intelligence police chief based in Oriental Mindoro has been suspended for threatening a lawyer.

text: Ang pulis amo si Lt.
english: The police officer is Lt.

text: Col.
english: Col.

text: Jaypee De Guzman, hepe sang Provincial Intelligence Unit (PIU) sang Oriental Mindoro Provincial Police Office.
english: Jaypee De Guzman, chief of the Provincial Intelligence Unit (PIU) of the Oriental Mindoro Provincial Police Office.

text: Siya ang gindagdagan sang 60 ka adlaw nga suspensyon matapos mapamatud-an nga guilty sa Conduct Unbecoming of a police officer kag Grave Irregularity in the Performance of Duty kaangot sa R.A. 6713.
english: He was given an additional 60 days suspension after being found guilty of Conduct Unbecoming of a police officer and Grave Irregularity in the Performance of Duty in connection with R.A. 6713.

text: Ang duwa ka mga kaso-administratibo batok kay De Guzman ang gikan sa mga reklamo sang PNP kag ni Atty. Josef Albert Comilang, officer-in-charge sang National Prosecution Service sang Department of Justice nga nakabase sa San Pablo City, Laguna.
english: The two administrative cases against De Guzman are based on complaints by the PNP and Atty. Josef Albert Comilang, officer-in-charge of the National Prosecution Service of the Department of Justice based in San Pablo City, Laguna.

text: Sa statement nga ginpagwa ni Comilang, iya ginsaysay nga sang gab-i sang Pebrero 13, 2025, nakabaton siya sang tawag sa telepono halin kay De Guzman nga nagasiling nga gina-verify sang PNP ang amo nga abogado.
english: In a statement issued by Comilang, he said that on the night of February 13, 2025, he received a phone call from De Guzman saying that the PNP was verifying the lawyer.

text: Namangkot si Comilang kay De Guzman kun ngaa gina-verify ini kag ginsabat siya sang pulis nga ini bangud nga naga serbe ini nga legal counsel sa mga tawo nga may drug cases.
english: Comilang asked De Guzman why he was being verified and the policeman replied that he was serving as a legal counsel to people with drug cases.

text: Bangud sa pahayag ni De Guzman, nagtuga ini sang dako nga kakulba kag kahadlok para sa iya kabuhi kag sang iya pamilya.
english: De Guzman's statement caused great panic and fear for his life and that of his family.

text: Atubangon na sang Gilas Pilipinas karon sa gab-i ang longtime Oceania basketball powerhouse nga New Zealand sa second window sang FIBA Asia Cup 2025 Qualifiers.
english: Gilas Pilipinas will face longtime Oceania basketball powerhouse New Zealand tonight in the second window of the FIBA ​​Asia Cup 2025 Qualifiers.

text: 7:30 ang game time sa Mall of Asia Arena sa Pasay City.
english: 7:30 game time at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay City.

text: Ginahaylo ang Filipino basketball fans nga magsuksok sang “blue” bilang suporta sa national team kag bilang paghingalit sa homecourt advantage batok sa Tall Blacks nga pang-22 sa FIBA ranking.
english: Filipino basketball fans are being encouraged to wear “blue” in support of the national team and in celebration of the homecourt advantage against the Tall Blacks who are 22nd in the FIBA ​​ranking.

text: Sa final 12-man lineup nga gin-release sang Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas (SBP), nakasaad nga magahampang para sa Gilas team sanday Justin Brownlee, June Mar Fajardo, Dwight Ramos, Kai Sotto, Scottie Thompson, Chris Newsome, Calvin Oftana, Japeth Aguilar, CJ Perez, Kevin Quiambao, Carl Tamayo, kag Mason Amos.

text: Wala pa naumpawan sa knee injury ang 6-foot-10 nga si AJ Edu kag indi pa liwat makahampang matapos nga na-miss man sini ang first window sang Asia Cup Qualifiers kag Olympic Qualifying Tournament.
english: 6-foot-10 AJ Edu is yet to recover from a knee injury and is yet to play again after missing the first window of the Asia Cup Qualifiers and Olympic Qualifying Tournament.

english: Also out of the final lineup were Jamie Malonzo with an injury and Ange Kouame who Coach Tim Cone tapped as a backup to Brownlee.

text: Patas ang Pilipinas kag New Zealand sa Group B nga may 2-0 win-loss records.
english: The Philippines and New Zealand are tied in Group B with 2-0 win-loss records.

text: Ini ang ika ika-lima nga pagkitaay sa FIBA tournament halin sang 2016 kun sa diin wala gid nakaagi-daog ang Gilas.
english: This is the fifth meeting in the FIBA ​​tournament since 2016 where the Gilas have never won.

text: Kinahanglan nga makuha sang Pilipinas ang isa sa duha ka nagapanguna nga pwesto sa grupo para nga maka-qualify sa FIBA Asia Cup 2025 nga natalana sa Jeddah, Saudi Arabia sa Agusto 5-17, 2025.
english: The Philippines will need to secure one of the top two spots in the group to qualify for the FIBA ​​Asia Cup 2025 scheduled in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia on August 5-17, 2025.

text: Mangin available ang pila ka mga pulungkuan para sa mga empleyado sang Iloilo Provincial Capitol sa performance Area #2 sa bahin sang Corner Huervana-Luna St.
english: Some seats will be available for employees of the Iloilo Provincial Capitol in performance Area #2 at Corner Huervana-Luna St.

text: sa Lapaz para sa Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan 2026.
english: in Lapaz for the Town Festival 2026.

text: Suno kay Atty. Renee Valencia, iya ginpahayag nga pagahatagan ang kada Department head sang tig-pulo ka mga tickets, apang magadepende ini sa ila kun sin-o sa ila nga mga staff ang ila nga pagahatagan.
english: According to Atty. Renee Valencia, she said that each Department head will be given ten tickets each, but it will depend on them which of their staff they will give.

text: Nahibaluan nga indi man mahatagan ang tanan nga mga empleyado bangud yara sa lima ka libo ang numero sang staff sang Iloilo Provincial Capitol.
english: It is known that not all employees will be given because the number of staff of the Iloilo Provincial Capitol is about 5,000.

text: Sa pihak naman nga bahin, may ara sang nakapain nga 400 free tickets para sa mga supporters sang walo ka mga competing festivals para sa Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan 2026 sa Iloilo Sports Complex.
english: Meanwhile, there are 400 free tickets for supporters of eight competing festivals for Kasadyahan sa Babanwahanan 2026 at the Iloilo Sports Complex.

text: Ini matapos nga ginpahayag ni Gov.
english: This is after Gov.

text: Arthur Defensor Jr., nga luyag nya nga mangin priority ang mga Local Government Units nga nagpasakop sa Kasadyahan.
english: Arthur Defensor Jr., that he wants to give priority to the Local Government Units that participated in the Kasadyahan.

text: BISAN sa gyera may ginasunod nga patakaran kag kasuguan ang mga nagailinaway nga mga pungsod.
english: EVEN in war, warring nations have rules and laws.

text: Indi basta ginapatay na lang ang kaaway – ang nagasungka wala ginapatay, ang Red Cross ginatagaan ligwa nga magbulong ang mga nasamaran sa patag-awayan, kag ang mga POWs (Prisoners of War) wala ginapatay sa gutom kag dapat trataron sing maayo.
english: It is not enough to kill the enemy – those who surrender are not killed, the Red Cross is given time to treat the wounded on the battlefield, and POWs (Prisoners of War) are not starved to death and should be treated well.

text: Sa kinaradto gani nga pagpati, indi basta matandug ang kaaway nga hari.
english: In this belief, the enemy king could not be touched.

text: Sunu pa kay Alexander the Great, isa lang ka hari ang makapatay sang isa man ka hari.
english: According to Alexander the Great, only one king can kill another king.

text: “Only a king can slay a king,” siling gani niya.
english: “Only a king can slay a king,” he said.

text: Gani sa lugar nga tagaan sing padya ang mga soldado nga nagpatay sa hari nga kaaway, iya pa ini ginpamatbatan sila sing silot nga kamatayan.
english: So instead of rewarding the soldiers who killed the enemy king, he sentenced them to death.

text: In other words, kon matratar naton ang kaaway sing may “kabalaka” indi ayhan dapat lang nga mas may “kabalaka” kita sa mga utod naton sa sosyedad, labi na gid kon kabataan, agud indi man sila basta ginapatay lang kag dapat tagaan sing lubos nga kinamatarong sa ila kabuhi?
english: In other words, if we can treat the enemy with “concern” shouldn't we be more “concerned” with our brothers and sisters in society, especially children, so that they are not just killed and should be given full rights to their lives?

text: Ginakasubo gid naton gani nga ang pila ka biktima sang Gyera kontra Droga sang gobyerno nagalakip sang mga menor edad katulad sang 17 anyos nga si Kian Lloyd de los Santos kag ang 5 ka tuig nga si Danica Garcia.
english: We are very sad that some of the victims of the government's War on Drugs include minors such as 17-year-old Kian Lloyd de los Santos and 5-year-old Danica Garcia.

text: Si Kian nagbato kuno sa mga pulis gani ginpatay gid samtang pwede man seguro namedyosan nga madakop lang kay wala man ini armas, samtang si Danica nangin “collateral damage” naman sang ginpatay ang iya amay nga kaangkas niya sa motorsiklo.
english: Kian allegedly threw stones at the police and was killed while he could have been arrested because he had no weapon, while Danica became collateral damage when her father was killed on a motorcycle.

text: Mga 5,000 na ang napatay – na-neutralize, sa lenggwahe mismo ni sadto PNP chief “Bato” de la Rosa – sa police operations, nga  ginkahulugan sang iban sing “ginpatay hungod”.
english: About 5,000 have been killed – neutralized, in the language of former PNP chief “Bato” de la Rosa – in police operations, which some have interpreted as “deliberately killed”.

text: Of course, gin-deny ini sang kapulisan.
english: Of course, the police denied it.

text: Kon i-upod ang pagpatay sa sining mga drug suspects sa vigilantes-style nga pagpatay, katulad sang mga riding-in-tandem, ang napatay sunu sa Children’s Legal Rights and Development Center sang Hulyo 2017 naglab-ut sa 20,000.
english: If the killings of these drug suspects are combined with vigilantes-style killings, such as riding-in-tandems, the death toll according to the Children's Legal Rights and Development Center in July 2017 reached 20,000.

text:
***

Apang dapat lang nga imbestigahan ining pagpatay sang mga pulis sa mga drug suspects agud mapihu gid kon “justified” ukon nakasala gid sila sa sining pagpatay.
english:
***

However, the police killing of drug suspects should be investigated to determine whether they were justified or guilty of the killing.

text: Wala ugaling sing nadangtan ang mga imbestigasyon tubtub natabo si Kian, sa diin nakita gid sa CCTV ang wala kaluoy nga pagpatay sa iya sang mga pulis samtang nagapakitluoy ini.
english: However, investigations reached no conclusion until Kian's incident, where CCTV footage showed the police mercilessly killing him while he was pleading.

text: Gin-akusar ang mga pulis kag nadutlan gid ining mga pulis.
english: The police were accused and these police were very angry.

text: Ini nagsugod na sang mas masigasig nga pag-imbestiga sa mga pulis angot sa ila police operations.
english: This has started a more aggressive investigation of the police regarding their police operations.

text: Gin-petition sang mga pamilya sang mga biktima, sa bulig sang Free Legal Assistance Group (FLAG), sa Korte Suprema agud ipagwa ang mga report kag iban pa nga dokumento angot sining police operations.
english: The families of the victims, with the help of the Free Legal Assistance Group (FLAG), petitioned the Supreme Court to release the reports and other documents regarding these police operations.

text: Nagdaug sila kag ginmando sang Korte Suprema ang pagpagwa sining mga dokumento sang mga police operations nga wala gid paghatag sadto sang kapulisan sa publiko.
english: They won and the Supreme Court ordered the release of these documents of police operations that the police had never given to the public.

text: Nagpasalamat si Vice President Leni Robredo sa sining mando sang Korte Suprema, kag nagsiling nga kinahanglan gid pagwaon ining mga dokumento agud magwa ang mga datos nga makapaathag sang mga hitabo kag kon bala “justifed” ukon nakasala gid man ang mga pulis.
english: Vice President Leni Robredo thanked the Supreme Court for its order, and said it is necessary to release these documents so that data can be released to explain the events and whether the police were “justified” or guilty.

text:
***

Samtang, ginpamilit man ni Senate Minority Leader Franklin Drilon nga dapat kasuhan anay ang mga yara sa druglist bag-o sila hingadlan sa publiko.
english:
***

Meanwhile, Senate Minority Leader Franklin Drilon insisted that those on the druglist should be prosecuted before they are named publicly.

text: Siling niya nga ang Konstitusyon may ginapatuman kon paano husgaran ang mga suspetsado, labi na gid sa idalom sang “due process” nga nagahatag sing “presumption of innocence” sa akusado kag ind basta pagwaon nga “guilty” nga wala sing nagakaigu nga akusahon sa husgado.
english: He said the Constitution requires how to judge suspects, especially under due process which gives the accused a presumption of innocence and will not simply be found guilty without being charged in court.

text: Sa matuod lang, dapat gid man akusahan sila bag-o pagwaon ang ila ngalan sa druglist.
english: In fact, they should be charged before their names are removed from the druglist.

text: Ina agud mapihu gid nga sandig sa ebidensya ang pagsuspetso sa ila.
english: This is to make sure that the suspicion against them is based on evidence.

english: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)

text: Personal na ininspekyon ni DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon ang kontrobersyal na Aganan Flyover sa bayan ng Pavia, Iloilo.
english: DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon personally inspected the controversial Aganan Flyover in Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Ang nakatiwangwang at palpak na flyover ay may total budget na ₱802 million at sinimulang ipatayo noong Hulyo 2020.
english: The abandoned and failed flyover has a total budget of ₱802 million and began construction in July 2020.

text: Ito ay may target completion date dapat sana na 24 buwan o dalawang taon lamang ngunit hanggang ngayon ay nakatengga at hindi pa rin ito napapakinabangan.
english: It has a target completion date that should be 24 months or two years but until now it is pending and it is still not being used.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay Dizon, sinabi nito na may nakalatag nang plano para sa pagpapatuloy ng konstruksyon.
english: When contacted by Bombo Radyo, Dizon said that a plan has been laid out for the continuation of construction.

text: Aniya, ang gagawin nila ngayon ay kumuha ng second opinion mula sa isang foreign consultant at tatagal ito ng isang buwan.
english: He said, what they will do now is get a second opinion from a foreign consultant and it will take a month.

text: Ayon sa kalihim, kapag may go-signal na, sisimulan agad ang final construction.
english: According to the secretary, once there is a go-signal, the final construction will begin immediately.

text: Dagdag pa ni Dizon, kapag natapos ito ngayong taon, ito ang magiging Christmas gift ni Presidente Marcos sa mga Ilonggo.
english: Dizon added that when it is completed this year, it will be President Marcos' Christmas gift to the Ilonggos.

text: Nag-abot sa Buenos Aires, Argentina ang amay ni Liam Payne agud bisitahon ang hotel kun sa diin nahulog kag napatay ang 31-anyos nga former One Direction star.
english: Liam Payne's father arrived in Buenos Aires, Argentina to visit the hotel where the 31-year-old former One Direction star fell to his death.

text: Ginkadtuan sini ang balkonahe sang hotel room kun sa diin natabo ang insidente kag nagkadto man sa vigil sang fans sa guwa sang hotel.
english: He went to the balcony of the hotel room where the incident occurred and also went to the vigil of fans outside the hotel.

text: Nagpasalamat man ini sa fans sang British musician sa pagpangamuyo, pagsindi sang kandila, kag pagbutang sang mga pictures kag bulak para kay Liam.
english: He also thanked the British musician's fans for praying, lighting candles, and putting pictures and flowers for Liam.

text: Antes sina, ginkadtuan man ni Geoff Payne ang morgue sa Buenos Aires agud nga pormal nga ma-identify ang bangkay sang iya anak.
english: Earlier, Geoff Payne also visited the morgue in Buenos Aires to formally identify his son's body.

text: Nagkadto man ini sa prosecutor’s office nga naga-imbestigar sa kaso agud nga matigayon na nga ma-repatriate ang bangkay Liam pabalik sa United Kingdom.
english: He also went to the prosecutor's office investigating the case so that Liam's body could be repatriated back to the United Kingdom.

text: Siya man ang naghapit sa Casa Sur hotel agud nga madala-pauli ang mga personal nga gamit nga nabilin sang iya anak.
english: He also stopped by the Casa Sur hotel to take home the personal belongings left by his son.

text: Huwebes sang aga (oras sa Pilipinas) sang na-report ang gulpyada sini nga kamatayon.
english: His sudden death was reported on Thursday morning (Philippine time).

text:
Base sa Argentina National Prosecutor’s Office, may 25 ka injuries si Payne bangud sa pagkahulog kag ang mayor gid nga rason sang iya kamatayon amo ang “polytraumatism, internal kag external hemorrhage.”

Sa statement sang opisina, ginsiling nga nagguwa sa autopsy nga posible nahulog ang 31-anyos nga musician samtang wala na sang pangalibutan ukon kun may ara man, posible nga naga-agaw-agaw na ang iya nga animo.
english:
According to the Argentina National Prosecutor's Office, Payne sustained 25 injuries from the fall and the main cause of his death was “polytraumatism, internal and external hemorrhage.”

In a statement, the office said the autopsy revealed that the 31-year-old musician may have fallen unconscious or if anything, he may have been unconscious.

text: May subtances man nga nakit-an sa kuwarto ni Payne nga ginpahayag sang prosecutor’s office nga posible makapamatuod sang alcohol kag drug consumption.
english: Substances were also found in Payne's room that the prosecutor's office said could prove alcohol and drug consumption.

text: Ginsaad man sa report nga natul-id sa ila imbestigasyon nga isahanon lamang ini sang natabo ang insidente.
english: The report also promised that their investigation confirmed that he was alone when the incident occurred.

text: Balantayan kun masustiner sang Cleveland Cavaliers ang ila matinlo nga 15-0 record sa ila pag-atubangay sang defending champion nga Boston Celtics alas otso buwas sa aga, Nobyembre 20, oras sa Pilipinas.
english: Watch if the Cleveland Cavaliers can sustain their clean 15-0 record when they face the defending champion Boston Celtics at 8 am tomorrow, November 20, Philippine time.

text: Semi-finals sa Eastern Conference sa NBA playoffs sang nagligad nga tuig sang katapusan nga nagkit-anay ang duha ka teams.
english: Semi-finals in the Eastern Conference in the NBA playoffs last year when the two teams last met.

text: Sang amo nga tion, madamo sang injuries sa roster sang Cavs kag ginlutos sang Celtics sa lima ka hampang tubtub nga dalayon nga naka-abanse ang Boston sa finals kag nakuha ang NBA crown batok sa Dallas Mavericks.
english: At that time, there were many injuries on the Cavs roster and the Celtics beat them in five games until Boston consistently advanced to the finals and won the NBA crown against the Dallas Mavericks.

text: Apang impresibo subong ang hulag sang Cavaliers nga wala pa sang kalutusan sa 15 ka mga hampang sa regular season sa idalom sang bag-o nga coach nga si Kenny Atkinson.
english: But the Cavaliers, who are still unbeaten in 15 regular-season games under new coach Kenny Atkinson, are impressive.

text: Excited na sila sa rematch suno kay Atkinson apisar nga sila ang pangayaw bangud may homecourt advantage sanday Jayson Tatum sa Boston Garden.
english: Atkinson said they are excited for the rematch despite being the foreigners because Jayson Tatum has homecourt advantage at Boston Garden.

text: Ang katapusan nga ginlutos sang Cavs amo ang Charlotte Hornets, 128-114, kahapon sang aga apisar nga wala si All-Star guard Donovan Mitchell nga amo ang ila scoring leader.
english: The Cavs last beat the Charlotte Hornets, 128-114, yesterday morning despite not having All-Star guard Donovan Mitchell as their scoring leader.

text: Ang Cavs amo ang ika-apat ka team sa maragtas sang NBA nga nag-umpisa sang season nga may record nga 15-0.
english: The Cavs are just the fourth team in NBA history to open the season with a 15-0 record.

text: Ini nga winning streak amo na ang pinakamalaba sa 55 ka tuig nga history sang Cavs sa liga nga lapaw pa sa 13-win runs nga nahimo sang team sang yara pa sa ila ang subong Lakers superstar nga si LeBron James.
english: This winning streak is now the longest in the Cavs' 55-year history in the league, surpassing the 13-win runs the team accomplished when they had current Lakers superstar LeBron James.

text: Malayo pa ang ila lalagson sa record nga iya sang Golden State Warriors nanday Stephen Curry nga may 24-0 record sang 2015-2016 season.#
english: They are still far from the record held by Stephen Curry's Golden State Warriors with a 24-0 record in the 2015-2016 season.

text: Nagmando na si US President Donald Trump nga hulagon ang duha ka mga nuclear submarines sang Estados Unidos kag isaylo sa nagakaigo nga mga rehiyon kasunod sa mga pamahog halin kay former Russian President Dmitry Medvedev.
english: US President Donald Trump has ordered the evacuation of two US nuclear submarines and their relocation to appropriate regions following threats from former Russian President Dmitry Medvedev.

text: Wala na gin-mensyonar ni Trump kun sa diin ini nga mga rehiyon apang ginmuno niya nga preparasyon ini pananglitan mangin matuod ang mga tinaga sang anay presidente sang Russia.
english: Trump did not mention where these regions are but said it was a preparation in case the former Russian president's words came true.

text: Nag-ugat ini sa pagbawi ni Trump sang 50 ka adlaw nga deadline agud nga magpasugot ang Russia nga makig-negosyar na agud matapos ang gyera sa Ukraine.
english: This stems from Trump's withdrawal of a 50-day deadline for Russia to agree to negotiate to end the war in Ukraine.

text: Sa baylo nga 50 ka adlaw, ginhimo niya nga 10 tubtub 12 ka adlaw ang deadline; kag kun wala sang kasugtanan nga mahimo, nagpamahog ini sang sanctions.
english: Instead of 50 days, he made the deadline 10 to 12 days; and if no agreement could be reached, it threatened sanctions.

text: Si Medvedev nga amo subong ang deputy chairman sang Russia Security Council ang nagsabat nga mahilig gid si Trump sa paghampang sa mga ultimatum.
english: Medvedev, who is now the deputy chairman of Russia’s Security Council, responded that Trump is very fond of playing with ultimatums.

text: Nagpahanumdom man ini sa US nga may yara ang Russia sang Soviet-era nuclear strike capabilities, kag nagsiling pa nga kada ultimatum nga ginahatag ang isa ka pamahog kag isa ka tikang pakadto sa gyera.
english: He also reminded the US that Russia has Soviet-era nuclear strike capabilities, adding that every ultimatum given is a threat and a step towards war.

text: Sa una nga sabat ni Trump, ginhikayan pa sini si Medvedev kag gintawag nga palpak nga former president nga naga-pinsar nga presidente man siya gihapon subong.
english: In Trump's first response, he even criticized Medvedev and called him a failed former president who thinks he's still president now.

text: Ginpaandaman man ni Trump si Medvedev nga mag-hinay-hinay bangud nagasulod siya sa isa ka delikado nga teritoryo.
english: Trump also warned Medvedev to slow down because he was entering dangerous territory.

text: Wala pa sang komento ang Russia sa latest nga mga statement sang presidente sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Russia has not yet commented on the latest statements by the president of the United States of America.

text: Ginhatagan na sang clearance ang seven-foot-three nga si Kai Sotto nga makaupod sa paghampang sa Gilas Pilipinas batok sa New Zealand kag sa Hong Kong sa FIBA Asia Cup Qualifiers.
english: Seven-foot-three Kai Sotto has been cleared to join Gilas Pilipinas against New Zealand and Hong Kong in the FIBA ​​Asia Cup Qualifiers.

text: Buot silingon sini, makaguwa ang twin tower combo ni Coach Tim Cone upod man si June Mar Fajardo.
english: This means that Coach Tim Cone's twin tower combo with June Mar Fajardo will be out.

text: Antes sini, napaidalom ang big man sa concussion protocols sang Japan B League matapos naigu sa ulo sa matchup sang Koshigaya Alphas batok sa Yokohama sang nagligad nga semana.
english: Earlier, the big man underwent concussion protocols of the Japan B League after being hit in the head in the Koshigaya Alphas matchup against Yokohama last week.

text: Daku nga bulig ang presensya ni Kai sa Gilas bangud ang New Zealand ang magahampang nga may seven-footer kag may 6-foot-10 players.
english: Kai's presence will be a big help to the Gilas because New Zealand will be playing with a seven-footer and with 6-foot-10 players.

text: Nagasalig man si Coach Tim sa chemistry nanday Sotto kag Fajardo kag makahimo makapahuway ang isa kag buslan anay sang isa agud maka-augment sa iban nila nga mas manubo nga players.
english: Coach Tim also trusts the chemistry of Sotto and Fajardo and can rest one and replace the other to augment their other lesser players.

text: Ini ang kulang suno sa coach sang na-injure man si Kai sa semifinal match sang Gilas batok sa Brazil sa Olympic Qualifying Tournament.
english: This was lacking, according to the coach, when Kai was also injured in the Gilas' semifinal match against Brazil in the Olympic Qualifying Tournament.

text: “So it’s a really good rotation.
english: “So it’s a really good rotation.

text: We have the two of them that can play together.
english: We have the two of them that can play together.

text: And then when June Mar rests, Kai can swing to the five.
english: And then when June Mar rests, Kai can swing to the five.

text: And when June Mar comes back, Kai can swing back to the four.
english: And when June Mar comes back, Kai can swing back to the four.

text: And so we have a constant.
english: And so we have a constant.

text: “And that was what was missing when we played (and lost to) Brazil in the semifinals of the OQT (Olympic Qualifying Tournament in Latvia) when Kai got injured.

text: Ano bala ang naga-inspire sa imo nga magtuon sang gamay ka pa?
english: What was it that inspired you to learn when you were little?

english: The stars in your role?

text: Sa Malaysia, agaw-atensyon gid ang regalo sang mag-asawa sa ila lima ka tuig nga bata agud lamang nga ma-engganyo ini nga mag-eskwela na.
english: In Malaysia, a couple gave their five-year-old son a gift to encourage him to go to school.

text: Sini lang nga bulan, may yara sang video ang iloy nga negosyante kun sa diin ginpamangkot sini ang anak nga si Fatima kun ano ang iya gusto para sa iya birthday.
english: Just this month, the business mother had a video where she asked her daughter Fatima what she wanted for her birthday.

text: Sabat sang bata, salakyan.
english: The boy answered, car.

text: Kag indi basta-basta nga salakyan kundi green Mercedes G Wagon ukon BMW.
english: And not just any car but a green Mercedes G Wagon or BMW.

text: Nag-promise man ang bata nga makadto na ini sa school kun hatagan ini sang iya gusto.
english: The boy also promised to go to school if he was given what he wanted.

text: Sa separado pa nga video, nakatabon na ang mata ni Fatima sang gin-sorpresa siya sang iloy kag amay sang isa ka luxury sports utility vehicle bilang iya nga birthday gift!
english: In a separate video, Fatima's eyes were covered when her mother and father surprised her with a luxury sports utility vehicle as her birthday gift!

text: Suno sa iloy, grabe ang excitement sang iya anak nga haluson na sini buy-an ang yabi sang amo nga salakyan.
english: According to the mother, her son was so excited that he almost let go of the keys to the car.

text: Ginpaathag man sang iloy nga nag-desisyon siya kag ang iya bana nga ihatag kay Fatima kun ano ang gusto sini sa iya birthday agud nga ma-motivate ini nga mag-eskwela kag matuman ang iya handum nga mangin isa ka doktor.
english: The mother also explained that she and her husband decided to give Fatima what she wanted for her birthday so that she would be motivated to go to school and fulfill her dream of becoming a doctor.

text: May yara ayhan sang tawo nga wala naka-eksperyensya sang kasakit?
english: Is there anyone who has not experienced pain?

text: Masami sa inyo ang na-akigan sang inyo mga ginikanan bangud sa sala nga inyo ginhimo, may na kontra sa opisina, ukon may yara ikaw sang traumatic experience kaangay sang pagpang-abuso pisikal kag emotional sang tawo nga malapit kag espesyal sa imo.
english: Many of you have been angry with your parents because of a mistake you have made, there has been an opposition in the office, or you have had a traumatic experience such as physical and emotional abuse by someone close and special to you.

text: Ang ini nga mga pilas sa imo tagipusuon ang makatuga sang kaakig kag kalain sang buot.
english: These wounds in your heart can cause anger and resentment.

text: Apang kun ikaw ang sahi sang tawo nga mabudlay mag-patawad, sa ulihe ikaw man sa gihapon ang mabudlayan.
english: But if you are the kind of person who finds it difficult to forgive, you will eventually find it difficult.

text: Pinaagi sa pag-patawad sa tawo nga nakasala sa imo ang makahatag sang kalinongan, paglaom kag kalipay.
english: By forgiving the person who has wronged you can bring peace, hope and happiness.

text: Ang pag let go ukon pagdula sang kalain sang buot ang maka pa-improve sang imo ikaayong lawas kag makahatag sang peace of mind.
english: Letting go of resentment can improve your health and give you peace of mind.

text: Ini ang makahatag sang healthier relationship, makalikaw sa pagbatyag sang anxiety kag stress, makapanubo man sang blood pressure, ma pa-baskog ang immune system, kag maka pa-improve sang imo nga tagipusuon.
english: It can provide healthier relationships, avoid feelings of anxiety and stress, lower blood pressure, strengthen the immune system, and improve your heart.

text: Gani sa imo dira nga may kalain sang buot nga gina tago-tago, tion na agud i-let go ina.
english: So for those of you who are hiding a grudge, it's time to let it go.

text: Ang Diyos nag-patawad sa aton mga sala kag sin-o kita para indi man magpatawad sang aton isig kapareho?
english: God has forgiven our sins and who are we not to forgive our fellow man?

text: Manami mabuhi sa kalibutan kun wala ikaw sang kalain sang buot nga ginadala.
english: It's nice to live in the world when you don't have any bad feelings.

text: Ginpahayag ni Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) Chief of Staff General Romeo Brawner Jr.
english: Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) Chief of Staff General Romeo Brawner Jr.

text: nga may plano ang Pilipinas nga magbakal sang mas madamo pa nga kagamitang militar halin sa pungsod India.

text: Suno kay Gen.
english: According to Gen.

text: Brawner, mataas ang kalidad sang military equipment nga ginahimo sang India, kag indi man ini tuman ka mahal pareho sa iban nga pungsod.

text: Wala niya ginsambit kun ano nga mga kagamitan ang ila gina-target nga baklon bangud sa seguridad nga rason.
english: He did not mention what equipment they were targeting to buy for security reasons.

text: Apang gin-ako niya nga nagapadayon ang proseso sang pagpadala sang India sang BrahMos cruise missile systems nga gin-order sang Pilipinas.
