text: Pila na ang imo edad sang natun-an mo nga magsulat sang tula, essay, ukon bisan gani mag-master sa pag-construct sang maayo nga paragraph?
english: How old were you when you learned to write a poem, an essay, or even mastered constructing a good paragraph?

text: Dalayawon subong ang isa ka apat ka tuig nga bata nga lalaki sa Saudi Arabia nga amo ang ginkilala sang Guinness World Records bilang pinaka-bata nga author sa bilog nga kalibutan matapos naka-baligya na sang masobra isa ka libo ka kopya sang iya libro nga “The Elephant Saeed and the Bear”.
english: A four-year-old boy in Saudi Arabia has been recognized by Guinness World Records as the youngest author in the world after selling more than a thousand copies of his book “The Elephant Saeed and the Bear”.

text: Ang children’s book nga ini ang ginsulat ni Saeed Rashed AlMheiri.
english: This children’s book is written by Saeed Rashed AlMheiri.

text: Istorya ini sang kindness kag wala ginlauman nga pag-abyanay sa tunga sang isa ka elepante kag isa ka polar bear.
english: It is a story of kindness and unexpected friendship between an elephant and a polar bear.

text: Suno sa young author, gusto-gusto gid niya nga ginabasa niya ang iya nga istorya sa iya ginikanan kag mga abyan sa eskwelahan.
english: According to the young author, he loves to read his story to his parents and friends at school.

text: Magluwas sa pagsulat kag pagbasa, isa pa gid sa hilig ni Saeed amo ang mathematics bangud luyag man niya nga mag-solve sang math problems kaupod sa iya nga iloy.
english: Besides writing and reading, another of Saeed's passions is mathematics because he also likes to solve math problems with his mother.

text: Indi man ini bag-o sa pamilya ni Saeed bangud ang nag-inspire sa iya nga makahimo sini nga rekord amo mismo ang iya utod nga babayi nga amo ang former record holder para sa “youngest person to publish a bilingual book (female)” kag “youngest person to publish a bilingual book series (female)” sang siya naga-edad pa lamang sang walo ka tuig.
english: This is also nothing new to Saeed’s family as what inspired him to make this record was his own sister who was the former record holder for “youngest person to publish a bilingual book (female)” and “youngest person to publish a bilingual book series (female)” when she was just eight years old.

text: Gin-share man ni Saeed nga dungan sila sang iya magulang nga nagabasa, nagasulat, kag naga-enjoy sa ila drawing kag iban pa nga activities bilang mga bata.
english: Saeed also shared that he and his brother read, wrote, and enjoyed their drawing and other activities as children.

text: Sa bata nga edad, may ginlunsar man ang utod nga babayi nga “Books from Children to Children” initiative nga amo ang naga-engganyo sa mga bata edad apat tubtub 10 ka tuig nga mag-sulat, mag-illustrate, kag maghimo sang libro para sa iban nga mga kabataan.
english: At an early age, the sister also launched the “Books from Children to Children” initiative which encourages children aged four to 10 to write, illustrate, and make books for other children.

text: Masako na subong ang mag-utod para sa ila masunod nga mga libro kag handa man nga mang-guba sang masunod nga mga rekord sa kalibutan.
english: The brothers are now busy for their next books and also ready to break the next world records.

text: Apat ang napatay kag walo naman ang pilason sang gin-arado sang truck ang mga salakyan kag mga balay sa Isabang, Lucena City.
english: Four people were killed and eight others injured when a truck plowed into vehicles and houses in Isabang, Lucena City.

text: Suno sa impormasyon, nadulaan sang kontrol ang truck kag nagkalayo ng royda sini kag ginbungguan ang mga naka-park nga salakyan.
english: According to reports, the truck lost control and its wheels caught fire and hit the parked vehicles.

text: Nalab-ot man sini ang tatlo ka mga balay kag iban pa nga naga-park nga salakyan sa lugar.
english: It also struck three houses and other parked vehicles in the area.

text: Sa kabaskog sang impact, nagkalaguba ang mga balay samtang nagkalayo naman ang iban nga salakyan.
english: With the force of the impact, houses were destroyed while other vehicles were burned.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sa insidente.
english: The investigation into the incident is ongoing.

text: Naatrasar ang pagdeklarar sang food security emergency sa Pilipinas.
english: The declaration of food security emergency in the Philippines has been delayed.

text: Suno kay Department of Agriculture (DA) spokesman Arnel de Mesa, wala pa gihapon nakaabot sa ila ang resolusyon nga ginpasar sang National Price Coordinating Council (NPCC).
english: Department of Agriculture (DA) spokesman Arnel de Mesa said the resolution passed by the National Price Coordinating Council (NPCC) has not yet reached them.

text: Santo sa nauna nga pahayag ni DA Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel, Jr., kun makaabot na sa ila, repasuhon pa ini sang duha ka adlaw antes ideklarar.
english: According to DA Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel, Jr., once it reaches them, it will be reviewed for two days before being declared.

text: Ang ginapatuhuyan sini amo ang price council resolution nga naga-rekomendar sang deklarasyon sang food emergency bangud sa nakit-an nga extraordinary increase sa presyo sang bugas sa mga merkado.
english: He was referring to the price council resolution recommending the declaration of a food emergency due to the extraordinary increase in the price of rice in the markets.

text: Magluwas sa tiglikom sang DA, ang iban pa nga mga miyembro sang NPCC amo ang mga head sang Department of Trade and Industry, Department of Health, Department of Environment and Natural Resources, Department of the Interior and Local Government, kag iban pa.
english: Apart from the DA secretary, other members of the NPCC are the heads of the Department of Trade and Industry, Department of Health, Department of Environment and Natural Resources, Department of the Interior and Local Government, among others.

text: Una kuntani nga gin-schedule ang deklarasyon Enero 22, ukon kahapon.
english: The declaration was originally scheduled for January 22, or yesterday.

text: May nauna naman nga pahayag si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. made an earlier statement.

text: nga pabor siya sa sini nga tikang agud pwersahon na nga magnubo ang presyo sa mga merkado bangud mataas man gihapon ini apisar ginpanubo na ang taripa.
english: He said he is in favor of this move to force the price down in the markets because it is still high despite the reduction in tariffs.

text: Nakahimo sang iya madinalag-on nga pagbalik ang Filipina skater Margielyn Didal sa isa ka kompetisyon sa Buenos Aires, Argentina matapos ang malawig nga pagpahuway.
english: Filipina skater Margielyn Didal made her triumphant return to a competition in Buenos Aires, Argentina after a long break.

text: Nangibabaw ang Tokyo Olympian kag 2018 Asian Games gold medalist Margielyn Didal sa Buenos Aires Conquest sa University of Buenos Aires Law School, sa iya pinakauna nga event humalin sang nagsuprir ini sang ankle injury sang October 2022.
english: Tokyo Olympian and 2018 Asian Games gold medalist Margielyn Didal dominated the Buenos Aires Conquest at the University of Buenos Aires Law School, in her first event since suffering an ankle injury in October 2022.

text: Ginpierde niya ang top female skaters sa kalibutan kalakip na ang Argentinian nga si Aldana Bertran kag Brazilian Leticia Bufoni sa qualifying round, kag isa pa ka Argentinian nga si Camila Cáceres sa semi finals.
english: She defeated top female skaters in the world including Argentinian Aldana Bertran and Brazilian Leticia Bufoni in the qualifying round, and another Argentinian Camila Cáceres in the semi finals.

text: Gin-atubang niya ang Dutch skateboarder nga si Roos Zwetsloot sa finals kun sa diin gindala pauli sang Filipino athlete ang championship trophy.
english: He faced Dutch skateboarder Roos Zwetsloot in the finals where the Filipino athlete took home the championship trophy.

text: MAY REKLAMO kami sa PLDT, nga tani masabat sini sing lubos sa indi na magdugay.
english: We HAVE A COMPLAINT with PLDT, which hopefully it will address fully soon.

text: Sa sobra tunga sa bulan (Enero 15 – Pebrero 6) na ang ugtas namon sa bisyohan nga wi-fi connection, pero wala kami tubtub subong makabaton sing deduction sa amon bill angot diri sa sulod na sang duha ka bulan (Pebrero kag Marso).
english: For more than half a month (January 15 – February 6) we have been cut off from the addictive wi-fi connection, but we have not yet received a deduction from our bill in this regard for two months (February and March).

text: In fact, sadtong Disyembre 2018 pa ang pagbisyo sang amon wi-fi, nga importante gid kaayo para sa akon.
english: In fact, our wi-fi was broken in December 2018, which is very important to me.

text: Sa masami naga-email ako sang madamo nga mensahe, sang gina-edit ko online, kag sang akon kolum nga ginapadala ko sa Panay News duha ka beses kada semana.
english: I usually email a lot of messages, what I edit online, and my column that I send to Panay News twice a week.

text: Apang gin-antos ko lang ini, kag sang iban pa nga myembro sang amon pamilya nga masami man nagagamit sang wi-fi, tubtub nga indi na gid kami makaagwanta.
english: But I just put up with it, and other members of our family who also use wi-fi often, until we couldn't take it anymore.

text: Gani nagreklamo ako sa upisina sang PLDT Iloilo sadtong Enero 15, 2019.
english: So I complained to the PLDT Iloilo office on January 15, 2019.

text: Nagbalik ako sa upisina sang PLDT Iloilo sadtong Enero23 kay nagbisyo liwat ang wi-fi.
english: I went back to the PLDT Iloilo office on January 23 because the wi-fi was broken again.

text: Liwat nagbisyo ini kag liwat ginreklamo ko sang Enero 26.
english: It got addicted again and I complained again on January 26th.

text: Kag liwat nagbisyo nga ginreklamo ko naman sadtong Pebrero 4.
english: And again, I complained about it on February 4th.

text: Ginkadtuan ini sang contractor duha ka adlaw despues kag nakaayo na ini liwat.
english: The contractor visited it two days later and it was back on track.

text: In fact, isa lang ka semana ang nagligad kag nagbulubisyo naman ining wi-fi connection namon tubtub karon.
english: In fact, it's only been a week and our wi-fi connection is still working.

text: Indi gid man masyado kaulugtasan gani ginapasensyahan ko anay.
english: It's not too much trouble so I'll be patient.

text: Kon sumahon mo gani ang perhwisyo sa amon, daw indi mo mabayaran ini sing linibu ka pesos.
english: If you add up the damage to us, it seems that you cannot pay for it in thousands of pesos.

text: Na-obligar na gani ako sa paggamit sang isa ka wireless nga wi-fi nga gadget agud lang makasulod sa internet sa madamo nga kahigayunan.
english: I have even been forced to use a wireless wi-fi gadget just to access the internet on many occasions.

text: Kag halos P50 gani ang ginagasto ko diri sa kada tion nga ginagamit ko ini.
english: And I spend almost P50 on it every time I use it.

text: Kon makapaabot pa kami sing deduction sa perhwisyo sang amon wi-fi connection, palihog lang Mr. PLDT indi na kami pagpaugtasa pa gid sing hulat.
english: If we can still expect a deduction for the loss of our wi-fi connection, please Mr. PLDT don't make us wait any longer.

text: Amen!
english: Amen!

text:
***

WALA naluyagan kag ginkasubo gid sang mga senior citizen ang panugdaon kontra kay Gobernador Defensor, nga isa man ka senior citizen, nga ginatudlo sang pila ka pumuluyo sa kay Congressman Ferjenel Biron.
english:
***

SENIOR citizens are not happy and saddened by the proposal against Governor Defensor, who is also a senior citizen, which some residents point to Congressman Ferjenel Biron.

text: “Si Gobernador Defensor tam-an na katigulang, dali na lang ina mapatay…,” sugid kuno sang isa ka taga-Passi kay Gob nga ginsiling mismo ni Congressman Biron sa isa ka miting nila.
english: “Governor Defensor is very old, he will soon die...,” a Passi resident allegedly told Gob that Congressman Biron himself said in a meeting between them.

text: Mga 78 anyos na seguro si Gob, apang mapagsik pa ini kag wala nagapalya sa pag-report sa kapitolyo kag sa kon diin pa agud atubangon ang iya mga obligasyon.
english: Gob is probably about 78 years old, but he is still active and does not fail to report to the capitol and elsewhere to face his obligations.

text: May nahibal-an gani ako nga 104 anyos na ang edad nga nakapangasawa pa sing tinedyer kag nakabata pa sila.
english: I even know someone who is 104 years old who still married a teenager and they still have children.

text: Ano pigaw!
english: What a poor man!

text: Nabatian man ni Gob ining sugilanon sa banwa sang Leon sang nag-miting sila didto.
english: Gob also heard this story in Leon town when they had a meeting there.

text: Sa ila miting sa Alimodian, may nagpalapit gani nga mga senior citizen nga nagpautwas gid sang ila kaakig kag kahanusbo sa sining pag-wish sing malain, ukon pagtuloy, kay Gob.
english: During their meeting in Alimodian, some senior citizens even approached and expressed their anger and disappointment at this bad wish, or insult, to Gob.

text: Naghibi gani ang pila sa ila.
english: Some of them even cried.

text: “Tani mag-amlig man ang aton mga kontra sa pagbuhi sang kasubong nga panugdaon kay samtang luyag pa sang iban nga maglawig pa ang aton kabuhi tungod madamo pa kita sing kaayuhan nga mahatag sa pumuluyo, sila iya luyag nga mapatay kita dayon,” siling gani ni Gob.
english: “I hope our opponents will also be careful in reviving such a proposal because while others want us to live longer because we have many benefits to give to the people, they want us to die immediately,” said Gob.

text: Gin-deny kuno ining pagtuloy kay Gob ni Mayor Kalay sang Alimodian, kag gin-deny man ini sang chief of staff ni Congressman Biron.
english: Mayor Kalay of Alimodian denied this extension to Gob, and Congressman Biron's chief of staff also denied it.

text: Sin-o ayhan sa ila ang nagasugid sing matuod?
english: Which of them is telling the truth?

text: Si Mayor Kalay bala?
english: Is it Mayor Kalay?

text: Ang chief of staff bala ni Biron?
english: Is it Biron's chief of staff?

text: Ukon ang mga tigulang nga nagsugid sini kay Gobernador Defensor?
english: Or the elders who told Governor Defensor about it?

text: Kon si Gob ugaling ang pahambalon, natural lang nga apinan ni Mayor Kalay (kag sang chief of staff ni Biron) si Congressman.
english: If Gob is asked to speak, it is only natural that Mayor Kalay (and Biron's chief of staff) will defend Congressman.

text: Wala ugaling nagtugda si Gob kon bala mapatihan ang mga tigulang nga nagsugid sining malain nga panugdaon kontra sa iya.
english: However, Gob did not suggest whether the elders who told this bad proposal against him could be believed.

text: Ano bala ang pakot n’yo?/PN
english: What is your net?/PN

text: Nagpaandam si British Prime Minister Keir Starmer nga posible na kilalahon sang Britanya bilang estado ang Palestinian sa Setyembre, kun indi maghimo sang konkreto nga mga tikang ang Israel agud tapuson ang krisis sa Gaza.
english: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer has warned that Britain could recognize the Palestinians as a state in September, if Israel does not take concrete steps to end the crisis in Gaza.

text: Sa iya pahayag, ginpunto ni Starmer nga dapat untaton ang giyera, tugutan ang padayon nga pagpasulod sang humanitarian aid, kag likawan ang ilegal nga pagpang-angkon sang mga teritoryo sa West Bank.
english: In his statement, Starmer pointed out that the war must be stopped, the continued flow of humanitarian aid allowed, and the illegal acquisition of territories in the West Bank avoided.

text: Ang warning nga ini, nagguwa matapos ang report sang Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) nga nagapakita nga naglab-ot na sa lebel sang tagutom ang kahimtangan sa Gaza.
english: The warning came after the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) report showed that the situation in Gaza had reached the level of famine.

text: Suno sa report, nagtaas man ang numeri sang nga napatay bangud sa gutom kag malnutrisyon, lakip na ang 88 ka mga kabataan.
english: According to the report, the number of deaths due to hunger and malnutrition also increased, including 88 children.

text: Ginkondenar naman ini ni Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, kag ginsiling nga ang pagkilala sa Palestinian ang possible reward lang sa terorismo nga ginahimo sang Hamas.
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu condemned the move, saying that recognition of the Palestinians is the only possible reward for the terrorism committed by Hamas.

text: Samtang, ginpahayag naman ni US President Donald Trump nga indi siya pabor sa paghatag sang reward sa Hamas, apang wala niya ini ginabalabagan ang desisyon sang Britain.
english: Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump said he was not in favor of rewarding Hamas, but he did not object to Britain's decision.

text: Magatipon na liwat ang Gilas Pilipinas para sa panibag-o nga misyon nga lutuson ang New Zealand kag ang Hong Kong sa FIBA Asia Cup qualifiers.
english: Gilas Pilipinas will reunite for a new mission to beat New Zealand and Hong Kong in the FIBA ​​Asia Cup qualifiers.

text: Sa pagpanguna sa gihapon ni Coach Tim Cone, magahanas ang national team sa Inspire Sports Academy sa Laguna para sa preparasyon sa una nga duha ka hampang nga diri mismo sa patigayunon sa Pilipinas.
english: Still led by Coach Tim Cone, the national team will train at the Inspire Sports Academy in Laguna in preparation for the first two games to be held here in the Philippines.

text: Sa Nobyembre 21, atubangon sang Gilas ang world no.
english: On November 21, the Gilas will face world no.

text: 22 nga New Zealand nga may pareho nga 2-0 record.
english: 22 New Zealand with an identical 2-0 record.

text: Tatlo ka adlaw ang makaligad, may rematch ini sa Hong Kong nga may 0-2 record subong kag una naman nga gintambakan sang Gilas sang Pebrero sa skor nga 94-64.
english: Three days later, it had a rematch in Hong Kong with an 0-2 record now and was first beaten by the Gilas in February with a score of 94-64.

text: Sa lista sang 15 players ni Cone, nalakip si AJ Edu nga naka-recover na subong matapos nga wala gid nakahampang sa first window sang FIBA Olympic Qualifying Tournament bangud sa injury.
english: Cone's list of 15 players includes AJ Edu, who is now recovering after missing the first window of the FIBA ​​Olympic Qualifying Tournament due to injury.

text: Yara man ang former Ateneo big man nga si Ange Kouame nga maga-upod kay Justin Brownlee bilang naturalized player.
english: There is also former Ateneo big man Ange Kouame who will join Justin Brownlee as a naturalized player.

text: Ini ang iya una nga pagbalik sa Gilas sa sulod sang duha ka tuig matapos ang katapusan sini nga hampang sa FIBA World Cup Asian Qualifiers sang 2022.
english: This will be his first return to the Gilas in two years after its last appearance in the FIBA ​​World Cup Asian Qualifiers in 2022.

text: Pamilyar na ang iban nga nawong nga nabilin sa team nga ginpili ni Cone nga amo sanday PBA stars June Mar Fajardo, Scottie Thompson, Japeth Aguilar, Calvin Oftana, Chris Newsome, CJ Perez, kag Jamie Malonzo.
english: Some of the faces left on Cone's team are familiar, namely PBA stars June Mar Fajardo, Scottie Thompson, Japeth Aguilar, Calvin Oftana, Chris Newsome, CJ Perez, and Jamie Malonzo.

text: Magahatag-pwersa man sa team ang players halin sa Japan B. League nga sanday Edu, Dwight Ramos, kag Kai Sotto.
english: The team will also be bolstered by players from the Japan B. League Edu, Dwight Ramos, and Kai Sotto.

text: Halin naman sa Korean Basketball League, yara si Carl Tamayo; kag magabulig man ang UAAP stars nga sanday Kevin Quiambao kag Mason Amos sang La Salle.
english: From the Korean Basketball League, there are Carl Tamayo; and UAAP stars Kevin Quiambao and Mason Amos of La Salle will also help.

text: Ini ang una nga hampang sang Gilas apat ka bulan matapos ang maragtason nga 89-80 nga upset batok sa World No.
english: It’s the Gilas’ first game four months after a historic 89-80 upset against World No. 1 overall.

text: 6 nga Latvia sa FIBA Olympic Qualifying Tournament kag ginkabos sang duha gid lamang ka hampang para maka-qualify kuntani sa Paris Olympics.#
english: 6 Latvia in the FIBA ​​Olympic Qualifying Tournament and lost only two games to qualify for the Paris Olympics.

text: Normal nga maka eksperyensya sang pag-kabalaka kag kasubo sa kabuhi sa tunga sang mga pagbag-o tuga sang coronavirus disease 2019 pandemic.
english: It is normal to experience anxiety and sadness in life amid the changes caused by the coronavirus disease 2019 pandemic.

text: Suno kay Dr. Joan Mae Rifareal, isa ka psychiatrist, indi malikawan nga makabatyag sang kakulba kag kasubo subong bangud nagakadula ang kontrol kag kasiguraduhan ang mga tawo angot sa dalagan sang kabuhi.
english: According to Dr. Joan Mae Rifareal, a psychiatrist, said it is inevitable to feel anxious and sad now that people are losing control and certainty about the course of life.

text: Pahayag niya, okay lang nga i-acknowledge ang inyo nabatyagan subong kag indi ini senyales nga mahina ang imo nga character.
english: He said it's okay to acknowledge your feelings now and it's not a sign that your character is weak.

text: Bangud sini, naghatag sang pila ka mga “healthy coping skills” ang doktor kaangay sang pagkaon sang mga masustansya nga pagkaon, pag-angkon sang bastante kag manami nga tulog kag pagpabilin sang “social connectedness” ukon relasyon sa iban tawo.
english: Because of this, the doctor gave some “healthy coping skills” such as eating nutritious foods, getting enough and good sleep and maintaining “social connectedness” or relationship with other people.

text: Panuyag ni Rifareal, limitahan man ang paggamit sang social media — mahimo nga duha lang ka beses mag check sang social media feed sa isa ka adlaw.
english: Rifareal suggests limiting your use of social media — you can only check your social media feed twice a day.

text: Ini bangud nga ang masobra nga paggamit sang social media ang maka-dugang lang sang aton pagbatyag sang anxiety.
english: This is because excessive use of social media can only increase our feelings of anxiety.

text: Nakastiguhan sang iya bana ang isa ka asawa nga wala naghatag sang inugbakal sang shabu.
english: Her husband punished a wife who did not give her money to buy shabu.

text: Natabo ini sa sulod mismo sang ila balay sa Brgy.
english: This happened inside their house in Brgy.

text: Poblacion Pardo, Cebu City.
english: Pardo Population, Cebu City.

text: Ang suspek amo si Arnold Navares, 48-anyos , isa ka kilala nga adik sa ila nga lugar.
english: The suspect was identified as Arnold Navares, 48, a known addict in the area.

text: Ang biktima amo si Mercedita, 50-anyos.
english: The victim was identified as Mercedita, 50 years old.

text: Suno sa biktima, nagpauli ang iya nga bana kag nangayo sang kwarta para magbakal sang shabu kag magpatigayon sang pot session kaupod ang mga abyan.
english: According to the victim, her husband came home and asked for money to buy shabu and have a pot session with friends.

text: Wala sang may nahatag ang asawa gani nangakig ang bana kag ginkastigo ini tubtob nga nalipong.
english: The wife did not give anything so the husband became angry and beat her until she fainted.

text: Sang naumpawan,didto lang ini kag nakapangayo sang bulig.
english: When he was relieved, he stayed there and asked for help.

text: Natigayon nga maaresto ang suspek kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act (RA) 9262 ukon ang Anti-Violence Against Women and their Children Act of 2024.
english: The suspect was arrested and is facing charges of violation of Republic Act (RA) 9262 or the Anti-Violence Against Women and their Children Act of 2024.

text: Nahulog sa nakabukas nga trap door sang stage sa tunga sang iya nga concert si Olivia Rodrigo sa Melbourne, Australia.
english: Olivia Rodrigo fell through an open trap door of the stage in the middle of her concert in Melbourne, Australia.

text: Tuman naman nga nagkabalaka ang fans ni Olivia para sa iya bangud sa insidente.
english: Olivia's fans were very worried about her because of the incident.

text: Gilayon naman nga nagsaka balik sa stage si Olivia kag ginsiling nga okay lang ini.
english: Olivia immediately went back on stage and said it was okay.

text: Ang iya show sa Australia ang kabahin sang iya Guts Tour nga ginpatigayon man sa Pilipinas sang nagligad nga semana.
english: His show in Australia is part of his Guts Tour which was also held in the Philippines last week.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 –  Magapatigayon ang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) sang piso caravan.
english: January – The Central Bank of the Philippines (BSP) will conduct a piso caravan.

text: Ini ang kadungan man sang pagselebrar sang Dinagyang Festival.
english: This is also in conjunction with the celebration of the Dinagyang Festival.

text: Suno sa BSP, kabahin ini sang ila ginaduso nga Clean Note and Coin Policy sa diin mahimo nga pabalyuhan ang mga higko, dunot kag gision nga mga kwarta sa Piso Caravan booth sang Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI)-Solis Branch, Iloilo City.
english: According to the BSP, this is part of its proposed Clean Note and Coin Policy where dirty, rotten and torn banknotes can be exchanged at the Piso Caravan booth of the Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI)-Solis Branch, Iloilo City.

text: Maga-umpisa ini bwas, Enero 23, las 10:00 sa aga tubtob la 1:00 sa hapon.
english: It will start tomorrow, January 23, from 10:00 am to 1:00 pm.

text: Usisa-on naman ang kwarta base sa 3S (size, signature, kag security thread) nga santo sa pagsulundan sang BSP.
english: The money will be checked based on 3S (size, signature, and security thread) in accordance with BSP guidelines.

text: Para sa mga BSP-supervised financial institutions nga luyag makigbahin sa Piso Caravan Program, makig-angot lang sa pinakamalapit nga BSP regional office ukon branch sa inyo lugar.
english: For BSP-supervised financial institutions wishing to participate in the Piso Caravan Program, simply contact the nearest BSP regional office or branch in your area.

text: Nagbukas ang Criminal Investigation and Detection Group ukon CIDG sang hotline agud magbaton sang tawag ukon impormasyon nga makatudlo sa negosyante nga si Atong Ang.
english: The Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) has opened a hotline to receive calls or information that can identify businessman Atong Ang.

text: Kasunod ini sang P10 Million nga reward nga gintanyag sang Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) sa sin-o man nga makatudlo sa amo nga wanted person.
english: This follows the P10 million reward offered by the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) to anyone who can identify the wanted person.

english: According to the Department of Foreign Affairs, the UAE’s decision to grant clemency to Filipinos during the Eid al-adha festival in June was a “generous and benevolent gesture”.

text: Pahayag sang ahensya, ini pamatuod sang mabakod nga bilateral nga relasyon sa tunga sang Pilipinas kag UAE.

text: 𝗣𝗔𝗩𝗜𝗔, 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Liwat nga magapapili bilang alkalde sang Pavia, Iloilo si Mayor Laurence Anthony ‘Luigi’ Gorriceta.
english: Pavia, Iloilo – Mayor Laurence Anthony 'Luigi' Gorriceta will run again as mayor of Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Gorriceta, iya ginpahayag nga last term niya subong bilang alkalde.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Gorriceta said this is his last term as mayor.

text: Suno kay Luigi, madamo pa siya sang programa nga ipatuman kun liwat nga mapilian bilang alkalde.
english: Luigi said he has many more programs to implement if he is re-elected as mayor.

text: Nagpasalamat man ini sa mga pumuluyo sang Pavia sa ginhatag nga suporta sa iya.
english: He also thanked the people of Pavia for the support given to him.

text: Magluwas diri, ginpasalamatan man sini ang Florete Group of Companies sa mga bulig indi lang sa iya kundi mangin sa Pavia.
english: He also thanked the Florete Group of Companies for their assistance not only to him but also to Pavia.

text: Mangin running mate naman ni Gorriceta si Vice Mayor Edsel “Bibo” Gerochi.
english: Gorriceta's running mate will be Vice Mayor Edsel “Bibo” Gerochi.

text: Nag-isyu si Mayor Raisa Treñas sang Executive Order No.
english: Mayor Raisa Treñas issued Executive Order No.

text: 006 Series of 2026 nga naga-provide sang safety kag security measures sa tunga sang Dinagyang Festival Celebration.
english: 006 Series of 2026 providing safety and security measures during the Dinagyang Festival Celebration.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga Gorzal, spokesperson ni Mayor Raisa, iya ginpahayag nga ang E.O. nagatuyo nga mahatag ang nagakaigo nga kaluwasan kag seguridad sang tanan nga responders, VIPs, turista, bisita, kag mga pumuluyo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga Gorzal, spokesperson of Mayor Raisa, said the E.O. aims to ensure the proper safety and security of all responders, VIPs, tourists, visitors, and residents.

text: Suno kay Gorzal, ini nga mando nagatukod sang mga security protocols nga ginapatuman sang Iloilo City Police Office upod sa AFP, kapulisan, kag iban pa nga ahensya sang gobyerno.
english: According to Gorzal, this order establishes the security protocols implemented by the Iloilo City Police Office together with the AFP, police, and other government agencies.

text: Lakip sa mga ginadumilian amo ang pagpalupad sang drones nga wala sang permit, pagsindi sang firecrackers nga wala sang permiso, pagdala sang armas, pag-inom kag abusive behavior nga nagaresulta sang peligro sa publiko, kag paghiwat sang political rallies ukon anti-government protests sa sulod sang selebrasyon.
english: Among the prohibitions are flying drones without a permit, lighting firecrackers without a permit, carrying weapons, drinking and abusive behavior that results in danger to the public, and holding political rallies or anti-government protests during the celebration.

text: Ginalimitahan man ang pagbaligya kag pag-inom sang makahulubog nga ilimnon halin alas 8:00 sang aga tubtob alas 2:00 sang kaagahon sa mga adlaw sang Enero 22–26, 2026.
english: The sale and consumption of alcoholic beverages is also restricted from 8:00 am to 2:00 am on the days of January 22–26, 2026.

text: Ang tanan nga ahensya sang syudad, kapulisan, barangay officials, kag volunteer force multipliers ginmanduan nga magbuligay sa pagpatuman sang ini nga mga regulasyon agud mangin malinong kag masadya ang Dinagyang Festival.
english: All city agencies, police, barangay officials, and volunteer force multipliers are instructed to cooperate in the implementation of these regulations to ensure a peaceful and happy Dinagyang Festival.

text: KON DAYON ang pagpatuman sang mando ni Labor Secretary Silvestre Bello III sang bag-o nga skema sa kita (earning) sang mga bus driver, may fixed salary na ini sila sugod sa Sabado, Marso 9.
english: IF Labor Secretary Silvestre Bello III's new earnings scheme for bus drivers is implemented immediately, they will have a fixed salary starting Saturday, March 9.

text: ‘Mangin katulad na sila sa mga regular nga mga empleyado,” siling ni Bello.
english: “They will be like regular employees,” Bello said.

text: Sa idalom sa sining skema sang kita sang mga bus driver, ang mga bus driver, lakip na ang mga conductor, magabaton na sang sweldo nga indi magnubo sa minimum wage sandig sa ginapatuman sa ila mga rehiyon.
english: Under this bus driver income scheme, bus drivers, including conductors, will receive a salary not less than the minimum wage as applicable in their regions.

text: Ginamando man sang DOLE nga tagaan sila sang bagay nga mga benepisyo, katulad sang night shift differential, service incentive leave, 13th month pay, holiday, kag overtime kag premium pay.
english: The DOLE also mandates that they be given appropriate benefits, such as night shift differential, service incentive leave, 13th month pay, holiday, and overtime and premium pay.

text: Katahum matuod ining skema sang kita sang mga bus driver kag mga conductor nga igapatuman sang DOLE, nga makabulig solbar sang madamo nga problema sa trapiko – halin sa manubo nga kita nila tubtub sa mga aksidente nga tuga sang indi pagsunod sa  mga regulasyon sa trapiko.
english: This income scheme for bus drivers and conductors to be implemented by the DOLE is truly beautiful, which will help solve many traffic problems – from their low income to accidents caused by non-compliance with traffic regulations.

text: Apang dapat indi lang ang mga bus driver kag mga conductor ang maga-ayuhan sa sining mando, nga sa subong mismo nakita naton nga makapaayo sa ila.
english: But it should not only be the bus drivers and conductors who will benefit from this order, which right now we have seen will benefit them.

text: Dapat may angay man nga kita (return to investment) ang mga operator, pati na ang iban nga apektado sang sining mandamiento.
english: Operators, as well as others affected by this mandate, must also have a return on investment.

text: Sa obserbasyon sang isa ka pagtuon sa problem sa trapiko, indi lang ang Salary System Fundamental dapat maga-resulta sa safe (hilway sa katalagman) nga serbisyo tungod sa maayo nga kita kag benepisyo sang mga bus driver kag mga conductor.
english: According to the observation of a study on the traffic problem, not only the Salary System Fundamental should result in safe (safe) service because of the good income and benefits of bus drivers and conductors.

text: Dapat man nga masaligan (reliable) ini nga makahatag sang suficiente nga capacidad sa pagsabat sa kinahanglanon (demand) sang mga pasahero kag sang ila mga dala.
english: It must also be reliable enough to provide sufficient capacity to meet the demand of passengers and their luggage.

text: In other words, dapat matatapan gid ang kinahanglanon sa pagbiyahe sang tanan sa nagakaigu nga tion kag circumstancia sang pagbiyahe.
english: In other words, everyone's travel needs must be met at the appropriate time and circumstances of travel.

text: Importante man nga ang mga bus operator may rasonable man nga kita (reasonable returns) sa ila operasyon.
english: It is also important that bus operators have reasonable returns from their operations.

text: Kon indi man maka-earn sing nagakaigu ang mga operator, aba basi mag-uluntat man ini sang ila operasyon kag nada ang damgo ta nga hilway kag masaligan nga serbisyo sa aton mga dalanon.
english: If the operators do not earn enough, they may stop their operations and our dream of free and reliable service on our roads will be lost.

text: Ini bala nga mga konsiderasyon nakita na sang aton mga otoridad, labi na gid sang DOLE, agud mangin madinalag-on ining skema sa kita sang mga bus driver kag mga conductor?
english: Have these considerations been seen by our authorities, especially the DOLE, to make this scheme successful in the income of bus drivers and conductors?

text: Basi wala pa sing kapihu-an kag sa lugar nga madinalag-on sa tanan, mga bus driver kag mga conductor lang ang mabuhi kag mag-enjoy, samtang nagatanga sa hangin ang mga operator nga luyag man makaseguro sang ila kita.
english: Maybe there is no security and in a place where everyone is successful, only bus drivers and conductors will survive and enjoy, while the operators who want to secure their income are struggling in the air.

text: Maayo seguro nga tun-an ta ini sing maayo bag-o ma-implementar sing lubos.
english: It's probably good to study it carefully before implementing it fully.

text:
***

Meantime, indi kita malipat nga ang problema naton sa trapiko indi lang masolbar sining skema sa kita sang mga bus driver kag mga conductor.
english:
***

Meantime, let us not forget that our traffic problem will not be solved by this scheme with the income of bus drivers and conductors.

text: Yara sa gihapon ang problema sang pagpatuman sang mga regulasyon sa trapiko sang aton mga otoridad.
english: There is still the problem of enforcing traffic regulations by our authorities.

text: Nakita naton gihapon ang ka-lax sang pagpatuman sang mga regulasyon sa trapiko (lack of enforcement) nga naga-resulta sa kakulangan sang disiplina kag “unsafe driving behaviour” sang mga driver.
english: We still see lax enforcement of traffic regulations resulting in lack of discipline and unsafe driving behavior of drivers.

text: Yara man ang sinadto nga pagpanukot sang penalty kag palpak nga monitoring system, kag ang mahuyang nga penalty system sang mga operator kontra sa mga dishonest nga mga driver.
english: There is also the old penalty collection and failed monitoring system, and the weak penalty system of operators against dishonest drivers.

text: Kag yara ang kakulangan sang technical skill sang aton mga driver sa paggamit sing nagakaigu sang ila salakyan, haslo nga driving practices kag binatasan sang publiko sa masami paglubag sang mga regulasyon sa trapiko.
english: And there is the lack of technical skill of our drivers in the proper use of their vehicles, poor driving practices and the behavior of the public in often violating traffic regulations.

text: Kabay tani nga matagaan ta anay ini tanan sang husto nga pagtuon kag pagpatuman agud mangin masulhay ang aton pagbiyahe kag nagakita sing alalangay ang aton mga driver kag mga  conductor, kag ang mga operator.
english: Hopefully we will give all of these proper study and implementation so that our journey will be easier and our drivers and conductors, and the operators will earn a living.

text: Nagpasa sang iya resignation letter si Atty. Karlo Nograles nga amo ang chairperson sang Civil Service Commission (CSC) sa sulod sang duha ka tuig.
english: Atty. has submitted his resignation letter. Karlo Nograles who has been the chairperson of the Civil Service Commission (CSC) for the past two years.

text: Epektibo subong nga Oktubre 7 ang iya pagpanaog sa pwesto santo sa sulat nga ginpadala kay President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: His resignation is effective October 7, according to a letter sent to President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: Ginkumpirma man sini nga magabalik siya sa Davao City agud gamiton suno sa iya ang mga leksyon nga iya natun-an bilang head sang commission kag amo man ang duha ka dekada sini nga serbisyo sa gobyerno.
english: He also confirmed that he will return to Davao City to use the lessons he learned as head of the commission as well as his two decades of government service.

text: “It is with mixed emotions that I tender my resignation as Chairperson of the Civil Service Commission (CSC) effective today, 7 October 2024.
english: “It is with mixed emotions that I tender my resignation as Chairperson of the Civil Service Commission (CSC) effective today, 7 October 2024.

text: This decision was difficult to make, as my time with the Commission has been productive, fulfilling, and inspiring.
english: This decision was difficult to make, as my time with the Commission has been productive, fulfilling, and inspiring.

text: I am extremely grateful for the opportunity to serve alongside such dedicated public servants,” kabahin sang iya sulat.
english: I am extremely grateful for the opportunity to serve alongside such dedicated public servants,” he wrote.

text: Kumpyansa man ini sa hinimuan sang CSC sa idalom sang iya liderato.
english: He is also confident in the performance of the CSC under his leadership.

text: “As I embark on this new path of public service, I leave the CSC extremely confident in its ability to steer our bureaucracy towards greater heights,” kabahin sang iya sulat.
english: “As I embark on this new path of public service, I leave the CSC extremely confident in its ability to steer our bureaucracy towards greater heights,” part of his letter.

text: Sa idalom ni Nograles, nakapatuman ang CSC sang direct public engagement programs kag gin-improve ang profile sang eligibility exams para mas makagalanyat sa mga Pilipino ang government service.
english: Under Nograles, the CSC has implemented direct public engagement programs and improved the profile of eligibility exams to make government service more attractive to Filipinos.

text: Mas ginsapubliko man ang pagkilala sa most outstanding civil servants sa idalom sang iya termino kag ginduso man ang modernisasyon kag ang digitalization sang ahensya.
english: He also made the recognition of the most outstanding civil servants more public under his term and pushed for the modernization and digitalization of the agency.

text: Matandaan nga antes na-appoint sa CSC, nakaserbe si Nograles bilang Cabinet secretary sang Duterte administration sang 2018 tubtub sang 2022 kag nakaserbe man bilang acting Presidential spokesperson halin sang 2021 tubtub sang 2022.
english: Before being appointed to the CSC, Nograles served as Cabinet secretary of the Duterte administration from 2018 to 2022 and as acting Presidential spokesperson from 2021 to 2022.

text: Nangin representative man siya sang 1st District sang Davao City halin sang 2010 tubtub sang 2018.
english: He was also the representative of the 1st District of Davao City from 2010 to 2018.

text: May mga naga-guluwa nga impormasyon nga magapadalagan ini sa posisyon sa local elections sa syudad sang Davao.
english: There are reports that he will run for the position in the local elections in Davao City.

text: Tubtub buwas, Oktubre 8, ang filing period sang Certificate of Candidacy (COC) sa Commission on Elections (COC).#
english: The filing period for the Certificate of Candidacy (COC) at the Commission on Elections (COC) is until tomorrow, October 8.#

text: UNA naisipan nga islan ang ngalan sang Filipinas ukon Pilipinas, ukon Philippines (sa English) sa Maharlika sang panahon sang martial law, ukon pagginahum militar, ni anay Diktador Ferdinand E. Marcos.
english: IT was first thought to change the name of the Philippines or Pilipinas, or Philippines (in English) to the Maharlika during the martial law, or military rule, of former Dictator Ferdinand E. Marcos.

text: Agud, sunu sa iya, hukson ang tanikala sang colonial influence sa pungsod kag islan ang laragway sang Filipino sa isa ka dungganon (maharlika) nga pumuluyo kag indi sang mga ulipon sang mga conquestadores.
english: In order, he said, to break the chains of colonial influence in the country and change the image of the Filipino to a dignified (royal) citizen and not the slaves of the conquistadors.

text: Wala ugaling matigayon ini kay may nakahutik seguro sa kay Marcos nga kaladlawan ang iya plano kay sa matuod indi mangin dungganon ang Filipino samtang indi siya hilway sa idalom sang pagginahum militar.
english: However, this was not achieved because someone must have thought that Marcos' plan was ridiculous because in fact the Filipino will not be honorable while he is not free under military rule.

text: Sining sini lang gin-ungkat man gani ini ni Presidente Duterte, sa amo man nga rason: ang paghukas sang tanikala sang colonal influence sa pungsod kag ang pag-suhestyon sang ngalan nga Maharlika.
english: Recently, President Duterte even raised it, for the same reason: to loosen the chains of colonial influence in the country and to suggest the name Maharlika.

text: Apang, hinali lang nga nag-atras man si Presidente Duterte sang may nakahutik man seguro sa iya nga indi bagay nga tawgon nga maharlika ang mga Filipino.
english: However, President Duterte suddenly backed down when someone told him that it was not appropriate to call the Filipinos monarchs.

text: Nagsiling na gid lang siya sa Kongreso nga bahala na kamo dira kon luyag man ninyo islan ang ngalan sang aton pungsod, kag kon ano ini nga ngalan.
english: He just told Congress that it's up to you if you want to change the name of our country, and what that name is.

text: Ngaa ayhan?
english: Why maybe?

text: Tungod seguro kay ang mga maharlika sadto nagasakop sang mga manggaran, mga poderoso kag ali nga mga hangaway nga manubo ang pagtan-aw sa mga kubos nga mga timawa (freemen) kag alipin (slaves) sa ila idalom.
english: Perhaps because the kings of old conquered the rich, powerful and elite soldiers who looked down on the poor freemen and slaves under them.

text: Dapat dungganon man ang pagtan-aw naton sa tanan kag indi ini mahimo sang mga maharlika.
english: We should also treat everyone with dignity and royalty cannot do that.

text:
***

Ti, kinahanglan gid bala naton islan pa ang ngalan sang Filipinas, ukon Pilipinas, ukon Philippines?
english:
***

Well, do we really need to change the name of the Philippines, or Pilipinas, or Philippines?

text: Indi na kinahanglan, kon ako ang pamangkuton!
english: Not necessarily, if you ask me!

text: Una ta nga rason: ang ideya nga colonial influence dapat tani ginkilala na naton ini mismo sadtong lubos na kita nangin-independiente sa Amerika sang Hulyo 4, 1946.
english: Our first reason: the idea of ​​colonial influence should have been recognized by us when we became fully independent from America on July 4, 1946.

text: Of course, natandaan ta pa ang pagtukod sang Republika ng Pilipinas ni anay Heneral Emilio Aguinaldo nga nagdeklarar sang aton independencia sadtong Hunyo 12, 1899.
english: Of course, we remember the establishment of the Republic of the Philippines by former General Emilio Aguinaldo who declared our independence on June 12, 1899.

text: Wala ugaling ginkilala ini sang iban nga mga pungsod samtang sige pa ang pag-gahum sang mga Amerikano sa aton.
english: However, other countries did not recognize this while the Americans continued to rule over us.

text: Tubtub subong nga tuig 2019, 73 anyos despues sang 1946, nagpabilin ang ngalan sang Filipinas.
english: Until this year 2019, 73 years after 1946, the name of the Philippines remains.

text: Samtang ang iban nga pungsod nag-ilis sang ila ngalan sa pagsugod mismo sang pagdeklarar sang ila independencia, katulad sang Sri Lanka (sadto Ceylon) kag Jordan (sadto Transjordan).
english: While other countries changed their names at the very beginning of the declaration of their independence, such as Sri Lanka (formerly Ceylon) and Jordan (formerly Transjordan).

text: Ngaa ayhan wala ta ya nag-ilis sang ngalan sadtong ginbuy-an na kita sang Amerika?
english: Why didn't we change our name when America let us go?

text: Kon hango man lang ang Filipinas sa ngalan ni Haring Felipe II sang Espanya, nga sadto emperador sang Espanya, nga nagpa-colonizar sang Filipinas, indi ini rason.
english: If the Philippines is named after King Philip II of Spain, who was then emperor of Spain, who colonized the Philippines, this is not a reason.

text: Ang ngalan nga Filipinas wala man nagadala sang personalidad ni Haring Felipe II, kundi sang isa ka matahum nga lin-ay, nga nagapadumdum sa aton sang katahum sang aton pungsod, nga Pearl of the Orient Seas kon tawgon gani sa iban nga pungsod.
english: The name Philippines does not carry the personality of King Philip II, but a beautiful landscape, which reminds us of the beauty of our country, the Pearl of the Orient Seas as it is called in other countries.

text: Kag kon tungod lang pangayaw ini nga pangalan indi man ini rason.
english: And if it's just because it's a foreign name, that's not a reason.

text: Siling gani ni Shakespeare: “A rose by any other name is as sweet”.
english: Shakespeare even said: “A rose by any other name is as sweet”.

text: In fact, ang bulak sang rosas makita ini sa madamo nga lugar nga ang katahum indi dapat angkunon sang isa ukon pila lang ka tawo ukon pungsod.
english: In fact, the rose flower is found in many places where beauty should not be claimed by one or a few people or countries.

text: Iya ini sang tanan nga luyag maghaklo libre sang kahumot sini.
english: It belongs to everyone who wants to breathe freely its fragrance.

text: Kasubong man sina ang ngalan, nga pwede iangot sa kon sin-o nga luyag sini.
english: The same is true of a name, which can be associated with anyone who wants it.

text: Madamo gani sang aton matahum nga kadalagahan ang may ngalan nga Filipinas.
english: Many of our beautiful girls even have Filipina names.

text: Sa ikatlo nga rason, ang independencia naton sa Amerika sadtong 1946 amo man yadtong tuig nga gintukod ang United Nations nga nagbugkos sang mga pungsod sa ideya sang Universal Human Rights para sa tanan, notwithstanding sang ila mga cultural differences.
english: For the third reason, our independence from America in 1946 was also the year that the United Nations was founded which bound nations together with the idea of ​​Universal Human Rights for all, notwithstanding their cultural differences.

text: Bugal ta pa gani nga isa ka Filipino, si Carlos P. Romulo, ang nangin presidente sang UN General Assembly sadtong 1949.
english: We are even proud that a Filipino, Carlos P. Romulo, became president of the UN General Assembly in 1949.

text: In other words, wala na sing kahulugan ang colonial influence sa aton tungod open na kita sa nagakalain-lain nga kultura nga may respeto sa tanan nga iban nga kultura bisan sa gihapon ginatib-ong naton ang aton namat-an nga kultura.
english: In other words, the colonial influence has no meaning for us because we are open to different cultures with respect for all other cultures even though we are still preserving our learned culture.

text: Matahum matuod ang ngalan nga Filipinas, ukon Pilipinas, ukon Philippines nga indi naton kinahanglan islan pa.
english: The name Filipinas, or Pilipinas, or Philippines is so beautiful that we don't need to change it.

text: Wala man ini labot sa kapintas ni Haring Felipe II ukon ano man nga kalainan niya.
english: It also has nothing to do with the cruelty of King Philip II or any of his evil.

text: Indi man ang Filipinas si Haring Felipe II.
english: King Philip II is not the Philippines.

text: ILOILO CITY- Bastante pa ang mga pasilidad sang Iloilo City Government nga ginapahamtangan sang mga Locally Stranded Individuals nga nagaabot sa Syudad sang Iloilo.
english: ILOILO CITY- The Iloilo City Government has enough facilities to accommodate Locally Stranded Individuals arriving in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga ginagamit sang syudad ang University of Iloilo- Phinma, Jaro Gym, Iloilo Central Elementary School, kag Diamond Jubilee Hall bilang quarantine facilities.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas said the city is using the University of Iloilo-Phinma, Jaro Gym, Iloilo Central Elementary School, and Diamond Jubilee Hall as quarantine facilities.

text: Sa tion nga kulangon gid man, ginpahayag sang alkalde nga may yara na sang mga eskwelahan nga ginreserba ang syudad.
english: In case of a shortage, the mayor said the city already has schools reserved.

text: Suno kay Mayor Treñas, ini ang ginalakipan sang Lapaz Elementary School sa Lapaz; Molo 1 Elementary School sa Molo; Jaro National High School kag isa ka eskwelahan sa Balantang, Jaro, kag may isa man ka eskwelahan sa Mandurriao.
english: According to Mayor Treñas, these include Lapaz Elementary School in Lapaz; Molo 1 Elementary School in Molo; Jaro National High School and a school in Balantang, Jaro, and there is also a school in Mandurriao.

text: Pahayag sang alkalde, natalana nga magpirma sang Memorandum of Agreement sa masunod nga semana ang Iloilo City Government kag tagdumalahan sang  ginreserba nga mga eskwelahan.
english: The mayor said the Iloilo City Government and the management of the reserved schools are scheduled to sign a Memorandum of Agreement next week.

text: Isang malakas na lindol na may lakás na 8.7 magnitude ang yumanig malapit sa Kamchatka Peninsula sa Russia nitong Miyerkules ng umaga, na nagbunsod ng mga babala ng tsunami at mga kautusang lumikas para sa ilang bahagi ng Japan, Russia, Alaska, at maging sa Hawaii.
english: A powerful earthquake measuring 8.7 on the Richter scale struck near the Kamchatka Peninsula in Russia on Wednesday morning, triggering tsunami warnings and evacuation orders for parts of Japan, Russia, Alaska, and even Hawaii.

text: Ayon sa Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA), unang naitala ang lindol bandang 8:25 a.m. (oras sa Japan) o 11:25 p.m. GMT noong Martes, na unang tinaya sa 8.0 magnitude, ngunit kalauna’y itinaas sa 8.7 matapos ang mas masusing pagsusuri.
english: According to the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA), the quake was first recorded around 8:25 a.m. (Japan time) or 11:25 p.m. GMT on Tuesday, which was initially estimated at 8.0 magnitude, but was later raised to 8.7 after further investigation.

text: Naglabas ang ahensiya ng tsunami advisory para sa hanggang 1 metrong taas ng alon sa baybayin ng Pacific sa Japan, ngunit inaasahang aabot pa ito sa 3 metro, batay sa pinakabagong pagsusuri.
english: The agency issued a tsunami advisory for up to 1 meter of wave height off the Pacific coast of Japan, but it is expected to reach 3 meters, based on the latest assessment.

text:
Ayon kay Yoshimasa Hayashi, Chief Cabinet Secretary ng Japan:

“Ang mga nasa baybayin ay agad na dapat lumikas patungo sa mas mataas na lugar o ligtas na gusali sa mga lugar na nasa ilalim ng babala ng tsunami mula Hokkaido hanggang Wakayama Prefecture.
english:
According to Yoshimasa Hayashi, Chief Cabinet Secretary of Japan:

“Those on the coast should immediately evacuate to higher ground or safe buildings in areas under tsunami warning from Hokkaido to Wakayama Prefecture.

text:
Tandaan na maaaring mas mataas pa ang kasunod na alon kaysa sa naunang dumating.”

Ang lindol ay tumama sa layong humigit-kumulang 250 kilometro mula sa Hokkaido, ang pinakahilagang pangunahing isla ng Japan.
english:
Remember that the next wave will be higher than the previous one.”

The quake struck about 250 kilometers from Hokkaido, Japan's largest main island.

text: Ayon sa ulat ng NHK, bahagya lamang itong naramdaman sa bansa.
english: According to NHK, it was barely felt in the country.

text: Samantala, ayon sa U.S. Geological Survey (USGS), ang lindol ay may lalim na 19.3 kilometro (12 milya).
english: Meanwhile, according to the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS), the quake was 19.3 kilometers (12 miles) deep.

text: Nagbabala ang USGS na ang mga mapanganib na alon ng tsunami na maaaring umabot sa 3 metro ang taas ay posibleng tumama sa baybayin ng Russia at Japan sa loob ng susunod na tatlong oras.
english: The USGS warns that dangerous tsunami waves up to 3 meters high are likely to hit the coasts of Russia and Japan within the next three hours.

text: Kasabay nito, naglabas din ng tsunami warning ang Pacific Tsunami Warning Center ng U.S. National Weather Service para sa Hawaii, kung saan maaaring makaranas ng pagtaas ng tubig at pinsala sa mga baybayin ng lahat ng isla.
english: Meanwhile, the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center of the U.S. National Weather Service also issued a tsunami warning for Hawaii, which could experience rising water levels and damage to the coasts of all islands.

text: Kulang sa tawo apang nasarangan sang Denver Nuggets nga mapatilaw kay Shai Gilgeous-Alexander kag sa Oklahoma City Thunder ang una nga mapait nga kapaslawan subong nga regular season sa National Basketball Association (NBA).
english: The Denver Nuggets were undermanned but managed to make Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Oklahoma City Thunder taste their first bitter failure this regular season in the National Basketball Association (NBA).

text: Nanguna sa 124-122 win sang former champions ang triple-double sang three-time MVP nga si Nikola Jokic nga may 23 points, 20 rebounds, kag 16 assists nga amo ang nagtapos sang perpekto nga record sang Thunder (7-1).
english: Three-time MVP Nikola Jokic’s triple-double of 23 points, 20 rebounds, and 16 assists capped the Thunder’s perfect record (7-1) in the 124-122 win over the former champions.

text: Ini man ang ikaapat na nga triple-double sang 29-anyos nga Serbian superstar subong nga season.
english: This is also the 29-year-old Serbian superstar's fourth triple-double this season.

text: Naka-skor naman si Russell Westbrook sang 29 points, may tag-24 puntos sanday Michael Porter Jr.
english: Russell Westbrook scored 29 points, Michael Porter Jr. had 24 points each.

text: kag Christian Braun, samtang may 10 points kag three blocks naman si Peyton Watson lakip na ang game-sealing block isa ka segundo ang nabilin sa game.
english: and Christian Braun, while Peyton Watson had 10 points and three blocks including a game-sealing block one second left in the game.

text: Ini nga kadalag-an amo man ang nagtapos sang four-game head-to-head losing streak sang Denver batok sa Oklahoma City.
english: This victory also ended Denver’s four-game head-to-head losing streak against Oklahoma City.

text: Naghampang sanday Jokic nga wala si Jamal Murray (concussion protocol) sa ikatatlo na nga tion, kag wala man si Aaron Gordon nga indi man makahampang sa masunod nga sinemana bangud sa right calf strain.
english: Jokic played without Jamal Murray (concussion protocol) for the third time, and Aaron Gordon, who will also miss next week with a right calf strain.

text: Sa Thunder naman, may 29 points, 10 rebounds kag nine assists si Jalen Williams samtang si Gilgeous-Alexander ang naka-skor sang 28 puntos.
english: For the Thunder, Jalen Williams had 29 points, 10 rebounds and nine assists while Gilgeous-Alexander scored 28 points.

text: Patas na subong ang Oklahoma City sa Suns kag Warriors sa number 1 spot sa West nga may 7-1 record samtang nagsaka naman ang Denver sa 5-3.#
english: Oklahoma City is now tied with the Suns and Warriors for the number 1 spot in the West with a 7-1 record while Denver moved up to 5-3.#

text: KABAY nga ang pamahog sa kabuhi sang mga obispo sang Simbahan Catolica pamahog gid lang kag indi pagatumanon sang kon sin-o nga nagapamahog nga ini.
english: HOPEFULLY the threat to the lives of the bishops of the Catholic Church is a threat and will not be carried out by whoever threatens it.

text: Ini nga pagpamahog sa mga Obispo ginpahibalo na gani ni Luis Cardinal Tagle sang sini lang kay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte mismo.
english: This threat to the Bishops was even informed by Luis Cardinal Tagle recently to President Rodrigo Duterte himself.

text: Posible nga tuga ini sang sugyot sang Presidente sadtong Disyembre 2018 sa diin nagsiling siya nga pamatyon ining mga Obispo.
english: This is possibly due to the President's suggestion in December 2018 where he said to kill these Bishops.

text: “These bishops, kill them.
english: “These bishops, kill them.

text: They are useless fools.
english: They are useless fools.

text: All they do is criticize,” siling sadto ni Duterte sa mix nga English kag Filipino, sunu sa isa ka pamantalaan nasyonal.
english: All they do is criticize,” Duterte said in a mix of English and Filipino, according to a national newspaper.

text: Ginatumod ining pag-criticize sang Presidente sa mga obispo nga myembro sang Catholic Bishops Conference of the Philippines, ukon CBCP), sa padayon nga Gyera kontra Droga sang Gobyernong Duterte.
english: The President's criticism of the bishops who are members of the Catholic Bishops Conference of the Philippines, or CBCP), is directed at the Duterte Government's ongoing War on Drugs.

text: Gina-kwestyon nila diri ang pagpamatay sa mga durugista nga para sa ila, sa madamo nga beses, ginhimo nga wala sing “due process”, ukon nagakaigu nga proseso sunu sa kasuguan, sa diin mga 5,000 na ang napatay sang kapulisan.
english: They question the killing of drug pushers which for them, in many cases, was done without “due process”, or due process according to the law, where about 5,000 people have been killed by the police.

text: Angot na gani ini seguro sa pagpangamuyo sang isa ka pari, si Father Noel Gatchalian, sadtong Setyembre 2018 nga tani magmasakit ang Presidente sang ginbalita nga nagmasakit siya, nga gin-deny sang Presidente.
english: This is probably related to the prayer of a priest, Father Noel Gatchalian, in September 2018 that the President would be sick when it was reported that he was sick, which the President denied.

text: Para sa Presidente pangamuyo ini agud mapatay siya.
english: For the President it is a prayer for his death.

text:
Siling gani sang Presidente: “Eh di sabihin ko na lang din ‘Mamatay sana kayong lahat ng venereal disease.’”

***

Gin-deny sang Presidente kag sang iya taghambal nga luyag niya ipapatay ang mga obispo sa iya ginhambal kontra sa ila.
english:
The President even said: “Eh di I just say 'May you all die of venereal disease.'”

***

The President and his spokesman denied that he wanted to kill the bishops for his remarks against them.

text: “Kilala naton ang Presidente sa iya hyperbole (lapaw nga sugid) nga, masami, kon indi lahog wala man sing kahulugan nga malain,” paathag gani sang iya taghambal nga si Atty. Salvador Panelo.
english: “We know the President for his hyperbole that, often, if not a joke, does not mean anything wrong,” explained his spokesman, Atty. Salvador Panelo.

text: “Abogado siya kag nahibala-an niya kon ano ang maayo kag malain,” dugang gani niya nga paathag.
english: “He is a lawyer and he knows what is right and what is wrong,” he added.

text: Ang problema lang da kay bisan langas-langas lang ini (kon langas-langas gid man), gina-seryoso ugaling ini sang iban, labi na gid sang iya mga fanatico nga sumulunod, ukon mga paryente nga todo pangapin sa iya.
english: The problem is that even if it's just a joke (if it's a joke), it's taken seriously by others, especially his fanatical followers, or relatives who are very defensive of him.

text: In fact, sa sulat ni Cardinal Tagle, ginsiling niya nga ang pagpamahog sa mga obispo halin sa “someone claiming to be working for the president’s family,” ukon malapit sa pamilya sang Presidente.
english: In fact, in Cardinal Tagle’s letter, he said the threat to the bishops came from “someone claiming to be working for the president’s family,” or close to the President’s family.

text: Sa mapati man ukon indi ang Presidente sa sining pagpamahog sa mga obispo, ginpakamaayo na gid lang sang Presidente nga ibalik ang pamahog sa sining mga nagapamahog.
english: Whether the President believes or not in this threat to the bishops, the President has just blessed to return the threat to these threats.

text: “Indi ninyo pagtandugon ang mga pari (priests), wala sila labot sa pulitika!” siling ni Presidente.
english: “Don't touch the priests, they don't care about politics!” said President.
